  //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
  function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
    try {
      // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
      // 每个调用创建新的jQuery对象，互不影响
      var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
      tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
      return $(tempDiv);
    } catch (e) {
      flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
      return $('<div>');
    }
  }

  function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
    try {
      tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
      if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
        tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
    }
  }


  function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
    // 移除script标签
    let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
    // 移除style标签
    result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
    return result;
  }

    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {

            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的jQuery对象，互不影响
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return $(tempDiv);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return $('<div>');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        return result;

    function decode(content) {
        // 将Base64编码的内容解码为WordArray
        var ivEncData = CryptoJS.enc.Base64.parse(content);
        
        // 创建AES密钥 (242ccb8230d709e1)
        var key = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("242ccb8230d709e1");
        
        // 提取前16字节作为IV
        var iv = ivEncData.clone();
        iv.sigBytes = 16;
        iv.words.splice(4); // 每个Word是4字节，16字节需要4个Word
        
        // 提取加密数据部分（从16字节开始）
        var encryptedData = ivEncData.clone();
        encryptedData.words.splice(0, 4); // 移除前4个Word（16字节）
        encryptedData.sigBytes -= 16;
        
        // 使用AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding模式解密
        var decrypted = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(
            {
                ciphertext: encryptedData,
                salt: null
            },
            key,
            {
                iv: iv,
                mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC,
                padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7 // PKCS5Padding在CryptoJS中对应Pkcs7
            }
        );
        
        // 将解密结果转换为UTF-8字符串
        return decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8);
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() { }

        /*
         * 通用返回字段

        async Get(url, headers, followRedirects) {

            // 备用方法2: 查找较长的 p 标签
            if (!intro) {

                intro = intro.replace(/^\s*未知\s*$/gm, "").trim();  // 移除只包含"未知"的行

            // 提取观看人数 - 根据glyphicon-eye-open图标定位

                    chapters.push(...c.chapters);

            }else{

                if(c.chapters.length > 0){

    // 发现页书籍列表函数
    async function find(url, page) {
        try {
            var targetUrl;

            // 判断URL类型
            var isCompleted = url.includes("/completed");
            var isPopular = url.includes("/popular");
            var isBooklist = url.includes("/booklist");

            // 处理{{page}}占位符并生成正确的分页URL
            if (url.includes("{{page}}")) {
                // URL包含占位符,需要根据类型替换为正确的格式
                if (isCompleted || isPopular) {
                    // 完本小说和热门排行的分页格式
                    // 第1页: /completed/
                    // 第2页: /completed/index_2.html
                    if (page === 1) {
                        // 第1页:直接移除{{page}}部分
                        targetUrl = url.replace("{{page}}/", "").replace("/{{page}}", "");
                    } else {
                        // 第N页:将{{page}}/替换为 index_{page}.html
                        targetUrl = url.replace("{{page}}/", "index_" + page + ".html");
                    }
                } else if (isBooklist) {
                    // 普通分类的分页格式
                    // 第1页: /booklist1/
                    // 第2页: /booklist1/1.html
                    if (page === 1) {
                        // 第1页:直接移除{{page}}部分
                        targetUrl = url.replace("{{page}}/", "").replace("/{{page}}", "");
                    } else {
                        // 第N页:替换为 {page-1}.html
                        targetUrl = url.replace("{{page}}/", (page - 1) + ".html");
                    }
                } else {
                    // 其他情况:直接替换为页码
                    targetUrl = url.replace("{{page}}", page.toString());
                }
            } else {
                // URL不包含占位符(兼容旧格式)
                if (isCompleted || isPopular) {
                    if (page === 1) {
                        targetUrl = url.replace(/\/index(_\d+)?\.html$/, '') + "/";
                    } else {
                        targetUrl = url.replace(/\/index(_\d+)?\.html$/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') + "/index_" + page + ".html";
                    }
                } else if (isBooklist) {
                    if (page === 1) {
                        targetUrl = url.replace(/\/\d+\.html$/, '') + "/";
                    } else {
                        targetUrl = url.replace(/\/\d+\.html$/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') + "/" + (page - 1) + ".html";
                    }
                } else {
                    targetUrl = url;
                }
            }

            // 发送请求
            var get = await http.Get(targetUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);

            if (!get || !get.data) {
                flutterBridge.log("❌ HTTP请求失败或返回空数据");
                return "[]";
            }

            flutterBridge.text(0, get.data);

            // 解析书籍列表
            var result = parseBookList(get.data);

            return result;
        } catch (e) {
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    // 解析书籍列表的通用函数
    function parseBookList(html) {
        try {
            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(html));
            var books = [];

            // 查找所有书籍卡片 - 使用正确的选择器 .home-truyendecu
            var $bookCards = $tempContainer.find(".home-truyendecu");

            if ($bookCards.length === 0) {
                removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
                return "[]";
            }

            $bookCards.each(function (index) {
                try {
                    var $item = $(this);

                    // 提取书名和链接 - 从 .caption h3 或 h3[itemprop="name"]
                    var $titleLink = $item.find(".caption a[itemprop='url']").first();
                    if ($titleLink.length === 0) {
                        $titleLink = $item.find(".caption h3 a").first();
                    }
                    if ($titleLink.length === 0) {
                        return; // continue
                    }

                    var name = $titleLink.find("h3[itemprop='name']").text().trim();
                    if (!name) {
                        name = $titleLink.text().trim();
                    }
                    if (!name) {
                        name = $item.find(".caption h3").text().trim();
                    }

                    if (!name) {
                        return; // continue
                    }

                    var bookUrl = $titleLink.attr('href');
                    if (!bookUrl) {
                        return; // continue
                    }

                    // 规范化bookUrl
                    if (!bookUrl.startsWith('http')) {
                        if (bookUrl.startsWith('/')) {
                            bookUrl = baseurl + bookUrl;
                        } else {
                            bookUrl = baseurl + "/" + bookUrl;
                        }
                    }

                    // 提取封面 - 从 .each_truyen img
                    var coverUrl = "";
                    var $img = $item.find(".each_truyen img").first();
                    if ($img.length > 0) {
                        var src = $img.attr('src') || $img.attr('data-src');
                        if (src) {
                            if (src.startsWith('http')) {
                                coverUrl = src;
                            } else if (src.startsWith('/')) {
                                coverUrl = baseurl + src;
                            } else {
                                coverUrl = src; // 可能已经是完整URL
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // 提取作者 - 列表页的作者在 .chi-tiet.chuyen-muc a 中(无href属性)
                    var author = "";
                    var $authorElem = $item.find(".chi-tiet.chuyen-muc a").first();
                    if ($authorElem.length > 0) {
                        var authorText = $authorElem.text().trim();
                        // 过滤日期格式和纯数字(浏览量)
                        if (authorText &&
                            !/^\d{4}[-\/]\d{1,2}[-\/]\d{1,2}/.test(authorText) &&  // 不是日期
                            !/^\d+$/.test(authorText) &&  // 不是纯数字
                            authorText !== "未知") {  // 不是"未知"
                            author = "作者:" + authorText;  // 添加"作者:"前缀
                        }
                    }

                    // 如果没找到,尝试其他位置
                    if (!author) {
                        var $chiTiet = $item.find(".chi-tiet").first();
                        if ($chiTiet.length > 0) {
                            var text = $chiTiet.text().trim();
                            if (text &&
                                !/^\d{4}[-\/]/.test(text) &&
                                !/^\d+$/.test(text) &&
                                text !== "未知") {
                                author = "作者:" + text;  // 添加"作者:"前缀
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // 提取分类 - 列表页不显示
                    var kind = "";

                    // 提取简介 - 列表页不显示
                    var intro = "";

                    // 提取最新章节
                    var latestChapterTitle = "";
                    var $latestChapter = $item.find(".chi-tiet.tt-status a, .tt-status a").first();
                    if ($latestChapter.length > 0) {
                        latestChapterTitle = $latestChapter.text().trim();
                    }

                    var book = {
                        "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                        "name": name,
                        "author": author,
                        "kind": kind,
                        "coverUrl": coverUrl,
                        "intro": intro,
                        "tocUrl": bookUrl,
                        "wordCount": "",
                        "type": 0,
                        "latestChapterTitle": latestChapterTitle,
                    };
                    books.push(book);
                } catch (e) {
                    // 跳过解析失败的书籍
                }
            });

            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) {
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {
            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的jQuery对象，互不影响
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return $(tempDiv);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return $('<div>');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

            return $('<div>');
        }
    }

        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {

        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);

async function chapter(tocUrl) {

// 辅助函数：构建分页 URL（仅保留第一页逻辑，兼容原函数调用）
function buildPageUrl(tocUrl, pageIndex) {
    if (pageIndex === 0) {
        return tocUrl;
    } else {
        const baseUrl = tocUrl.endsWith('/') ? tocUrl.slice(0, -1) : tocUrl;
        return baseUrl + "/" + (pageIndex + 1) + "/";
    }
}

    // 获取单页章节
    async function getChapterPage(pageUrl) {
        try {
            var get = await http.Get(pageUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
            flutterBridge.text(2, get.data);

            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var chapters = [];
            var hasNextPage = false;

            var novelId = "";
            var match = pageUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\/?/);

                novelId = match[1];
            }

            var $listContainer = $tempContainer.find("#content_1");
            var $chapterLinks = $listContainer.length > 0 ? $listContainer.find("a[href*='.html']") : $tempContainer.find("a[href*='.html']");

            var index = 0;
            $chapterLinks.each(function () {
                var $link = $(this);
                var chapterName = $link.text().trim();
                var href = $link.attr('href');

                if (!chapterName || !href || chapterName.length < 2) {
                    return true;

                if (chapterName.includes("下载") || chapterName.includes("TXT") || chapterName.includes("目录") ||
                    chapterName.includes("下一页") || chapterName.includes("上一页") || chapterName.includes("开始阅读") ||
                    chapterName.includes("最新章节") || chapterName === "全部") {

                }

                } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {

                } else {
                    chapterId = baseurl + "/" + novelId + "/" + href;

                    "index": index,
                    "isPay": false,
                    "isVip": false,
                    "isVolume": false,
                    "tag": ""
                });

            });

            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {

                if (text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) {
                    hasNextPage = true;
                    return false;

            });

            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
            return { chapters: chapters, hasNextPage: hasNextPage };
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节页出错:" + e.message);
            return { chapters: [], hasNextPage: false };

    // 章节内容函数(支持分页章节)
    async function content(url) {
        try {
            var allContent = [];
            var currentUrl = url;
            var pageIndex = 1;
            var maxPages = 10; // 防止无限循环

            while (pageIndex <= maxPages) {
                var get = await http.Get(currentUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
                if (pageIndex === 1) {
                    flutterBridge.text(3, get.data);
                }

                var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));

               
                var $content = $tempContainer.find("#booktxt");

                if ($content.length > 0) {
                    // 移除广告和无关元素
                    $content.find("script, style, .ad, .adsbygoogle, .advertisement").remove();

                    // 提取段落内容
                    var paragraphs = [];
                    $content.find("p").each(function () {
                        var text = $(this).text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    });

                    // 如果没有p标签,直接获取文本
                    if (paragraphs.length === 0) {
                        var text = $content.text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    }

                    if (paragraphs.length > 0) {
                        allContent.push(paragraphs.join('\r\n\r\n'));
                    }
                } else {
                    break;
                }

                // 检查是否有下一页
                var hasNextPage = false;
                $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();
                    var href = $(this).attr('href');
                    if ((text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) && href) {
                        // 构建下一页URL
                        if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                            currentUrl = href;
                        } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                            currentUrl = baseurl + href;
                        } else {
                            // 相对路径,需要基于当前URL构建
                            var urlParts = currentUrl.split('/');
                            urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] = href;
                            currentUrl = urlParts.join('/');
                        }
                        hasNextPage = true;
                        return false; // break
                    }
                });

                removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

                if (!hasNextPage) {
                    break;
                }

                pageIndex++;
            }

            // 合并所有分页内容
            var finalContent = allContent.join('\r\n\r\n');

            // 移除导航文本
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/上一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/目录/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一页/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/首页/g, '');

            // 清理多余的空行
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/\r\n\r\n\r\n+/g, '\r\n\r\n').trim();

            return finalContent;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节内容出错:" + e.message);
            return "";
        }
    }

function parsefindList(html) {
    try {
        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(html));
        var books = [];
        var bookUrls = new Set(); // 统一去重，两种结构共用

        $tempContainer.find(".item").each(function () {
            var $item = $(this);
            var book = {
                "bookUrl": "",
                "name": "",

                "kind": "",
                "coverUrl": "",
                "intro": "",
                "tocUrl": "",
                "wordCount": "",
                "type": 0,
                "latestChapterTitle": ""

            // 提取bookUrl并过滤
            var href = $item.find(".image a").first().attr('href');
            if (!href || href.includes('javascript:') || href.includes('#')) return true;
            // URL规范化
            book.bookUrl = href.startsWith('http') ? href : (href.startsWith('/') ? baseurl + href : '');
            if (!book.bookUrl || bookUrls.has(book.bookUrl)) return true;
            bookUrls.add(book.bookUrl);

            // 【核心修改1】拼接tocUrl：优先匹配/book/数字/格式，兼容原txt数字.html格式
            var numMatch = book.bookUrl.match(/book\/(\d+)\/?/) || book.bookUrl.match(/txt(\d+)\.html/);
            book.tocUrl = numMatch ? baseurl + "/list/" + numMatch[1] + "/" : book.bookUrl; // 适配新toc路径/list/数字/

            // 提取书名并校验
            book.name = $item.find("dl dt a").first().text().trim();
            if (!book.name || book.name.length < 2) return true;

            // 提取作者/字数/简介（新增简介）
            book.author = $item.find(".btm a").first().text().trim() || "";
            book.wordCount = $item.find(".btm em.orange").first().text().trim() || "";
            book.intro = $item.find("dl dd").first().text().trim() || ""; // 新增：提取简介

            // 提取封面：和原parseBookList一致，取last()，优先data-original
            var $coverImg = $item.find(".image img").last();
            if ($coverImg.length > 0) {
                var src = $coverImg.attr('data-original');
                if (src) {
                    book.coverUrl = src.startsWith('http') ? src : (src.startsWith('/') ? baseurl + src : "");
                }
                // 备用：如果没有data-original，取src
                if (!book.coverUrl) {
                    src = $coverImg.attr('src');
                    book.coverUrl = src.startsWith('http') ? src : (src.startsWith('/') ? baseurl + src : "");
                }
            }

            books.push(book);
        });

        $tempContainer.find("li:has(span.s1)").each(function () {
            var $li = $(this);
            var book = {
                "bookUrl": "",
                "name": "",
                "author": "",
                "kind": "",
                "coverUrl": "",
                "intro": "",
                "tocUrl": "",
                "wordCount": "",
                "type": 0,
                "latestChapterTitle": ""
            };

            // 提取bookUrl（span.s2 a的链接）并过滤
            var $s2A = $li.find("span.s2 a").first();
            var href = $s2A.attr('href');
            if (!href || href.includes('javascript:') || href.includes('#')) return true;
            // URL规范化
            book.bookUrl = href.startsWith('http') ? href : (href.startsWith('/') ? baseurl + href : '');
            if (!book.bookUrl || bookUrls.has(book.bookUrl)) return true;
            bookUrls.add(book.bookUrl);

            // 【核心修改2】拼接tocUrl：优先匹配/book/数字/格式，兼容原txt数字.html和纯数字格式
            var numMatch = book.bookUrl.match(/book\/(\d+)\/?/) || book.bookUrl.match(/txt(\d+)\.html/) || book.bookUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\//);
            book.tocUrl = numMatch ? baseurl + "/list/" + numMatch[1] + "/" : book.bookUrl; // 适配新toc路径/list/数字/

            // 提取书名并校验
            book.name = $s2A.text().trim();
            if (!book.name || book.name.length < 2) return true;

            // 提取分类/最新章节/作者（结构2核心字段）
            book.kind = $li.find("span.s1").first().text().trim() || ""; // 分类：如武侠
            book.latestChapterTitle = $li.find("span.s3 a").first().text().trim() || ""; // 最新章节
            book.author = $li.find("span.s4").first().text().trim() || ""; // 作者：如佚名

            // 无封面/字数/简介，留空；无其他字段，直接push
            books.push(book);
        });

        // 清理DOM+返回，和原parseBookList一致
        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        return JSON.stringify(books);
    } catch (e) {
        flutterBridge.log("解析发现页书籍列表出错:" + (e.message || "未知错误"));
        return "[]";
    }
}

            return parsefindList(get.data);

            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {

        } catch (e) {

        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');

                flutterBridge.log("正在获取第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页: " + pageUrl);

                var result = await getChapterPage(pageUrl);

                if (result.chapters.length > 0) {
                    allChapters.push(...result.chapters);
                    flutterBridge.log("第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页获取到 " + result.chapters.length + " 章");
                } else {
                    flutterBridge.log("第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页没有章节,停止获取");
                    break;
                }

                if (!result.hasNextPage) {
                    flutterBridge.log("没有下一页,总共获取 " + allChapters.length + " 章");
                    break;
                }

                pageIndex++;
                if (pageIndex >= 100) {
                    flutterBridge.log("目录页数超过100页,停止获取");
                    break;
                }
            }

            // 重新设置index
            for (var i = 0; i < allChapters.length; i++) {
                allChapters[i].index = i;
            }

            return JSON.stringify(allChapters);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节列表出错:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    // 获取单页章节
    async function getChapterPage(pageUrl) {
        try {
            var get = await http.Get(pageUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
            flutterBridge.text(2, get.data);

            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var chapters = [];
            var hasNextPage = false;

            var novelId = "";
            var match = pageUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\/?/);
            if (match) {
                novelId = match[1];
            }

            var $listContainer = $tempContainer.find("#list");
            var $chapterLinks = $listContainer.length > 0 ? $listContainer.find("a[href*='.html']") : $tempContainer.find("a[href*='.html']");

            var index = 0;
            $chapterLinks.each(function () {
                var $link = $(this);
                var chapterName = $link.text().trim();
                var href = $link.attr('href');

                if (!chapterName || !href || chapterName.length < 2) {
                    return true;
                }

                if (chapterName.includes("下载") || chapterName.includes("TXT") || chapterName.includes("目录") ||
                    chapterName.includes("下一页") || chapterName.includes("上一页") || chapterName.includes("开始阅读") ||
                    chapterName.includes("最新章节") || chapterName === "全部") {
                    return true;
                }

                var chapterId = "";
                if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                    chapterId = href;
                } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                    chapterId = baseurl + href;
                } else {
                    chapterId = baseurl + "/" + novelId + "/" + href;
                }

                chapters.push({
                    "name": chapterName,
                    "chapterId": chapterId,
                    "index": index,
                    "isPay": false,
                    "isVip": false,
                    "isVolume": false,
                    "tag": ""
                });
                index++;
            });

            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
                var text = $(this).text().trim();
                if (text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) {
                    hasNextPage = true;
                    return false;
                }
            });

            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
            return { chapters: chapters, hasNextPage: hasNextPage };
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节页出错:" + e.message);
            return { chapters: [], hasNextPage: false };
        }
    }

    // 章节内容函数(支持分页章节)
    async function content(url) {
        try {
            var allContent = [];
            var currentUrl = url;
            var pageIndex = 1;
            var maxPages = 10; // 防止无限循环

            while (pageIndex <= maxPages) {
                var get = await http.Get(currentUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
                if (pageIndex === 1) {
                    flutterBridge.text(3, get.data);
                }

                var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));

                // 使用正确的内容选择器: div.con
                var $content = $tempContainer.find("#content");

                if ($content.length > 0) {
                    // 移除广告和无关元素
                    $content.find("script, style, .ad, .adsbygoogle, .advertisement").remove();

                    // 提取段落内容
                    var paragraphs = [];
                    $content.find("p").each(function () {
                        var text = $(this).text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    });

                    // 如果没有p标签,直接获取文本
                    if (paragraphs.length === 0) {
                        var text = $content.text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    }

                    if (paragraphs.length > 0) {
                        allContent.push(paragraphs.join('\r\n\r\n'));
                    }
                } else {
                    break;
                }

                // 检查是否有下一页
                var hasNextPage = false;
                $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();
                    var href = $(this).attr('href');
                    if ((text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) && href) {
                        // 构建下一页URL
                        if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                            currentUrl = href;
                        } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                            currentUrl = baseurl + href;
                        } else {
                            // 相对路径,需要基于当前URL构建
                            var urlParts = currentUrl.split('/');
                            urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] = href;
                            currentUrl = urlParts.join('/');
                        }
                        hasNextPage = true;
                        return false; // break
                    }
                });

                removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

                if (!hasNextPage) {
                    break;
                }

                pageIndex++;
            }

            // 合并所有分页内容
            var finalContent = allContent.join('\r\n\r\n');

            // 移除导航文本
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/上一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/目录/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一页/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/首页/g, '');

            // 清理多余的空行
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/\r\n\r\n\r\n+/g, '\r\n\r\n').trim();

            return finalContent;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节内容出错:" + e.message);
            return "";
        }
    }

// 发现页分类函数
async function getfinds() {
    try {
        var sort = [
            { "title": "武侠小说", "url": baseurl + "/html/wuxiaxianxia/list_{{page}}.html", "type": 0 },
            { "title": "言情小说", "url": baseurl + "/html/yanqing/list_{{page}}.html", "type": 0 },
            { "title": "玄幻小说", "url": baseurl + "/html/xuanhuan/list_{{page}}.html", "type": 0 },

    } catch (e) {

        return "[]";
    }
}

    //解析发现列表

    function parsefindList(html) {
        try {
            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(html));
            var books = [];
            var bookUrls = new Set(); // 统一去重，两种结构共用

            $tempContainer.find(".item").each(function () {
                var $item = $(this);
                var book = {
                    "bookUrl": "",
                    "name": "",
                    "author": "",
                    "kind": "",
                    "coverUrl": "",
                    "intro": "",
                    "tocUrl": "",
                    "wordCount": "",
                    "type": 0,
                    "latestChapterTitle": ""
                };

                // 提取bookUrl并过滤
                var href = $item.find(".image a").first().attr('href');
                if (!href || href.includes('javascript:') || href.includes('#')) return true;
                // URL规范化
                book.bookUrl = href.startsWith('http') ? href : (href.startsWith('/') ? baseurl + href : '');
                if (!book.bookUrl || bookUrls.has(book.bookUrl)) return true;
                bookUrls.add(book.bookUrl);

                // 拼接tocUrl：从txt数字.html提取数字
                var numMatch = book.bookUrl.match(/txt(\d+)\.html/);
                book.tocUrl = numMatch ? baseurl + "/indexlist/" + numMatch[1] + "/" : book.bookUrl;

                // 提取书名并校验
                book.name = $item.find("dl dt a").first().text().trim();
                if (!book.name || book.name.length < 2) return true;

                // 提取作者/字数/简介（新增简介）
                book.author = $item.find(".btm a").first().text().trim() || "";
                book.wordCount = $item.find(".btm em.orange").first().text().trim() || "";
                book.intro = $item.find("dl dd").first().text().trim() || ""; // 新增：提取简介

                // 提取封面：和原parseBookList一致，取last()，优先data-original
                var $coverImg = $item.find(".image img").last();
                if ($coverImg.length > 0) {
                    var src = $coverImg.attr('data-original');
                    if (src) {
                        book.coverUrl = src.startsWith('http') ? src : (src.startsWith('/') ? baseurl + src : "");
                    }
                }

                books.push(book);
            });

            $tempContainer.find("li:has(span.s1)").each(function () {
                var $li = $(this);
                var book = {
                    "bookUrl": "",
                    "name": "",
                    "author": "",
                    "kind": "",
                    "coverUrl": "",
                    "intro": "",
                    "tocUrl": "",
                    "wordCount": "",
                    "type": 0,
                    "latestChapterTitle": ""
                };

                // 提取bookUrl（span.s2 a的链接）并过滤
                var $s2A = $li.find("span.s2 a").first();
                var href = $s2A.attr('href');
                if (!href || href.includes('javascript:') || href.includes('#')) return true;
                // URL规范化
                book.bookUrl = href.startsWith('http') ? href : (href.startsWith('/') ? baseurl + href : '');
                if (!book.bookUrl || bookUrls.has(book.bookUrl)) return true;
                bookUrls.add(book.bookUrl);

                // 拼接tocUrl：兼容txt数字.html 和 纯数字两种链接格式
                var numMatch = book.bookUrl.match(/txt(\d+)\.html/) || book.bookUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\//);
                book.tocUrl = numMatch ? baseurl + "/indexlist/" + numMatch[1] + "/" : book.bookUrl;

                // 提取书名并校验
                book.name = $s2A.text().trim();
                if (!book.name || book.name.length < 2) return true;

                // 提取分类/最新章节/作者（结构2核心字段）
                book.kind = $li.find("span.s1").first().text().trim() || ""; // 分类：如武侠
                book.latestChapterTitle = $li.find("span.s3 a").first().text().trim() || ""; // 最新章节
                book.author = $li.find("span.s4").first().text().trim() || ""; // 作者：如佚名

                // 无封面/字数/简介，留空；无其他字段，直接push
                books.push(book);
            });

            // 清理DOM+返回，和原parseBookList一致
            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("解析发现页书籍列表出错:" + (e.message || "未知错误"));
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    // 发现页书籍列表函数
    async function find(url, page) {
        try {
            // APP传入的URL包含{{page}}占位符,需要替换为实际页码
            if (url.includes('{{page}}')) {
                    url = url.replace('{{page}}', page);
            }

            var get = await http.Get(url, JSON.stringify(header), true);

            return parsefindList(get.data);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取发现页出错:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    // 导出函数供APP调用
    window.search = search;
    window.info = info;
    window.chapter = chapter;
    window.content = content;
    window.getfinds = getfinds;
    window.find = find;

</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<!--如果要引入外部 js 必须在书源代码的上面-->
<script>
    var isCookieJar = false;// 不需要CookieJar请修改此处
    class FlutterJSBridge {
        constructor() {
            this.init(); //前台webview 里必须删除这行
        }

        init() {
            if (window.flutter_inappwebview) {
                this.isReady = true;
                this.CookieJar();
            } else {
                window.addEventListener('flutterInAppWebViewPlatformReady', () => {
                    this.isReady = true;
                    console.log('JSBridge初始化完成');
                    this.CookieJar();
                });
            }
        }

        //通知原生页面初始化完成,仅在书源和tts生效,webview请勿使用,只有通知加载成功后才允许运行,否则会一直等待加载成功
        async CookieJar() {
            try {
                await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('CookieJar', isCookieJar);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('汇报完成准备失败:', error);
            }
        }

        //获取应用编译版本
        async getbuildNumber() {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('buildNumber');
            } catch (error) {
                return 0;
            }
        }

        //获取应用版本
        async getversion() {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('version');
            } catch (error) {
                return "0.0.0";
            }
        }

        //获取设备唯一id
        async getDeviceid() {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('id');
            } catch (error) {
                return "";
            }
        }

        //获取设备平台 此处返回 windows、macos、ios、ohos、android
        async getDevice() {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('device');
            } catch (error) {
                return "";
            }
        }

        //输出日志,前台webview请勿使用
        //str 为 String
        async log(str) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('log', str);
            } catch (error) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        //书源调试时可输出 html 代码到前台
        //type 0 搜索源码 , 1详情源码 ,2目录源码 ,3正文源码
        //str 为 String
        //type 为int
        async text(type, str) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('text', type, str);
            } catch (error) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        //toast弹窗
        //str 为 String
        async showToast(str) {

                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('showToast', str);
            } catch (error) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        //获取默认ua
        async getWebViewUA() {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('getWebViewUA');
            } catch (error) {
                return "";
            }
        }

        //通过url打开外部应用
        //url 为 String
        async openurl(url) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('openurl', url, "");
            } catch (error) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        //通过url打开外部应用并附带mimeType
        //url 为 String
        //mimeType 为 String
        async openurlwithMimeType(url, mimeType) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('openurl', url, mimeType);
            } catch (error) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        /**
         * 使用webView访问网络
         * @param html 直接用webView载入的html, 如果html为空直接访问url
         * @param url html内如果有相对路径的资源不传入url访问不了
         * @param js 用来取返回值的js语句, 没有就返回整个源代码
         * @param body 当参数不为空的时候,会以post请求,此时请务必在 header 中带上content-type
         * @param header 请求的header头,此参数必须是json字符串
         * @return 返回js获取的内容
         */
        async webview(url, js, html, body, header) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('webview', url, js, html, body, header, "", "");
            } catch (error) {
                return "";
            }
        }

        /**
         * overrideUrlRegex 为正则表达式
         * 使用方法和上面的一样
         * 但返回的内容为正则到的内容,如果无法正则到则返回 js 获取的内容,如果 js 为空则返回页面 html
         */
        async webViewGetOverrideUrl(url, js, html, body, header, overrideUrlRegex) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('webview', url, js, html, body, header, overrideUrlRegex, "");
            } catch (error) {
                return "";
            }
        }

        /**
         * 使用webView获取资源url
         * urlregex 为正则表达式
         * 使用方法和上面的一样
         * 但返回的内容为正则到的内容,如果无法正则到则返回 js 获取的内容,如果 js 为空则返回页面 html
         */
        async webViewGetSource(url, js, html, body, header, urlregex) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('webview', url, js, html, body, header, "", urlregex);
            } catch (error) {
                return "";
            }
        }


        /**
         * 启动前台 webview 访问链接并获取结束时的 html,可用于手工过盾
         * @param url 网址

         * @return 返回网页的内容
         */
        async startBrowser(url, title, header) {

        }

        //专门为段评设置的半屏显示,不返回任何东西

        /*
        * @param str为图片链接

        * 此函数是让用户输入图片中的验证码,当链接为空则直接让用户输入验证码

                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('getVerificationCode', str, header);
            } catch (error) {

            }

        //提交内容书本信息 json 后的字符串

            } catch (error) {
                return "";
            }
        }

    }

    //webview请勿使用
    //以下提交的url,headers,body 都必须为字符串,headers必须为json字符串
    //当followRedirects 为 false 时不处理重定向,当为 true 时会自动处理重定向 ,如不明白用途直接用 true 最佳
    // 以下所有参数除当followRedirects外均为 String
    class Http {
        constructor() { }

        /*
         * 通用返回字段
         * method post get 或者 head
         * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
         * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
         * statusCode 状态码
         * statusMessage
         * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容
         */
        async Get(url, headers, followRedirects) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "get", url, "", JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, "");
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url, headers, followRedirects) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "head", url, "", JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, "");
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }


        async Post(url, headers, body, contenttype, followRedirects) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "post", url, body, JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    class Cache {
        constructor() { }
        async get(key) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.get', key);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        async set(key, value) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.set', key, value);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        async remove(key) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('cache.remove', key);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        //如果登录为弹窗格式的,里面输入框输入的内容可以通过这个函数获取,默认返回的json格式或者为空,需要自行转换
        async getLoginInfo() {
            return await this.get("LoginInfo")
        }

        //将修改后的弹窗输入内容报错 ,必须 JSON.stringify,不然会出错
        async putLoginInfo(info) {
            return await this.set("LoginInfo", info)
        }

                    });

                    // 如果没有p标签,直接获取文本

                        var text = $content.text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    }

                    if (paragraphs.length > 0) {
                        allContent.push(paragraphs.join('\r\n\r\n'));
                    }
                } else {

                }

                // 检查是否有下一页
                var hasNextPage = false;
                $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();

                removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

                if (!hasNextPage) {
                    break;

                pageIndex++;

            return finalContent;
        } catch (e) {

            book.tocUrl = book.bookUrl; // 目录链接和书籍链接一致

            // 2. 提取name：.hot_sale a p.title 的文本，非空校验
            var $titleP = $bookA.find("p.title").first();
            book.name = $titleP.text().trim();
            // 过滤无效书名（长度<2），和parseBookList校验规则一致
            if (!book.name || book.name.length < 2) {
                return true;
            }

            // 3. 提取author：.hot_sale a p.author，移除「作者：」前缀+剔除末尾（日期）后缀
            var $authorP = $bookA.find("p.author").first();
            if ($authorP.length > 0) {
                var authorText = $authorP.text().trim();
                authorText = authorText.replace(/^作者[:：\s]*/, ""); // 移除前缀，兼容中英文冒号
                authorText = authorText.replace(/（.*?）$/, ""); // 剔除末尾（日期）后缀，如（2026-01-23）
                book.author = authorText.trim(); // 二次去空格，避免残留空白
            }

            // 4. 提取intro：.hot_sale a p.review，移除「简介：」前缀
            var $reviewP = $bookA.find("p.review").first();
            if ($reviewP.length > 0) {
                var introText = $reviewP.text().trim();
                introText = introText.replace(/^简介[:：\s]*/, ""); // 移除前缀，兼容中英文冒号
                book.intro = introText;
            }

            // 以下字段：coverUrl/kind/wordCount/latestChapterTitle

            // 有效书籍加入数组
            books.push(book);
        });

        // 清理临时DOM容器，防止内存泄漏，和parseBookList保持一致
        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        // 转JSON字符串返回，异常返回空数组，格式统一

        async webview(url, js, html, body, header) {

        async webViewGetOverrideUrl(url, js, html, body, header, overrideUrlRegex) {

        async webViewGetSource(url, js, html, body, header, urlregex) {

    class Http {
        constructor() { }

        /*
         * 通用返回字段

         * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
         * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
         * statusCode 状态码
         * statusMessage
         * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容
         */
        async Get(url, headers, followRedirects) {
            try {
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "get", url, "", JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, "");
            } catch (error) {

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {
            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的jQuery对象,互不影响
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return $(tempDiv);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:" + e.message);
            return $('<div>');
        }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:" + e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js,创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

    // 章节列表函数(支持分页)
    async function chapter(tocUrl) {
        try {
            var allChapters = [];
            var pageIndex = 0;

            while (true) {
                var pageUrl;
                if (pageIndex === 0) {
                    pageUrl = tocUrl;
                } else {
                    var baseUrl = tocUrl.endsWith('/') ? tocUrl.slice(0, -1) : tocUrl;
                    pageUrl = baseUrl + "/" + (pageIndex + 1) + "/";
                }

                flutterBridge.log("正在获取第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页: " + pageUrl);

                var result = await getChapterPage(pageUrl);

                if (result.chapters.length > 0) {
                    allChapters.push(...result.chapters);
                    flutterBridge.log("第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页获取到 " + result.chapters.length + " 章");
                } else {
                    flutterBridge.log("第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页没有章节,停止获取");
                    break;
                }

                if (!result.hasNextPage) {
                    flutterBridge.log("没有下一页,总共获取 " + allChapters.length + " 章");
                    break;
                }

                pageIndex++;
                if (pageIndex >= 100) {
                    flutterBridge.log("目录页数超过100页,停止获取");
                    break;
                }
            }

            // 重新设置index
            for (var i = 0; i < allChapters.length; i++) {
                allChapters[i].index = i;
            }

            return JSON.stringify(allChapters);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节列表出错:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    // 获取单页章节
    async function getChapterPage(pageUrl) {
        try {
            var get = await http.Get(pageUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
            flutterBridge.text(2, get.data);

            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var chapters = [];
            var hasNextPage = false;

            var novelId = "";
            var match = pageUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\/?/);
            if (match) {
                novelId = match[1];
            }

            var $listContainer = $tempContainer.find(".directoryArea").last();
            var $chapterLinks = $listContainer.length > 0 ? $listContainer.find("a[href*='.html']") : $tempContainer.find("a[href*='.html']");

            var index = 0;
            $chapterLinks.each(function () {
                var $link = $(this);
                var chapterName = $link.text().trim();
                var href = $link.attr('href');

                if (!chapterName || !href || chapterName.length < 2) {
                    return true;
                }

                if (chapterName.includes("下载") || chapterName.includes("TXT") || chapterName.includes("目录") ||
                    chapterName.includes("下一页") || chapterName.includes("上一页") || chapterName.includes("开始阅读") ||
                    chapterName.includes("最新章节") || chapterName === "全部") {
                    return true;
                }

                var chapterId = "";
                if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                    chapterId = href;
                } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                    chapterId = baseurl + href;
                } else {
                    chapterId = baseurl + "/" + novelId + "/" + href;
                }

                chapters.push({
                    "name": chapterName,
                    "chapterId": chapterId,
                    "index": index,
                    "isPay": false,
                    "isVip": false,
                    "isVolume": false,
                    "tag": ""
                });
                index++;
            });

            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
                var text = $(this).text().trim();
                if (text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) {
                    hasNextPage = true;
                    return false;
                }
            });

            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
            return { chapters: chapters, hasNextPage: hasNextPage };
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节页出错:" + e.message);
            return { chapters: [], hasNextPage: false };
        }
    }

    // 章节内容函数(支持分页章节)
    async function content(url) {
        try {
            var allContent = [];
            var currentUrl = url;
            var pageIndex = 1;
            var maxPages = 10; // 防止无限循环

            while (pageIndex <= maxPages) {
                var get = await http.Get(currentUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
                if (pageIndex === 1) {
                    flutterBridge.text(3, get.data);
                }

                var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));

                // 使用正确的内容选择器: div.con
                var $content = $tempContainer.find("div.Readarea").first();

                if ($content.length > 0) {
                    // 移除广告和无关元素
                    $content.find("script, style, .ad, .adsbygoogle, .advertisement").remove();

                    // 提取段落内容
                    var paragraphs = [];
                    $content.find("p").each(function () {
                        var text = $(this).text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    });

                    // 如果没有p标签,直接获取文本
                    if (paragraphs.length === 0) {
                        var text = $content.text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    }

                    if (paragraphs.length > 0) {
                        allContent.push(paragraphs.join('\r\n\r\n'));
                    }
                } else {
                    break;
                }

                // 检查是否有下一页
                var hasNextPage = false;
                $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();
                    var href = $(this).attr('href');
                    if ((text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) && href) {
                        // 构建下一页URL
                        if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                            currentUrl = href;
                        } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                            currentUrl = baseurl + href;
                        } else {
                            // 相对路径,需要基于当前URL构建
                            var urlParts = currentUrl.split('/');
                            urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] = href;
                            currentUrl = urlParts.join('/');
                        }
                        hasNextPage = true;
                        return false; // break
                    }
                });

                removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

                if (!hasNextPage) {
                    break;
                }

                pageIndex++;
            }

            // 合并所有分页内容
            var finalContent = allContent.join('\r\n\r\n');

            // 移除导航文本
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/上一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/目录/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一页/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/首页/g, '');

            // 清理多余的空行
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/\r\n\r\n\r\n+/g, '\r\n\r\n').trim();

            return finalContent;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节内容出错:" + e.message);
            return "";
        }
    }

    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {

            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');

    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:" + e.message);

    //移除 css js,创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

    // 解析书籍列表
    function parseBookList(html) {
        try {
            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(html));
            var books = [];
            var bookUrls = new Set(); // 用于去重

            // 查找所有h3标题下的书籍链接
            $tempContainer.find("h3 a").each(function () {
                var $link = $(this);
                var href = $link.attr('href');

                // 必须有href属性
                if (!href) {
                    return true; // continue
                }

                // 过滤掉非书籍链接
                if (href.includes('/i/') || href.includes('/fenlei/') ||
                    href.includes('/paihang/') || href.includes('/wanjie/') ||
                    href.includes('/zuixin/') || href.includes('.html') ||
                    href.includes('javascript:') || href.includes('/zuozhe/')) {
                    return true; // continue
                }

                // 提取书籍ID,格式如 /167/ 或 https://www.sudugu.org/167/
                var match = href.match(/\/(\d+)\/?$/);
                if (!match) {
                    return true; // continue
                }

                var bookId = match[1];
                var bookUrl = "";
                if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                    bookUrl = href;
                } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                    bookUrl = baseurl + href;
                } else {
                    return true; // continue
                }

                // 确保URL以/结尾
                if (!bookUrl.endsWith('/')) {
                    bookUrl += '/';
                }

                // 去重
                if (bookUrls.has(bookUrl)) {
                    return true; // continue
                }
                bookUrls.add(bookUrl);

                // 提取书名
                var name = $link.text().trim();
                if (!name || name.length < 2) {
                    return true; // continue
                }

                // 查找父容器(.item或.itemtxt)获取更多信息
                var $container = $link.closest('.item, div');

                // 提取作者 - 查找包含"作者:"的链接
                var author = "";
                var $authorLink = $container.find("a[href*='/zuozhe/']").first();
                if ($authorLink.length > 0) {
                    var authorText = $authorLink.text().trim();
                    // 移除"作者:"前缀
                    author = authorText.replace(/^作者[:\s]*/, '');
                }

                // 提取分类和状态 - 从span标签中提取
                var kind = "";
                var status = "";
                $container.find("span").each(function () {
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();
                    if (text === '已完结' || text === '连载中') {
                        status = text;
                    } else if (text && text.length > 0 && text.length < 10 && !text.includes('更新')) {
                        // 可能是分类
                        if (!kind) {
                            kind = text;
                        }
                    }
                });


                // 提取封面 - 在同一容器中查找img(优先查找.item容器)
                var coverUrl = "";
                var $itemContainer = $link.closest('.item');
                var $img = $itemContainer.length > 0 ? $itemContainer.find("img").first() : $container.find("img").first();
                if ($img.length > 0) {
                    var src = $img.attr('src');
                    if (src) {
                        if (src.startsWith('http')) {
                            coverUrl = src;
                        } else if (src.startsWith('/')) {
                            coverUrl = baseurl + src;
                        }
                    }
                }


                // 提取最新章节 - 查找章节链接(包含.html的链接)
                var latestChapterTitle = "";
                var $chapterLinks = $container.find("a[href*='.html']");
                if ($chapterLinks.length > 0) {
                    // 取第一个章节链接(最新章节)
                    latestChapterTitle = $chapterLinks.first().text().trim();
                }

                var book = {
                    "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                    "name": name,
                    "author": author,
                    "kind": kind,
                    "coverUrl": coverUrl,
                    "intro": "",
                    "tocUrl": bookUrl,
                    "wordCount": status,  // 将状态信息放在wordCount字段
                    "type": 0,
                    "latestChapterTitle": latestChapterTitle
                };

                books.push(book);
            });

            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("解析书籍列表出错:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

async function info(bookurl) {

        // 1. 提取书名：容器内ul>li>h1 直接取文本（适配给定结构）
        if ($infoWrap.length > 0) {

        // 备用方案：全局h1（防止容器class变化）

        // 2. 提取作者：匹配【作者：】span，取其后续兄弟a标签的文本
        if ($infoWrap.length > 0) {

        // 备用方案：全局匹配

            author = $tempContainer.find("span:contains('作者：')").next("a").text().trim() || "";
        }

        // 3. 提取分类：匹配【类别：】span，取其父li的文本并剔除前缀

        }

        // 4. 提取封面：【精准匹配封面专属容器】（核心修改）

        // 最终去重空格，避免空值/无效值
        coverUrl = coverUrl.trim();

        // 5. 提取简介：优先精准匹配.description容器，无结果则走原兜底逻辑
        var $descContainer = $tempContainer.find(".description").first();
        if ($descContainer.length > 0) {
            intro = $descContainer.text().trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
        } else {
            var $introContainer = $tempContainer.clone();
            $introContainer.find("#list, #pages, .pages, .bookmark, .pure-u-xl-5-6").remove();
            $introContainer.find("p, div, section").each(function () {
                var text = $(this).text().trim();
                if (text.length > 50 && text.length < 1000 &&
                    !text.includes("最新章节") && !text.includes("作者") && !text.includes("更新时间") &&
                    !text.includes("第") && !text.includes("章") && !text.includes("收藏本书")) {
                    intro = text;
                    return false;
                }
            });
            removeHTMLSafely($introContainer);
        }

        // 6. 提取字数：保留原通用逻辑（结构未展示，备用）
        $tempContainer.find("*").each(function () {
            var text = $(this).clone().children().remove().end().text().trim();
            if (text.match(/^[\d.]+万字$/)) {
                wordCount = text;
                return false;
            }
        });

        // 7. 提取最新章节：排除收藏的a标签，精准匹配章节链接
        var $chapterLinks = $tempContainer.find("a[href*='.html']").not(".anchor_bookmark");
        if ($chapterLinks.length > 0) {
            latestChapterTitle = $chapterLinks.first().text().trim() || "";
        }

        // 构造返回对象（保留原所有字段，兼容原有调用）
        var book = {
            "bookUrl": bookurl,
            "name": name,
            "author": author,
            "kind": kind,
            "coverUrl": coverUrl,
            "intro": intro,
            "tocUrl": bookurl,
            "wordCount": wordCount,
            "type": 0,
            "latestChapterTitle": latestChapterTitle
        };

        // 销毁临时容器，避免内存占用
        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        // 返回JSON字符串，与原函数一致
        return JSON.stringify(book);
    } catch (e) {
        flutterBridge.log("获取详情出错:" + e.message);
        return "{}";
    }
}
    // 章节列表函数(支持分页)
    async function chapter(tocUrl) {
        try {
            var allChapters = [];
            var pageIndex = 0;

            while (true) {
                var pageUrl;
                if (pageIndex === 0) {
                    pageUrl = tocUrl;
                } else {
                    var baseUrl = tocUrl.endsWith('/') ? tocUrl.slice(0, -1) : tocUrl;
                    pageUrl = baseUrl + "/p-" + (pageIndex + 1) + ".html";
                }

                flutterBridge.log("正在获取第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页: " + pageUrl);

                var result = await getChapterPage(pageUrl);

                if (result.chapters.length > 0) {
                    allChapters.push(...result.chapters);
                    flutterBridge.log("第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页获取到 " + result.chapters.length + " 章");
                } else {
                    flutterBridge.log("第" + (pageIndex + 1) + "页没有章节,停止获取");
                    break;
                }

                if (!result.hasNextPage) {
                    flutterBridge.log("没有下一页,总共获取 " + allChapters.length + " 章");
                    break;
                }

                pageIndex++;
                if (pageIndex >= 100) {
                    flutterBridge.log("目录页数超过100页,停止获取");
                    break;
                }
            }

            // 重新设置index
            for (var i = 0; i < allChapters.length; i++) {
                allChapters[i].index = i;
            }

            return JSON.stringify(allChapters);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节列表出错:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

async function getChapterPage(pageUrl) {
    try {
        var get = await http.Get(pageUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
        flutterBridge.text(2, get.data);

        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
        var chapters = [];
        var hasNextPage = false;

        var novelId = "";
        var match = pageUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\/?/);
        if (match) {
            novelId = match[1];
        }

        var $listContainer = $tempContainer.find("#list");
        var $chapterLinks = $listContainer.length > 0 ? $listContainer.find("a[href*='.html']") : $tempContainer.find("a[href*='.html']");

        var index = 0;
        $chapterLinks.each(function () {
            var $link = $(this);
            var chapterName = $link.text().trim();
            var href = $link.attr('href');

            if (!chapterName || !href || chapterName.length < 2) {
                return true;
            }

            // 核心修复：添加「收藏本书」的过滤，同时保留原有所有排除条件
            if (chapterName.includes("下载") || chapterName.includes("TXT") || chapterName.includes("目录") ||
                chapterName.includes("下一页") || chapterName.includes("上一页") || chapterName.includes("开始阅读") ||
                chapterName.includes("最新章节") || chapterName === "全部" || chapterName.includes("收藏本书")) {
                return true;
            }

            var chapterId = "";
            if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                chapterId = href;
            } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                chapterId = baseurl + href;
            } else {
                chapterId = baseurl + "/" + novelId + "/" + href;
            }

            chapters.push({
                "name": chapterName,
                "chapterId": chapterId,
                "index": index,
                "isPay": false,
                "isVip": false,
                "isVolume": false,
                "tag": ""
            });
            index++;
        });

        $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
            var text = $(this).text().trim();
            if (text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) {
                hasNextPage = true;
                return false;
            }
        });

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        return { chapters: chapters, hasNextPage: hasNextPage };
    } catch (e) {
        flutterBridge.log("获取章节页出错:" + e.message);
        return { chapters: [], hasNextPage: false };
    }
}

    // 章节内容函数(支持分页章节)
    async function content(url) {
        try {
            var allContent = [];
            var currentUrl = url;
            var pageIndex = 1;
            var maxPages = 10; // 防止无限循环

            while (pageIndex <= maxPages) {
                var get = await http.Get(currentUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
                if (pageIndex === 1) {
                    flutterBridge.text(3, get.data);
                }

                var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));

                var $content = $tempContainer.find(".content").first();

                if ($content.length > 0) {
                    // 移除广告和无关元素
                    $content.find("script, style, .ad, .adsbygoogle, .advertisement").remove();

                    // 提取段落内容
                    var paragraphs = [];
                    $content.find("p").each(function () {
                        var text = $(this).text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    });

                    // 如果没有p标签,直接获取文本
                    if (paragraphs.length === 0) {
                        var text = $content.text().trim();
                        if (text.length > 0) {
                            paragraphs.push(text);
                        }
                    }

                    if (paragraphs.length > 0) {
                        allContent.push(paragraphs.join('\r\n\r\n'));
                    }
                } else {
                    break;
                }

                // 检查是否有下一页
                var hasNextPage = false;
                $tempContainer.find("a").each(function () {
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();
                    var href = $(this).attr('href');
                    if ((text === "下一页" || text.includes("下一页")) && href) {
                        // 构建下一页URL
                        if (href.startsWith('http')) {
                            currentUrl = href;
                        } else if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                            currentUrl = baseurl + href;
                        } else {
                            // 相对路径,需要基于当前URL构建
                            var urlParts = currentUrl.split('/');
                            urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] = href;
                            currentUrl = urlParts.join('/');
                        }
                        hasNextPage = true;
                        return false; // break
                    }
                });

                removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

                if (!hasNextPage) {
                    break;
                }

                pageIndex++;
            }

            // 合并所有分页内容
            var finalContent = allContent.join('\r\n\r\n');

            // 移除导航文本
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/上一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/目录/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一页/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/下一章/g, '');
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/首页/g, '');

            // 清理多余的空行
            finalContent = finalContent.replace(/\r\n\r\n\r\n+/g, '\r\n\r\n').trim();

            return finalContent;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("获取章节内容出错:" + e.message);
            return "";
        }
    }

async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
    try {
        const get = await http.Get(tocUrl, header, true);
        const data = JSON.parse(get.data);
        const chapters = [];
        
        if (data.data && data.data.chapterListWithVolume) {
            const chapterList = data.data.chapterListWithVolume;
            let v_Index = [];
            
            for (let volumeIndex = 0; volumeIndex < chapterList.length; volumeIndex++) {
                let volumeChapters = chapterList[volumeIndex];
                if (volumeChapters.length === 0) continue;
                
                let volumeName = volumeChapters[0].volume_name;
                v_Index.push(chapters.length);
                
                chapters.push({
                    name: volumeName,
                    chapterId: "",
                    index: chapters.length,
                    isPay: false,
                    isVip: false,
                    isVolume: true,
                    tag: ""
                });
                
                for (let chapterItem of volumeChapters) {
                    let timestamp = parseInt(chapterItem.firstPassTime) * 1000;
                    let chapterTime = new Date(timestamp).toLocaleString();
                    let chapterInfo = [volumeName, chapterTime].join(" | ").replace(/第.卷：默认 \|/g, "").trim();
                    
                    let chapterId = "";
                    if (chapterItem.itemId) {
                        chapterId = "data:chapter;base64," + btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({
                            item_id: chapterItem.itemId,
                            title: chapterItem.title || "未知章节"
                        }))));
                    }
                    
                    chapters.push({
                        name: chapterItem.title || "未知章节",
                        chapterId: chapterId,
                        index: chapters.length,
                        isPay: false,
                        isVip: false,
                        isVolume: false,
                        tag: chapterInfo
                    });
                }
            }
            
            let len = v_Index.length;
            if (len < 2) {
                for (; len > 0; len--) {
                    chapters.splice(v_Index[len - 1], 1);
                }
            } else {
                for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                    let currentVolumeIndex = v_Index[i];
                    let nextVolumeIndex = v_Index[i + 1];
                    if (nextVolumeIndex === undefined) nextVolumeIndex = chapters.length;
                    let chapterCount = nextVolumeIndex - currentVolumeIndex - 1;
                    chapters[currentVolumeIndex]["tag"] = `共 ${chapterCount} 章`;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return JSON.stringify(chapters);
    } catch (error) {
        return "[]";
    }
}

async function content(url, bookurl) {

        if (!url.startsWith('data:chapter;base64,')) {

        const decodedStr = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(base64Part)));
        const chapterData = JSON.parse(decodedStr);
        
        if (!chapterData.item_id) {
            return "章节ID错误";
        }
        
        let bookId = "";
        if (bookurl && bookurl.includes("book_id=")) {
            const bookIdMatch = bookurl.match(/book_id=(\d{19})/);

                bookId = bookIdMatch[1];
            }
        }
        
        let contentUrl = `${baseUrl}/content?item_id=${chapterData.item_id}`;
        if (bookId) {
            contentUrl += `&book_id=${bookId}`;
        }
        
        const get = await http.Get(contentUrl, header, true);
        const response = JSON.parse(get.data);
        
        // 检查是否是限流错误

            return response.message;
        }
        
        if (Array.isArray(response) && response.length > 0) {
            const chapter = response[0];
            
            if (chapter.content) {
                return chapter.content;
            }
        }
        
        return "内容加载失败";
    } catch (error) {
        return "内容加载失败";
    }

            const books = [];
            
            if (url.includes("type_style")) {
                const response = JSON.parse(get.data);
                if (response.data && response.data.book_info) {
                    for (const item of response.data.book_info) books.push(await processBookData(item));
                } else if (response.data && response.data.data) {
                    for (const item of response.data.data) books.push(await processBookData(item));
                }
            } else if (url.includes("novel.snssdk.com") && url.includes("new_category/book_list")) {
                const response = JSON.parse(get.data);
                if (response.data && response.data.data) {
                    for (const item of response.data.data) books.push(await processBookData(item));
                }
            } else if (url.includes(baseUrl) && url.includes("detail?book_id=")) {
                const response = JSON.parse(get.data);
                if (response.data) {
                    const dataList = Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [response.data];
                    for (const item of dataList) books.push(await processBookData(item));
                }
            } else if (url.includes("fanqienovel.com/fqbookshelf/groupName/")) {
                const sessionId = await getSessionId();
                if (!sessionId) return "[]";

                    let group_bookids = [];

                        let gName = i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组";

                    });
                    if (group_bookids.length > 0) {

                        const dataList = Array.isArray(detailData.data) ? detailData.data : [detailData.data];
                        for (const bookData of dataList) books.push(await processBookData(bookData));
                    }
                }
            } else if (url.includes("fanqienovel.com/fqbookshelf") || url.includes("read_recommend") || url.includes("read_history")) {
                const sessionId = await getSessionId();
                if (!sessionId) return "[]";

                    const response = JSON.parse(get.data);
                    if (response.data && response.data.cell_view && response.data.cell_view.book_data) {
                        for (const item of response.data.cell_view.book_data) books.push(await processBookData(item));
                    }
                } else if (url.includes("read_history")) {
                    const response = JSON.parse(get.data);
