                else if (response.data && Array.isArray(response.data)) bookList = response.data;
                for (const item of bookList) books.push(await processBookData(item));
            }
            return JSON.stringify(books);

  function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {

      var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');

      return $('<div>');
    }

    try {

      if (tempContainer.parentNode) {

    } catch (e) {
      flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);

  function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {

    // 移除style标签
    result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');

    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {
            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的jQuery对象，互不影响
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return $(tempDiv);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return $('<div>');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

    async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
        var chapters = [];
        var currentPage = 1;
        var totalPages = 1;
        
        flutterBridge.log("目录开始获取:" + tocUrl);
        
        var result = await http.Get(tocUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
        if (!result || result.statusCode !== 200) {
            flutterBridge.log("目录第一页获取失败:" + (result ? result.statusCode : "null"));
            return "[]";
        }
        
        flutterBridge.log("目录第一页获取成功，数据长度:" + result.data.length);
        
        try {
            var html = parseHTMLSafely(result.data);
            
            let scriptText = result.data;
            let pageMatch = scriptText.match(/i\s*<=\s*(\d+)/);
            if (pageMatch) {
                totalPages = parseInt(pageMatch[1]);
                flutterBridge.log("检测到总页数:" + totalPages);
            } else {
                flutterBridge.log("未检测到总页数，使用默认值1");
            }
            
            let firstPageCount = 0;
            html.find(".BGsectionThree-content li a").each(function() {
                let chapter = {};
                chapter.name = $(this).text().trim();
                chapter.chapterId = baseurl + $(this).attr("href");
                chapters.push(chapter);
                firstPageCount++;
            });
            
            flutterBridge.log("第一页章节数:" + firstPageCount);
            removeHTMLSafely(html);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("目录第一页解析错误:" + e.message);
        }
        
        currentPage = 2;
        flutterBridge.log("开始获取第2页到第" + totalPages + "页");
        
        while (currentPage <= totalPages) {
            var pageUrl = tocUrl.replace("/ml.html", "/ml_" + currentPage + ".html");
            flutterBridge.log("获取第" + currentPage + "页:" + pageUrl);

            var result = await http.Get(pageUrl, JSON.stringify(header), true);
            if (!result || result.statusCode !== 200) {
                flutterBridge.log("第" + currentPage + "页获取失败:" + (result ? result.statusCode : "null"));
                break;
            }
            
            flutterBridge.log("第" + currentPage + "页获取成功");
            
            try {
                var html = parseHTMLSafely(result.data);
                
                let pageCount = 0;
                html.find(".BGsectionThree-content li a").each(function() {
                    let chapter = {};
                    chapter.name = $(this).text().trim();
                    chapter.chapterId = baseurl + $(this).attr("href");
                    chapters.push(chapter);
                    pageCount++;
                });
                
                flutterBridge.log("第" + currentPage + "页章节数:" + pageCount);
                removeHTMLSafely(html);
            } catch (e) {
                flutterBridge.log("第" + currentPage + "页解析错误:" + e.message);
                break;
            }
            
            currentPage++;
        }
        
        flutterBridge.log("目录获取完成，总章节数:" + chapters.length);
        
        for (let i = 0; i < chapters.length; i++) {
            chapters[i].index = i;
        }
        
        return JSON.stringify(chapters);
    }

    // 如果https一直被盾拦截 ，可以使用https2协议
    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        /*
         * 检查速率限制
         * 实现方法：
         * 1. 获取当前时间戳
         * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
         * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
         * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
         * 5. 递归检查速率限制
         * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
         */
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        /*
         * 通用返回字段
         * method post get 或者 head
         * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
         * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
         * statusCode 状态码
         * statusMessage
         * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容
         */
        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {

                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {

            }
        }


        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();

                return  null;
            }
        }

    // 如果https一直被盾拦截 ，可以使用https2协议
    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        /*
         * 检查速率限制
         * 实现方法：
         * 1. 获取当前时间戳
         * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
         * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
         * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
         * 5. 递归检查速率限制
         * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
         */
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        /*
         * 通用返回字段
         * method post get 或者 head
         * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
         * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
         * statusCode 状态码
         * statusMessage
         * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容
         */
        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }


        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {
            this.open = false;
            this.requestTimestamps = [];
            this.rateLimit = 5;
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000;
        }

        async checkRateLimit() {
            if (!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url, headers, followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "get", url, "", JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, "");
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url, headers, followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "head", url, "", JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, "");
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url, headers, body, contenttype, followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "post", url, body, JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, contenttype);

  class Http {
    constructor() {
      /*
       * 速率限制配置
       * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
       * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
       * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
       */
      this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
      this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
      this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
      this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
    }

    /*
     * 检查速率限制
     * 实现方法：
     * 1. 获取当前时间戳
     * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
     * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
     * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
     * 5. 递归检查速率限制
     * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
     */
    async checkRateLimit() {
      if(!this.open) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
      this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
      // 检查是否超过速率限制
      if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
        // 计算需要等待的时间
        const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
        const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
        // 等待到速率限制可用
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
        // 递归检查速率限制
        return this.checkRateLimit();
      }
      // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
      this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
    }


    /*
     * 通用返回字段
     * method post get 或者 head
     * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
     * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
     * statusCode 状态码
     * statusMessage 
     * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容 
     */
    async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return  null;
      }
    }

    async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return  null;
      }
    }

    
    async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
      } catch (error) {
        return  null;
      }
    }
  }

  class Http {
    constructor() {
      /*
       * 速率限制配置
       * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
       * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
       * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
       */
      this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
      this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
      this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
      this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
    }

    /*
     * 检查速率限制
     * 实现方法：
     * 1. 获取当前时间戳
     * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
     * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
     * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
     * 5. 递归检查速率限制
     * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
     */
    async checkRateLimit() {
      if(!this.open) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
      this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
      // 检查是否超过速率限制
      if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
        // 计算需要等待的时间
        const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
        const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
        // 等待到速率限制可用
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
        // 递归检查速率限制
        return this.checkRateLimit();
      }
      // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
      this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
    }


    /*
     * 通用返回字段
     * method post get 或者 head
     * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
     * headers map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
     * statusCode 状态码
     * statusMessage
     * data 返回后的字节格式化后的内容
     */
    async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    
    async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

     */
    async function chapter(tocUrl) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var chapterListUrl = tocUrl;

        var htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(chapterListUrl, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(mheader));

        flutterBridge.text(2, htmlContent);

        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(htmlContent);

        var $chapterContainer = null;
        
        // 先尝试找到完整的章节目录容器，避免包含最新章节
        var markers = ["章节目录", "目录"];
        var $markerContainer = findContainerByMarker($tempContainer, markers, 5);
        if ($markerContainer) {

        if (!$chapterContainer) {

                return /^\/\d+\/\d+$/.test(href);
            };
            
            var minMatchCount = 10; // 增加最小匹配数量，确保找到完整的章节列表
            $chapterContainer = findBestContainer($tempContainer, linkMatcher, minMatchCount);
        }
        
        if (!$chapterContainer) {

            flutterBridge.log("警告：未找到专门的章节列表容器，使用全页搜索");
        } else {
            flutterBridge.log("找到章节列表容器");
        }

        var chapterIndex = 0;
        var chapterLinks = [];
        
        // 先收集所有章节链接
        $chapterContainer.find("a").each(function() {
            try{
                var $element = $(this);
                var chapterUrl = $element.attr('href');
                var chapterName = $element.text().trim();

                if(!chapterUrl || !chapterName || chapterName.length < 2){
                    return true;
                }

                if(processedUrls.has(chapterUrl)){
                    return true;
                }

                var isChapterLink = /^\/\d+\/\d+$/.test(chapterUrl);
                
                if (!isChapterLink) {
                    return true;
                }

                var isChapterName = chapterName.indexOf("章") !== -1 || 
                                    chapterName.indexOf("节") !== -1 ||
                                    chapterName.indexOf("第") !== -1 ||
                                    /^\d+/.test(chapterName);
                
                if (!isChapterName) {
                    return true;
                }

                processedUrls.add(chapterUrl);
                
                var dateIndex = chapterName.lastIndexOf("202");
                if (dateIndex > 0) {
                    chapterName = chapterName.substring(0, dateIndex).trim();
                }

                chapterUrl = normalizeUrl(chapterUrl);

                chapterLinks.push({
                    "name": chapterName,
                    "chapterId": chapterUrl,
                    "url": chapterUrl

        });
        
        // 过滤掉可能的最新章节（通常在页面顶部，数量较少）
        // 只保留完整的章节列表
        if (chapterLinks.length > 20) {
            // 如果链接数量很多，说明是完整的章节列表
            chapters = chapterLinks;
        } else {
            // 否则可能是最新章节，需要重新查找
            flutterBridge.log("章节数量过少，可能只获取到了最新章节");
            chapters = chapterLinks;
        }
        
        // 按章节URL中的数字排序，确保顺序正确
        chapters.sort(function(a, b) {
            var numA = parseInt(a.url.match(/\/\d+\/(\d+)/)[1]);
            var numB = parseInt(b.url.match(/\/\d+\/(\d+)/)[1]);
            return numA - numB;
        });
        
        // 设置正确的索引
        for (var i = 0; i < chapters.length; i++) {

        var contenttxt = "";

        var possibleContentSelectors = [
            ".article", "#content", ".content", "#chapterContent", ".novel-content", 
            "#novelcontent", ".read-content", ".article-content"
        ];
        
        var $contentContainer = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < possibleContentSelectors.length && !$contentContainer; i++) {
            var $found = $tempContainer.find(possibleContentSelectors[i]);
            if ($found.length > 0) {
                var textLength = $found.text().trim().length;
                if (textLength > 100) {
                    $contentContainer = $found;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (!$contentContainer) {
            var maxTextLength = 0;
            $tempContainer.find("div, article").each(function() {
                var $div = $(this);
                var textLength = $div.text().trim().length;
                var pCount = $div.find("p").length;
                
                var score = textLength + pCount * 100;
                
                if (score > maxTextLength && textLength > 200) {
                    maxTextLength = score;
                    $contentContainer = $div;
                }
            });
        }

        if ($contentContainer) {
            $contentContainer.find("p").each(function() {
                var pText = $(this).text().trim();
                if (pText) {
                    var isAd = pText.indexOf("广告") !== -1 || 
                              pText.indexOf("APP") !== -1 ||
                              pText.indexOf("最新网址") !== -1 ||
                              pText.indexOf("笔趣阁") !== -1;
                    if (!isAd) {
                        contenttxt += pText + "\r\n\r\n";
                    }
                }
            });
            
            if (!contenttxt) {
                contenttxt = $contentContainer.text().trim();
                contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/(?<=[。！？!?])\s*/g, "\r\n\r\n");
            }
        }

        if (!contenttxt || contenttxt.length < 50) {
            contenttxt = $tempContainer.text().trim();
        }

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

        if(!contenttxt || contenttxt.length < 50){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取内容失败");
            return "";
        }

        return contenttxt.trim();

  //以下提交的url，headers,body 都必须为字符串,headers必须为json字符串
  //当followRedirects 为 false 时不处理重定向，当为 true 时会自动处理重定向 ，如不明白用途直接用 true 最佳

  // 如果需要使用http2协议请在url前添加 http2:// ，例如 http2://baidu.com
  // 如果https一直被盾拦截 ，可以使用https2协议
  class Http {
    constructor() {
      /*
       * 速率限制配置
       * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
       * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
       * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
       */
      this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
      this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
      this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
      this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
    }

    /*
     * 检查速率限制
     * 实现方法：
     * 1. 获取当前时间戳
     * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
     * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
     * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
     * 5. 递归检查速率限制
     * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
     */
    async checkRateLimit() {
      if(!this.open) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
      this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
      // 检查是否超过速率限制
      if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
        // 计算需要等待的时间
        const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
        const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
        // 等待到速率限制可用
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
        // 递归检查速率限制
        return this.checkRateLimit();
      }
      // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
      this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
    }


    /*
     * 通用返回字段
     * method post get 或者 head
     * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
     * headers map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
     * statusCode 状态码
     * statusMessage
     * data 返回后的字节格式化后的内容
     */
    async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    
    async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  class Http {
    constructor() {
      this.open = false;

      this.rateLimitWindow = 1000;
    }

    async checkRateLimit() {
      if(!this.open) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
      if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
        const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
        const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
        return this.checkRateLimit();
      }
      this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
    }

        var searchUrl = baseurl + "/sscc/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(key);

        flutterBridge.log("搜索URL: " + searchUrl);

        // 使用webview打开搜索页面（可能需要用户手动输入验证码）
        var htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(searchUrl, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(header));

        // 检测是否有验证码
        if(!htmlContent || hasCaptchaChallenge(htmlContent)){
            flutterBridge.showToast("搜索需要验证码，请在浏览器中完成");
            var s = await flutterBridge.startBrowser(searchUrl, "搜索验证", JSON.stringify(header));
            if(s){
                htmlContent = s;
            }
        }

        if(!htmlContent){
            flutterBridge.showToast("搜索请求失败");
            return "[]";
        }

        flutterBridge.text(0, htmlContent);

        var books = [];
        var processedUrls = new Set();
        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 智能定位搜索结果容器
        var linkMatcher = function(href) {
            if (!href) return false;
            // 天天书屋书籍链接格式: /tiku/数字/
            return /\/tiku\/\d+/.test(href);
        };
        
        var $resultContainer = findBestContainer($tempContainer, linkMatcher, 1);

        if (!$resultContainer) {
            $resultContainer = $tempContainer;
        }

        // 提取书籍信息
        $resultContainer.find("a").each(function() {
            try{
                var bookUrl = $(this).attr('href');
                
                if (!bookUrl || processedUrls.has(bookUrl)) { return true; }
                if (!linkMatcher(bookUrl)) { return true; }
                
                processedUrls.add(bookUrl);
                
                var fullText = $(this).text().trim();
                var bookName = fullText;
                var author = "";
                
                // 提取作者（如果有）
                var authorMatch = fullText.match(/作者[：:\s]*(.+)$/);
                if(authorMatch) {
                    author = authorMatch[1].trim();
                    bookName = fullText.substring(0, fullText.indexOf('作者')).trim();
                }
                
                if(bookName && bookName.length > 1){
                    bookUrl = normalizeUrl(bookUrl);

                    var book={
                        "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                        "name": bookName,
                        "author": author,
                        "kind": "",
                        "coverUrl": "",
                        "intro": "",
                        "tocUrl": bookUrl,
                        "wordCount": "",
                        "type": 0,
                        "latestChapterTitle": ""
                    };
                    books.push(book);
                }
            }catch(e){
                flutterBridge.log("解析书籍信息出错: " + e.message);
            }
        });

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        flutterBridge.log("找到 " + books.length + " 本书");

    /*
     * info(bookurl) - 书籍详情
     */
    async function info(bookurl) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(bookurl, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(mheader));

        if(!htmlContent){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取信息失败");
            return JSON.stringify({});
        }

        flutterBridge.text(1, htmlContent);

        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 从h1提取标题
        var h1Text = $tempContainer.find("h1").first().text().trim();
        
        var name = "";
        var author = "";
        var kind = "";
        var intro = "";
        var latestChapterTitle = "";

        if(h1Text) {
            name = h1Text;
        }

        // 提取作者、分类、状态等信息
        $tempContainer.find("*").each(function() {
            var text = $(this).text().trim();
            
            // 作者
            if(text.indexOf("作者") !== -1 && !author && text.length < 50) {
                var match = text.match(/作者[：:\s]*(.+?)(?:\s|$)/);
                if(match) { author = match[1].trim(); }
            }
            
            // 分类和状态
            if(text.indexOf("类别") !== -1 && text.indexOf("状态") !== -1 && !kind && text.length < 100) {
                var kindMatch = text.match(/类别[：:\s]*([^\s状态]+)\s*状态[：:\s]*(.+)/);
                if(kindMatch) { kind = kindMatch[1].trim(); }
            }
            
            // 最新章节
            if(text.indexOf("最新章节") !== -1 && !latestChapterTitle && text.length < 100) {
                var chapterMatch = text.match(/最新章节[：:\s]*(.+)/);
                if(chapterMatch) { latestChapterTitle = chapterMatch[1].trim(); }
            }
        });

        // 提取简介
        $tempContainer.find("*").each(function() {
            if(intro) return false;
            
            var text = $(this).text().trim();
            
            // 查找包含"简介"的元素
            if((text.indexOf("简介") !== -1 || text.indexOf("介绍") !== -1) && text.length > 20 && text.length < 2000) {
                var idx = text.indexOf("简介");
                if(idx === -1) idx = text.indexOf("介绍");
                
                if(idx !== -1) {
                    var potentialIntro = text.substring(idx + 2).replace(/[：:]\s*/, "").trim();
                    if(potentialIntro.length > 10 && potentialIntro.length < 1500) {
                        intro = potentialIntro;
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        var coverUrl = $tempContainer.find("img[src*='tikuimg']").first().attr('src') || "";

        var book={
            "bookUrl": bookurl,
            "name": name,
            "author": author,
            "kind": kind,
            "coverUrl": normalizeUrl(coverUrl),
            "intro": intro,
            "tocUrl": bookurl,
            "wordCount": "",
            "type": 0,
            "latestChapterTitle": latestChapterTitle
        };

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        return JSON.stringify(book);
    }

    /*
     * chapter(tocUrl) - 章节列表
     * 从书籍详情页提取所有章节链接
     * 页面结构：<dl>内有2个<dt>标题："最新章节"+"正文目录"，只需提取"正文目录"后的<dd>
     */
    async function chapter(tocUrl) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(tocUrl, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(mheader));

        if(!htmlContent){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取目录失败");
            return "[]";
        }

        flutterBridge.text(2, htmlContent);

        var chapters = [];
        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 天天书屋章节链接格式: /ikus/{书籍ID}/{章节ID}.html
        var chapterLinkMatcher = function(href) {
            if (!href) return false;
            return /\/ikus\/\d+\/\d+\.html/.test(href);
        };

        // 核心策略：找到"正文目录"的<dt>标题，只提取其后的所有<dd>
        var $catalogDt = null;
        $tempContainer.find("dt").each(function() {
            var text = $(this).text();
            if (text.indexOf("正文目录") !== -1) {
                $catalogDt = $(this);
                return false; // 找到后停止遍历
            }
        });

        if ($catalogDt) {
            flutterBridge.log("找到'正文目录'标题");

            // 遍历该<dt>之后的所有兄弟元素（<dd>）
            // 注意：这里的DD元素100%都是章节链接，不需要再用正则过滤！
            var $nextSibling = $catalogDt.next();
            while ($nextSibling.length > 0) {
                // 检查是否是<dd>标签
                if (!$nextSibling.is("dd")) {
                    break; // 遇到非<dd>元素就停止
                }

                try{
                    var $link = $nextSibling.find("a").first();
                    if ($link.length === 0) {
                        $nextSibling = $nextSibling.next();
                        continue;
                    }

                    var chapterUrl = $link.attr('href');
                    var chapterName = $link.text().trim();

                    // 基本验证：URL和名称不能为空
                    if(!chapterUrl || !chapterName || chapterName.length < 2){
                        $nextSibling = $nextSibling.next();
                        continue;
                    }

                    // 标准化URL
                    chapterUrl = normalizeUrl(chapterUrl);

                    chapters.push({
                        "name": chapterName,
                        "chapterId": chapterUrl,
                        "index": chapters.length,
                        "isPay": false,
                        "isVip": false,
                        "isVolume": false,
                        "tag": ""
                    });
                }catch(e){
                    flutterBridge.log("解析章节出错: " + e.message);
                }

                $nextSibling = $nextSibling.next();
            }

            flutterBridge.log("从'正文目录'提取了 " + chapters.length + " 个章节");
        } else {
            // 兜底方案：如果没找到"正文目录"标题，使用URL去重模式
            flutterBridge.log("未找到'正文目录'标题，使用去重模式");

            var processedUrls = new Set();

            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function(index) {
                try{
                    var $element = $(this);
                    var chapterUrl = $element.attr('href');
                    var chapterName = $element.text().trim();

                    if(!chapterUrl || !chapterName || chapterName.length < 2){
                        return true;
                    }

                    if(!chapterLinkMatcher(chapterUrl)){
                        return true;
                    }

                    var normalizedUrl = normalizeUrl(chapterUrl);

                    if(processedUrls.has(normalizedUrl)){
                        return true;
                    }

                    processedUrls.add(normalizedUrl);

                    chapters.push({
                        "name": chapterName,
                        "chapterId": normalizedUrl,
                        "index": chapters.length,
                        "isPay": false,
                        "isVip": false,
                        "isVolume": false,
                        "tag": ""
                    });
                }catch(e){
                    flutterBridge.log("解析章节出错: " + e.message);
                }
            });

            flutterBridge.log("去重模式下找到 " + chapters.length + " 个章节");
        }

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        flutterBridge.log("总共返回 " + chapters.length + " 个章节");
        return JSON.stringify(chapters);
    }

    /*
     * content(url) - 章节内容
     * 天天书屋章节页面可能有验证码保护，且正文可能分多页
     */
    async function content(url) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        // 获取第一页内容
        var htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(url, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(mheader));

        // 检查是否有验证码
        if(!htmlContent || hasCaptchaChallenge(htmlContent)){
            flutterBridge.showToast("章节需要验证，请在浏览器中完成");
            var s = await flutterBridge.startBrowser(url, "章节验证", JSON.stringify(mheader));
            if(s){
                htmlContent = s;
            }
        }

        if(!htmlContent){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取内容失败");
            return "";
        }

        flutterBridge.text(3, htmlContent);

        var allContent = [];  // 存储所有页面内容
        var currentUrl = url; // 当前页面URL
        var maxPages = 50;    // 最大页数限制，防止死循环
        var pageCount = 0;

        while (currentUrl && pageCount < maxPages) {
            pageCount++;

            // 解析当前页面
            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

            // 从 #content 获取正文
            var $contentElement = $tempContainer.find("#content").first();
            if($contentElement.length > 0) {
                var pageText =await  flutterBridge.htmlToText($contentElement.html());
                allContent.push(pageText);
                flutterBridge.log("获取第 " + pageCount + " 页，长度: " + pageText.length);
            }

            // 查找下一页链接（常见选择器）
            var nextPageUrl = null;

            // 方法1: 查找包含"下一页"文本的链接
            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function() {
                var text = $(this).text().trim();
                if ((text === "下一页" || text === "下页" || text === "下一章 ›") && !nextPageUrl) {
                    nextPageUrl = $(this).attr('href');
                }
            });

            // 方法2: 如果没找到，查找分页导航中的下一个数字链接
            if (!nextPageUrl) {
                // 查找当前激活的页码，然后找下一个
                var $currentPage = $tempContainer.find(".active, .current, .selected, [class*='page'][class*='active']").first();
                if ($currentPage.length > 0) {
                    var $nextPageLink = $currentPage.next("a");
                    if ($nextPageLink.length > 0) {
                        nextPageUrl = $nextPageLink.attr('href');
                    }
                }
            }

            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

            // 如果没有下一页链接，结束循环
            if (!nextPageUrl) {
                flutterBridge.log("没有更多页面，共 " + pageCount + " 页");
                break;
            }

            // 智能构建完整URL（处理相对路径）
            if (nextPageUrl.startsWith('http')) {
                currentUrl = nextPageUrl;  // 已经是完整URL
            } else if (nextPageUrl.startsWith('/')) {
                // 相对于域名的路径，需要保留书籍路径
                // 从currentUrl提取基础路径（如 /ikus/32515635305/）
                var pathParts = currentUrl.split('/');
                // 保留协议+域名+前3级路径（如 https://www.tiku365.net/tikus/32515635305）
                var basePath = pathParts.slice(0, 5).join('/');
                currentUrl = basePath + nextPageUrl;
            } else {
                // 相对路径，基于当前页面所在目录
                var lastSlashIndex = currentUrl.lastIndexOf('/');
                currentUrl = currentUrl.substring(0, lastSlashIndex + 1) + nextPageUrl;
            }

            // 避免重复访问同一URL（防止循环）
            if (currentUrl === url && pageCount > 1) {
                flutterBridge.log("检测到重复URL，停止翻页");
                break;
            }

            flutterBridge.log("正在获取第 " + (pageCount + 1) + " 页: " + currentUrl);
            htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(currentUrl, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(mheader));

            if (!htmlContent) {
                flutterBridge.log("获取第 " + (pageCount + 1) + " 页失败");
                break;
            }
        }

        // 合并所有页面内容
        var contenttxt = allContent.join("\n\n");

        // 清理内容
        contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/天天书屋.*?www\.tiku365\.net[\s\S]*/g, "");
        contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/看啥都有.*$/g, "");
        contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n");
        contenttxt = contenttxt.trim();

        // 限制最大长度
        if(contenttxt.length > 50000) {
            contenttxt = contenttxt.substring(0, 50000);
        }

        if(!contenttxt || contenttxt.length < 30){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取内容失败");
            return "";
        }

        return contenttxt;
    }

  class Http {
    constructor() {
      this.open = false;
      this.requestTimestamps = [];
      this.rateLimit = 5;
      this.rateLimitWindow = 1000;
    }

    async checkRateLimit() {
      if(!this.open) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
      if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
        const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
        const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
        return this.checkRateLimit();
      }
      this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
    }

    async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    
    async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
      try {
        await this.checkRateLimit();
        return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {

    // 智能容器定位工具函数
    function findBestContainer($htmlContainer, linkMatcher, minMatchCount) {
        var $bestContainer = null;
        var maxMatchCount = 0;
        var checkedParents = new Set();
        
        $htmlContainer.find("a").each(function() {
            var href = $(this).attr('href');
            
            if (!linkMatcher(href)) {
                return true;
            }
            
            var $parent = $(this).parent();
            var depth = 0;
            
            while ($parent.length > 0 && depth < 10) {
                var parentKey = $parent[0].outerHTML.substring(0, Math.min(500, $parent[0].outerHTML.length));
                
                if (!checkedParents.has(parentKey)) {
                    checkedParents.add(parentKey);
                    
                    var count = $parent.find("a").filter(function() {
                        return linkMatcher($(this).attr('href'));
                    }).length;
                    
                    if (count > maxMatchCount && count >= minMatchCount) {
                        maxMatchCount = count;
                        $bestContainer = $parent;
                    }
                }
                
                $parent = $parent.parent();
                depth++;
            }
        });
        
        return $bestContainer;
    }

    function normalizeUrl(url) {

    /*

     */
    async function search(key, page) {

        // 使用 http.Post 发送搜索请求 (302重定向到结果页)

        var postHeader = {
            "Connection": "keep-alive",
            "sec-ch-ua": '"Chromium";v="147", "Not:A-Brand";v="8", "Google Chrome";v="147"',
            "sec-ch-ua-mobile": "?0",

            "Sec-Fetch-Site": "same-origin",

            "Referer": baseurl,

        var get = await http.Post(searchUrl, postHeader, body, "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", true);

        if(!htmlContent){

        flutterBridge.text(0, htmlContent);

        var books = [];

        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 智能定位搜索结果容器 (article-list)
        var linkMatcher = function(href) {
            if (!href) return false;
            // 福书网的书籍链接格式: /book/数字.html
            return /\/book\/\d+\.html/.test(href);

        var $resultContainer = findBestContainer($tempContainer, linkMatcher, 1);

        // 提取书籍信息

                // 解析书名、作者

                // 提取作者（——后面）

                if(authorMatch) {
                    author = authorMatch[1].trim();
                    bookName = fullText.substring(0, fullText.indexOf('——')).trim();
                }
                
                if(bookName && bookName.length > 1){
                    bookUrl = normalizeUrl(bookUrl);

                    var book={
                        "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                        "name": bookName,
                        "author": author,
                        "kind": kind,
                        "coverUrl": "",
                        "intro": "",
                        "tocUrl": bookUrl,

                    };

                flutterBridge.log("解析书籍信息出错: " + e.message);

    /*
     * info(bookurl) - 书籍详情
     * 访问书籍页面提取基本信息
     */
    async function info(bookurl) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(bookurl, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(mheader));

        if(!htmlContent){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取信息失败");
            return JSON.stringify({});
        }

        flutterBridge.text(1, htmlContent);

        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 从h1提取标题，格式: 书名（分类）——作者
        var h1Text = $tempContainer.find("h1").first().text().trim();
        
        var name = "";
        var author = "";
        var kind = "";
        var intro = "";
        var latestChapterTitle = "";

        // 解析h1文本
        if(h1Text) {
            name = h1Text;
            
            // 提取分类
            var categoryMatch = h1Text.match(/（([^）]+)）/);
            if(categoryMatch) {
                kind = categoryMatch[1];
                name = h1Text.substring(0, h1Text.indexOf('（')).trim();
            }
            
            // 提取作者
            var authorMatch = h1Text.match(/——(.+)$/);
            if(authorMatch) {
                author = authorMatch[1].trim();
            }
        }

        // 尝试从其他位置找作者
        if(!author) {
            $tempContainer.find("*").each(function() {
                var text = $(this).text().trim();
                if(text.indexOf("作者") !== -1 && !author) {
                    var match = text.match(/作者[：:\s]*(.+?)(?:$|[\r\n])/);
                    if(match) {
                        author = match[1].trim();
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // 提取简介（查找"文案："后面的内容，限制长度）
        var foundIntro = false;
        $tempContainer.find("*").each(function() {
            if(foundIntro) return false;
            
            var $elem = $(this);
            var text = $elem.text().trim();
            
            // 查找包含"文案"的元素
            if(text.indexOf("文案") !== -1 && text.indexOf("文案") < 100) {
                var idx = text.indexOf("文案");
                var potentialIntro = text.substring(idx + 2).replace(/[：:]\s*/, "").trim();
                
                // 简介应该在200字以内
                if(potentialIntro.length > 10 && potentialIntro.length < 500) {
                    intro = potentialIntro;
                    foundIntro = true;
                    return false;
                }
                
                // 如果太长，可能是包含了正文，截取前面部分
                if(potentialIntro.length >= 500) {
                    // 找到第一个句号或换行处截断
                    var cutIdx = potentialIntro.indexOf('。');
                    if(cutIdx > 20 && cutIdx < 300) {
                        intro = potentialIntro.substring(0, cutIdx + 1).trim();
                        foundIntro = true;
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        
        // 如果还没找到，尝试从特定位置提取（h1后面第一个大段文本）
        if(!intro && !foundIntro) {
            var h1Elem = $tempContainer.find("h1").first();
            if(h1Elem.length > 0) {
                // 获取h1后面的兄弟元素或父元素的下一个子元素
                var nextElements = h1Elem.parent().find("p, div").slice(0, 5);
                nextElements.each(function() {
                    if(intro) return false;
                    
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();
                    // 排除导航、按钮等
                    if(text.length > 30 && text.length < 500 &&
                       text.indexOf("首页") === -1 &&
                       text.indexOf("返回") === -1 &&
                       text.indexOf("加入收藏") === -1 &&
                       text.indexOf("来顶一下") === -1) {
                        intro = text;
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // 提取最新章节（从下拉菜单或分页信息）
        var pageInfo = $tempContainer.text();
        var pageMatch = pageInfo.match(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)/);
        if(pageMatch) {
            latestChapterTitle = "第" + pageMatch[2] + "章";
        }

        var book={
            "bookUrl": bookurl,
            "name": name,
            "author": author,
            "kind": kind,
            "coverUrl": "",
            "intro": intro,
            "tocUrl": bookurl,
            "wordCount": "",
            "type": 0,
            "latestChapterTitle": latestChapterTitle
        };

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        return JSON.stringify(book);
    }

    /*
     * chapter(tocUrl) - 章节列表
     * 从下拉菜单或分页链接中提取章节

    async function chapter(tocUrl) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var htmlContent = await flutterBridge.webview(tocUrl, "", "", "", JSON.stringify(mheader));

        if(!htmlContent){

        var chapters = [];
        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        var pageInfo = $tempContainer.text();

        var contenttxt = "";

        // 查找正文内容区域
        // 福书网页面结构：正文在 <main> 或 <td class="main"> 容器内
        
        // 方法1: 直接定位 main 容器
        var $mainContainer = $tempContainer.find(".main").first();
        
        if($mainContainer.length > 0) {
            // 从 main 中提取文本
            var mainText = $mainContainer.text().trim();
            
            if(mainText) {
                contenttxt = mainText;

                contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/www\.fushucun\.com.*$/s, "");
                
                // 移除元数据标签行
                contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/^(作品来源|作者|时间|文案)[^\n]*\n?/gm, "");
                contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/^.*(主角|配角|其它|一句话简介|立意)[：:][^\n]*$/gm, "");
                
                // 移除多余的空白行
                contenttxt = contenttxt.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n");
                contenttxt = contenttxt.trim();
                
                // 限制最大长度
                if(contenttxt.length > 20000) {
                    contenttxt = contenttxt.substring(0, 20000);
                }
            }
        }

        // 兜底方案
        if(!contenttxt || contenttxt.length < 50){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取内容失败");

        }

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

        if(!contenttxt || contenttxt.length < 50){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取内容失败");
            return "";
        }

        return contenttxt;

  class Http {
    constructor() {
      this.open = false;
      this.requestTimestamps = [];
      this.rateLimit = 5;
      this.rateLimitWindow = 1000;
    }

    async checkRateLimit() {
      if(!this.open) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
      if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
        const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
        const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
        return this.checkRateLimit();
      }
      this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
    }

    async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
      try { await this.checkRateLimit(); return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,""); } catch (error) { return null; }
    }

    async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {

  }

    result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
    return result;

        "Referer": baseurl,
        "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8"
    };

    function normalizeUrl(url) {
        if (!url) return "";
        if (url.startsWith('http')) return url;
        if (url.startsWith('/')) return baseurl + url;
        return baseurl + '/' + url;
    }

    /*
     * search(key, page) - 搜索功能
     * 神书网搜索URL: /soso67fb4.html?searchkey={URL编码关键词}
     */
    async function search(key, page) {
        if(page > 1){
            return "[]";
        }

        // 获取首页HTML，从中提取搜索表单的action地址
        var homeResult = await flutterBridge.webview(baseurl + "/", "", "", "",header);
        
        if(!homeResult ){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取首页失败");
            return "[]";
        }
        
        var homeHtml = homeResult;
         flutterBridge.text(0, homeHtml);
        // 从HTML中提取搜索表单的action属性
        // 表单格式: <form ... action="/soso67fb4.html?method=get">
        var formActionMatch = homeHtml.match(/<form[^>]*action=["']([^"']*soso[^"']*)["'][^>]*>/i);
        
        if(!formActionMatch){
            flutterBridge.log("未能在首页找到搜索表单action");
            return "[]";
        }
        
        var formAction = formActionMatch[1];
        var encodedKey = encodeURIComponent(key);
        
        // 构建完整搜索URL（注意：action可能已包含参数，需要正确拼接）
        var realSearchUrl = "";
        if(formAction.indexOf('?') !== -1){
            realSearchUrl = baseurl + formAction + "&searchkey=" + encodedKey;
        } else {
            realSearchUrl = baseurl + formAction + "?searchkey=" + encodedKey;
        }

        flutterBridge.log("真实搜索URL: " + realSearchUrl);
        await cookie.remove(baseurl);
        
        // 使用webview加载（因为可能有JS重定向）
        var htmlContent =  await  flutterBridge.webview(realSearchUrl, "", "", "",header);

        if(!htmlContent){
            flutterBridge.showToast("搜索请求失败");
            return "[]";
        }

        flutterBridge.text(0, htmlContent);

        var books = [];
        var processedUrls = new Set();
        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 神书网书籍链接格式: /{分类ID}_{书籍ID}/
        // 示例: /222_222264/ 或 /201_201175/
        var bookLinkMatcher = function(href) {
            if (!href) return false;
            return /^\/\d+_\d+\/$/.test(href);
        };

        // 基于真实HTML结构提取搜索结果
        // 结构: div.item > div.image > a[href] (书籍链接)
        //       + dl > dt > a (书名) + dd (简介) + div.btm > a[author] + em(字数/时间)
        
        // 方法1: 优先查找 .item 容器
        $tempContainer.find(".item").each(function() {
            try{
                var $item = $(this);
                
                // 从 image 区域获取书籍URL
                var bookUrl = $item.find(".image a").first().attr('href');
                
                if (!bookUrl || !bookLinkMatcher(bookUrl) || processedUrls.has(bookUrl)) { 
                    return true; 
                }
                
                processedUrls.add(bookUrl);
                
                // 书名（优先从dt标签获取）
                var bookName = $item.find("dt a").first().text().trim();
                if(!bookName) {
                    bookName = $item.find(".image a").first().attr('title') || "";
                }
                
                // 作者（/author/xxx/ 格式的链接）
                var author = "";
                $item.find("a[href*='/author/']").each(function(){
                    if(!author) {
                        author = $(this).text().trim();
                    }
                });
                
                // 简介（dd标签内容）
                var intro = $item.find("dd").first().text().trim();
                if(intro && intro.length > 200) {
                    intro = intro.substring(0, 200);  // 限制长度
                }
                
                // 字数（em标签）
                var wordCount = "";
                $item.find("em.orange, em[class*='orange']").each(function(){
                    if(!wordCount) wordCount = $(this).text().trim();
                });
                
                if(bookName && bookName.length > 1){
                    bookUrl = normalizeUrl(bookUrl);

                    var book={
                        "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                        "name": bookName,
                        "author": author,
                        "kind": "",
                        "coverUrl": "",
                        "intro": intro,
                        "tocUrl": bookUrl,
                        "wordCount": wordCount,
                        "type": 0,
                        "latestChapterTitle": ""
                    };
                    books.push(book);
                }
            }catch(e){
                flutterBridge.log("解析.item出错: " + e.message);
            }
        });

        // 方法2: 如果没找到.item容器，使用通用匹配作为备选
        if(books.length === 0) {
            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function() {
                try{
                    var bookUrl = $(this).attr('href');
                    
                    if (!bookUrl || processedUrls.has(bookUrl)) { return true; }
                    if (!bookLinkMatcher(bookUrl)) { return true; }
                    
                    processedUrls.add(bookUrl);
                    
                    var bookName = $(this).attr('title') || $(this).text().trim();

                    if(bookName && bookName.length > 1){
                        bookUrl = normalizeUrl(bookUrl);

                        var book={
                            "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                            "name": bookName,
                            "author": "",
                            "kind": "",
                            "coverUrl": "",
                            "intro": "",
                            "tocUrl": bookUrl,
                            "wordCount": "",
                            "type": 0,
                            "latestChapterTitle": ""
                        };
                        books.push(book);
                    }
                }catch(e){
                    flutterBridge.log("解析书籍信息出错: " + e.message);
                }
            });
        }

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        flutterBridge.log("找到 " + books.length + " 本书");
        return JSON.stringify(books);
    }

    /*
     * info(bookurl) - 书籍详情
     * URL格式: http://www.shenpinwu.co/{cat}_{book_id}/
     */
    async function info(bookurl) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var htmlResult = await http.Get(bookurl, mheader, true);

        if(!htmlResult || !htmlResult.data){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取信息失败");
            return JSON.stringify({});
        }

        var htmlContent = htmlResult.data;

        flutterBridge.text(1, htmlContent);

        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 从h1提取书名
        var h1Text = $tempContainer.find("h1").first().text().trim();
        
        var name = h1Text || "";
        var author = "";
        var kind = "";
        var intro = "";
        var latestChapterTitle = "";
        var coverUrl = "";

        // 提取封面图
        coverUrl = $tempContainer.find("img").first().attr('src') || "";

        // 遍历页面元素提取详细信息
        $tempContainer.find("*").each(function() {
            var text = $(this).text().trim();

            // 作者
            if(!author && text.length < 30) {
                var authorMatch = text.match(/作者?[：:\s]*(.+?)(?:\s|$)/);
                if(authorMatch && authorMatch[1].length > 0 && authorMatch[1].length < 15) { 
                    author = authorMatch[1].trim(); 
                }
            }

            // 分类
            if(!kind && text.length < 15) {
                var categories = ['玄幻', '武侠', '都市', '历史', '科幻', '游戏', '女生', '其他'];
                for(var i=0; i<categories.length; i++) {
                    if(text.indexOf(categories[i]) !== -1) {
                        kind = categories[i];
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            // 最新章节
            if(!latestChapterTitle && text.length < 60 && name) {
                var chapterMatch = text.match(/(第\s*\d+\s*[章节篇])/);
                if(chapterMatch && text.indexOf(name) === -1) { 
                    latestChapterTitle = chapterMatch[1]; 
                }
            }
        });

        // 提取简介（查找较长的文本块）
        $tempContainer.find("p, div").each(function() {
            if(intro) return false;
            
            var text = $(this).text().trim();
            
            if(text.length > 50 && text.length < 2000 && 
               text.indexOf(name) === -1 &&
               text.indexOf('加入书架') === -1 &&
               text.indexOf('马上阅读') === -1 &&
               text.indexOf('推荐') === -1 &&
               text.indexOf('催更') === -1) {
                intro = text;
            }
        });

        var book={
            "bookUrl": bookurl,
            "name": name,
            "author": author,
            "kind": kind,
            "coverUrl": normalizeUrl(coverUrl),
            "intro": intro,
            "tocUrl": bookurl,
            "wordCount": "",
            "type": 0,
            "latestChapterTitle": latestChapterTitle
        };

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        return JSON.stringify(book);
    }

    /*
     * chapter(tocUrl) - 章节列表
     * 从书籍详情页提取所有章节链接
     * 注意：页面有2个区域：最新章节(上) + 全部章节目录(下)
     * 全部章节目录默认只显示部分章节，需点击"展开更多"才能看到全部
     */
    async function chapter(tocUrl) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        // 第1步：先用http.Get获取页面
        var htmlResult = await http.Get(tocUrl, mheader, true);

        if(!htmlResult || !htmlResult.data){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取目录失败");
            return "[]";
        }

        var htmlContent = htmlResult.data;
        
        // 第2步：检查是否需要展开全部章节（如果章节数太少）
        var $tempCheck = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));
        var initialChapterCount = 0;
        var hasExpandBtn = false;
        
        // 统计可见的章节数量
        $tempCheck.find("a").each(function() {
            var href = $(this).attr('href');
            if (href && /^\/\d+_\d+\/\d+\.html$/.test(href)) {
                initialChapterCount++;
            }
        });
        
        // 检查是否有"展开更多"按钮
        if ($tempCheck.find("*:contains('展开'), *:contains('更多'), *:contains('查看全部')").length > 0) {
            hasExpandBtn = true;
        }
        
        removeHTMLSafely($tempCheck);
        
        flutterBridge.log("初始章节数: " + initialChapterCount + ", 有展开按钮: " + hasExpandBtn);
        
        // 第3步：如果章节数少或有展开按钮，用webview加载并点击展开
        if (initialChapterCount < 50 || hasExpandBtn) {
            flutterBridge.log("使用webview展开全部章节...");
            
            var expandJs = `
                setTimeout(function(){
                    // 点击"展开更多"、"点击展开"、"查看全部"等按钮
                    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('a, div, span, button');
                    for(var i=0; i<buttons.length; i++){
                        var text = (buttons[i].textContent || '').toLowerCase();
                        if((text.indexOf('展开') !== -1 || 
                            text.indexOf('更多') !== -1 || 
                            text.indexOf('查看全部') !== -1) &&
                           text.length < 20) {
                            buttons[i].click();
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }, 500);
            `;
            
            var expandedContent = await flutterBridge.webview(
                tocUrl,
                "",
                htmlContent + "<script>" + expandJs + "<"+"/script>",
                "",
                JSON.stringify(mheader)
            );
            
            if(expandedContent && expandedContent.length > htmlContent.length) {
                htmlContent = expandedContent;
                flutterBridge.log("展开成功，新内容长度: " + htmlContent.length);
            } else {
                flutterBridge.log("展开失败或无变化，使用原始内容");
            }
        }

        };

        // 核心策略：找到"全部章节目录"的<dt>标题，只遍历其后的兄弟节点
        var $catalogDt = null;

        // 查找包含"全部章节目录"文本的<dt>元素
        $tempContainer.find("dt").each(function() {
            var text = $(this).text().trim();

            if ((text.indexOf('全部章节') !== -1 ||
                 text.indexOf('正文目录') !== -1 ||
                 text.indexOf('章节目录') !== -1) &&
                text.length < 50) {

                $catalogDt = $(this);
                flutterBridge.log("找到'全部章节目录'标题: " + text.substring(0, 50));
                return false;  // 找到后停止
            }
        });

                if ($nextSibling.is("a")) {

                        var chapterName = $nextSibling.find("dd").first().text().trim();

                        if(!chapterName){

                        if(processedUrls.has(chapterUrl)){

                            continue;

                        if(!chapterLinkMatcher(chapterUrl)){
                            $nextSibling = $nextSibling.next();
                            continue;

                        processedUrls.add(chapterUrl);

                        chapters.push({

                // 如果遇到另一个<dt>，检查是否是结束标记
                else if ($nextSibling.is("dt")) {

                    // 如果是"点击展开更多"等按钮，跳过继续
                    if (dtText.indexOf('展开') !== -1 ||

                        flutterBridge.log("跳过展开按钮: " + dtText.substring(0, 30));
                        $nextSibling = $nextSibling.next();
                        continue;

                    // 遇到其他<dt>标题，可能到了另一个区域，停止
                    flutterBridge.log("遇到其他<dt>标题，停止遍历: " + dtText.substring(0, 30));
                    break;
                }

                $nextSibling = $nextSibling.next();
            }

            flutterBridge.log("从'全部章节目录'提取了 " + chapters.length + " 个章节");
        } else {
            // 兜底方案：提取所有章节并用URL去重（按URL数字排序确保正序）
            flutterBridge.log("未找到'全部章节目录'标题，使用去重+排序模式");

            var allChapters = [];

                    if(!chapterUrl || !chapterName || chapterName.length < 2){
                        return true;

                    if(processedUrls.has(chapterUrl)){
                        return true;
                    }

                    if(!chapterLinkMatcher(chapterUrl)){
                        return true;
                    }

                    processedUrls.add(chapterUrl);
                    chapterUrl = normalizeUrl(chapterUrl);

                    // 提取章节号用于排序
                    var chapterNumMatch = chapterUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\.html$/);
                    var chapterNum = chapterNumMatch ? parseInt(chapterNumMatch[1]) : 999999;

                    allChapters.push({
                        name: chapterName,
                        chapterId: chapterUrl,
                        num: chapterNum
                    });
                }catch(e){
                    flutterBridge.log("解析章节出错: " + e.message);
                }
            });

            // 按章节号正序排列（第1章在最前）
            allChapters.sort(function(a, b) { return a.num - b.num; });

            allChapters.forEach(function(ch, idx) {
                chapters.push({
                    "name": ch.name,
                    "chapterId": ch.chapterId,
                    "index": idx,
                    "isPay": false,
                    "isVip": false,
                    "isVolume": false,
                    "tag": ""
                });
            });

            flutterBridge.log("去重+排序模式找到 " + chapters.length + " 个章节");
        }

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        flutterBridge.log("总共返回 " + chapters.length + " 个章节");
        return JSON.stringify(chapters);

    /*
     * content(url) - 章节内容
     * URL格式: /{cat}_{book_id}/{chapter_id}.html
     * 注意：正文可能分多页，需要自动获取所有页面并合并
     */
    async function content(url) {
        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var htmlResult = await http.Get(url, mheader, true);

        if(!htmlResult || !htmlResult.data){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取内容失败");
            return "";

        var htmlContent = htmlResult.data;

        flutterBridge.text(3, htmlContent);

        var allContent = [];  // 存储所有页面内容
        var currentUrl = url; // 当前页面URL
        var maxPages = 20;    // 最大页数限制
        var pageCount = 0;

        while (currentUrl && pageCount < maxPages) {
            pageCount++;

            // 解析当前页面
            var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

            // 从正文容器获取内容
            var $contentElement = $tempContainer.find(".content").first();
            if ($contentElement.length === 0) {
                var $h1 = $tempContainer.find("h1").first();
                if ($h1.length > 0) {
                    $contentElement = $h1.nextAll("p, div");
                }
                
                if ($contentElement.length === 0) {
                    var maxLength = 0;
                    $tempContainer.find("div, p").each(function() {
                        var text = $(this).text().trim();
                        if(text.length > maxLength && text.length > 200 &&
                           text.indexOf('首页') === -1 && 
                           text.indexOf('目录') === -1 &&
                           text.indexOf('下一页') === -1) {
                            maxLength = text.length;
                            $contentElement = $(this);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            if($contentElement.length > 0) {
                var pageText = $contentElement.html();
                if (pageText) {
                    allContent.push(await flutterBridge.htmlToText(pageText));
                    flutterBridge.log("获取第 " + pageCount + " 页，长度: " + pageText.length);
                }
            }

            // 查找下一页链接
            var nextPageUrl = null;
            
            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function() {
                var text = $(this).text().trim();
                var href = $(this).attr('href');
                
                if ((text === '下页' || text === '下一页' || text === '下一章(→)') && !nextPageUrl && href) {
                    nextPageUrl = href;
                }
                
                if (!nextPageUrl && href && href.indexOf('page=') !== -1) {
                    nextPageUrl = href;
                }
            });

            removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);

            if (!nextPageUrl) {
                flutterBridge.log("没有更多页面，共 " + pageCount + " 页");
                break;
            }

            // 构建完整URL并获取下一页
            if (nextPageUrl.startsWith('/')) {
                var pathParts = url.split('/');
                basePath = pathParts.slice(0, 3).join('/');
                currentUrl = basePath + nextPageUrl;
            } else if (nextPageUrl.startsWith('http')) {
                currentUrl = nextPageUrl;
            } else {
                var lastSlashIndex = url.lastIndexOf('/');
                currentUrl = url.substring(0, lastSlashIndex + 1) + nextPageUrl;
            }

            if (currentUrl === url && pageCount > 1) {
                flutterBridge.log("检测到重复URL，停止翻页");
                break;
            }

            flutterBridge.log("正在获取第 " + (pageCount + 1) + " 页: " + currentUrl);
            
            var nextResult = await http.Get(currentUrl, mheader, true);
            if(!nextResult || !nextResult.data){
                flutterBridge.log("获取第 " + (pageCount + 1) + " 页失败");
                break;

            htmlContent = nextResult.data;
        }

        var contenttxt = allContent.join("\n\n");

    /*
     * find(url, page) - 分类浏览

    async function find(url, page) {
        var u = url.replaceAll("{{page}}", page);
        if(!u.startsWith('http')){
            u = baseurl + u;
        }

        flutterBridge.log("分类URL: " + u);

        var mheader={
            ...header,
            "Referer": baseurl
        };

        var htmlResult = await http.Get(u, mheader, true);

        if(!htmlResult || !htmlResult.data){
            flutterBridge.showToast("获取分类失败");
            return "[]";
        }

        var htmlContent = htmlResult.data;

        flutterBridge.text(0, htmlContent);

        var books = [];
        var processedUrls = new Set();
        var $tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(htmlContent));

        // 神书网书籍链接格式: /{分类ID}_{书籍ID}/
        var bookLinkMatcher = function(href) {
            if (!href) return false;
            return /^\/\d+_\d+\/$/.test(href);
        };

        // 基于真实HTML结构提取书籍列表
        // 结构: div.item > div.image > a[href] (封面/链接)
        //       + dl > dt > a (书名) + dd (简介) + div.btm > a[author] + em(字数/时间)
        
        $tempContainer.find(".item").each(function() {
            try{
                var $item = $(this);
                
                // 从 image 区域获取书籍URL和封面
                var $imageLink = $item.find(".image a").first();
                var bookUrl = $imageLink.attr('href');
                var coverUrl = $imageLink.find("img").first().attr('data-original') || 
                               $imageLink.find("img").first().attr('src') || "";
                
                if (!bookUrl || !bookLinkMatcher(bookUrl) || processedUrls.has(bookUrl)) { 
                    return true; 
                }
                
                processedUrls.add(bookUrl);
                
                // 书名（从dt标签的a获取）
                var bookName = $item.find("dt a").first().attr('title') || 
                               $item.find("dt a").first().text().trim();
                
                // 作者（从.btm中的a[包含/author/]获取）
                var author = "";
                $item.find("a[href*='/author/']").each(function(){
                    if(!author) {
                        author = $(this).text().trim();
                    }
                });
                
                // 简介（dd标签内容）
                var intro = $item.find("dd").first().text().trim();
                if(intro && intro.length > 200) {
                    intro = intro.substring(0, 200);  // 限制长度
                }
                
                // 字数和时间
                var wordCount = "";
                var updateTime = "";
                $item.find("em.orange, em[class*='orange']").each(function(){
                    if(!wordCount) wordCount = $(this).text().trim();
                });
                $item.find("em.blue, em[class*='blue']").each(function(){
                    if(!updateTime) updateTime = $(this).text().trim();
                });
                
                if(bookName && bookName.length > 1){
                    bookUrl = normalizeUrl(bookUrl);

                    var book={
                        "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                        "name": bookName,
                        "author": author,
                        "kind": "",
                        "coverUrl": normalizeUrl(coverUrl),
                        "intro": intro,
                        "tocUrl": bookUrl,
                        "wordCount": wordCount + (updateTime ? " | " + updateTime : ""),
                        "type": 0,
                        "latestChapterTitle": ""
                    };
                    books.push(book);
                }
            }catch(e){
                flutterBridge.log("解析.item出错: " + e.message);
            }
        });

        // 如果没找到.item容器，使用通用匹配作为备选
        if(books.length === 0) {
            flutterBridge.log("未找到.item容器，使用通用匹配");
            
            $tempContainer.find("a").each(function() {
                try{
                    var bookUrl = $(this).attr('href');
                    
                    if (!bookUrl || processedUrls.has(bookUrl)) { return true; }
                    if (!bookLinkMatcher(bookUrl)) { return true; }
                    
                    processedUrls.add(bookUrl);
                    
                    var bookName = $(this).attr('title') || $(this).text().trim();
                    
                    if(bookName && bookName.length > 1){
                        bookUrl = normalizeUrl(bookUrl);

                        var book={
                            "bookUrl": bookUrl,
                            "name": bookName,
                            "author": "",
                            "kind": "",
                            "coverUrl": "",
                            "intro": "",
                            "tocUrl": bookUrl,
                            "wordCount": "",
                            "type": 0,
                            "latestChapterTitle": ""
                        };
                        books.push(book);
                    }
                }catch(e){
                    flutterBridge.log("解析书籍信息出错: " + e.message);
                }
            });
        }

        removeHTMLSafely($tempContainer);
        flutterBridge.log("找到 " + books.length + " 本书");
        return JSON.stringify(books);
    }
