    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        /*
         * 检查速率限制
         * 实现方法：
         * 1. 获取当前时间戳
         * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
         * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
         * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
         * 5. 递归检查速率限制
         * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
         */
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if (!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        /*
         * 通用返回字段
         * method post get 或者 head
         * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
         * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
         * statusCode 状态码
         * statusMessage
         * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容
         */
        async Get(url, headers, followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', "get", url, "", JSON.stringify(headers), followRedirects, "");
            } catch (error) {
                return null;

        }

            try {

            } catch (error) {

            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();

            const startTime = new Date().getTime();
            if (method === "GET") {
                data = await http.Get(urla, headers);
            } else {
                data = await http.Post(urla, headers, JSON.stringify(body), "application/json");
            }
            const endTime = new Date().getTime();
            const timeoutSwitch = await getVariable("超时自动切换") || "true";
            let timeout = await getVariable("超时时间") || "5";
            timeout = parseInt(timeout) * 1000;
            if (timeoutSwitch === 'true' && endTime - startTime > timeout) {
                await switchToNextLine("线路超时")
            }
            dataJson = data.data;
            dataJson = JSON.parse(dataJson);
            return dataJson;
        } catch {
            let hostsbk = (await getVariable('云端配置'))['hosts'] || hosts;
            let autoSwitch = await getVariable("自动切换") || "true";
            if (hostsbk.length > index+1 && autoSwitch === 'true') {
                await switchToNextLine("线路报错")
                return await request(url, method, body, index + 1)
            }
        }
        return dataJson
    }

    async function upHtml() {
        // flutterBridge.showToast(`正在检查更新`);
        let html = await http.Get(`${await BaseUrl()}/static/source_config/gyks.html`);
        html = html.data;
        // flutterBridge.showToast(html);
        let couldVersion = "0"
        let match = html.match(/let localVersion = '([^\']+)'/);
        if (match) {
            couldVersion = match[1];
        }
        let compareResult = compareVersions(couldVersion);
        if (compareResult === -1) {
            // flutterBridge.showToast(`发现新版本：${couldVersion},当前版本：${localVersion},正在更新光遇聚合书源`);
            await flutterBridge.setHtml(html);
            flutterBridge.showToast(`光遇聚合书源发现新版本，已更新\n${localVersion} → ${couldVersion}`);
        } else {
            // flutterBridge.showToast(`已是最新版本：${localVersion}`);
        }
    }

    // 版本比较函数
    function compareVersions(vs) {
        const normalize = (v) => {
            return v.split('.').map(n => {
                const num = parseInt(n, 10);
                return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
            });
        };

        const parts1 = normalize(localVersion);
        const parts2 = normalize(vs);
        const maxLength = Math.max(parts1.length, parts2.length);

        for (let i = 0; i < maxLength; i++) {
            const num1 = parts1[i] || 0;
            const num2 = parts2[i] || 0;
            if (num1 > num2) return 1;
            if (num1 < num2) return -1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // 获取云端配置
    async function getCloudSettings(r) {
        if (r === undefined) r = false;
        let c = await cache.get('gyks_config');
        if (r || !c) {
            await flutterBridge.showToast(`正在更新最新配置`);
            try {
                let url = `/static/source_config/config.json`;
                let js = await request(url);
                let intc = parseInt(c);
                let intv = parseInt(js['version']);
                if (intc >= intv) {
                    await flutterBridge.showToast(`已是最新配置：${js['version']}`);
                    return;
                } else if (!intc && intv) {
                    await flutterBridge.showToast(`已初始化配置：${intv}`);
                } else if (intc < intv || !intc && intv) {
                    await flutterBridge.showToast(`已更新配置：${intc}→${intv}`);
                } else {
                    await flutterBridge.showToast(`获取配置失败：请切换线路再试试~`);
                    return;
                }
                await cache.set('gyks_config', js['version'])
                await setVariable('云端配置', js);
                return js;
            } catch (e) {
                await flutterBridge.showToast(`获取最新配置失败：${e}`);
            }
        }
    }

    async function _getParsedVariable() {

    async function deleteVariable() {
        await cache.remove("gyks_variable");

    // 获取源变量
    async function getVariable(k = "") {
        const parsed = await _getParsedVariable();
        if (k === "") {
            return parsed;
        }
        let value = parsed[k];
        if (value === undefined) {
            value = defaultConfig[k];
        }
        return value !== undefined ? value : "";
    }

    // 设置源变量
    async function setVariable(k, v, t = true) {
        const vs = await getVariable();
        vs[k] = v;
        await cache.set("gyks_variable", JSON.stringify(vs));
        if (k !== '云端配置' && t) {
            const notifySwitch = await getVariable("切换提醒") || "true";
            const notifyMsg = `设置 ${k} 为 ${v}`;
            if (notifySwitch === 'true' && k === "线路") {
                await flutterBridge.showToast(notifyMsg)
            }
        }
    }


    async function search(key, page) {
        let moreSettings = await getVariable('更多设置');
        let tab = moreSettings && moreSettings['搜索模式'] || '小说';
        let sourcesKey = moreSettings && moreSettings[tab] || '全部';

        let disabled_sources = moreSettings && moreSettings['强制搜索'] || "0";
        if (disabled_sources === "false") {
            disabled_sources = "0";
        } else if (disabled_sources === "true") {
            disabled_sources = "1";
        }

        let searchUrl = `/search?title=${key}&tab=${tab}&source=${sourcesKey}&page=${page}&disabled_sources=${disabled_sources}`;
        let data = await request(searchUrl);
        let books_data = data.data;

        let books = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < books_data.length; i++) {
            var book = books_data[i];
            let type = 0;
            if (book.tab === "听书") {
                type = 1;
            } else if (book.tab === "小说") {
                type = 0;
            } else if (book.tab === "漫画") {
                type = 2;
            }
            books.push({
                "bookUrl": `/detail?book_id=${book.book_id}&source=${book.source}&tab=${book.tab}`,
                "name": book.book_name,
                "author": book.author,
                "kind": [
                    book.status,
                    book.score,
                    book.tags,
                    typeof book.last_chapter_update_time === "number" && book.last_chapter_update_time > 946656000 && book.last_chapter_update_time < 4102444800
                        ? new Date(book.last_chapter_update_time * 1000).toLocaleString("zh-CN")
                        : book.last_chapter_update_time
                ].filter(v => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "").join(","),
                "coverUrl": book.thumb_url,
                "intro": book.abstract,
                "tocUrl": ``,
                "wordCount": book.word_number,
                "type": type,
                "latestChapterTitle": `${book.source}:${book.latest_chapter_title || ""}`,
            })
        }
        return JSON.stringify(books);
    }

    async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
        tocUrl = JSON.parse(tocUrl);
        var variable = await cache.get("variable") || "";
        let moreSettings = await getVariable('更多设置');
        let is_last_source = moreSettings && moreSettings['目录显示来源'] || 'false';
        variable = variable.trim();
        if (variable !== "") {
            variable = JSON.stringify({
                'custom': variable
            });
        }
        let catalogUrl = `/catalog?book_id=${tocUrl.book_id}&source=${tocUrl.source}&tab=${tocUrl.tab}&variable=${variable}`;
        flutterBridge.log(catalogUrl);
        let data = await request(catalogUrl, "POST");
        let catalog_data = data.data;
        let chapters = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < catalog_data.length; i++) {
            let chapterName = catalog_data[i].title;
            if (is_last_source === 'true') {
                if (i === catalog_data.length - 1) {
                    chapterName = `${catalog_data[i].source}:${chapterName}`;
                }
            }
            chapters.push({
                "name": chapterName,
                "chapterId": JSON.stringify({
                    item_id: catalog_data[i].item_id,
                    source: tocUrl.source,
                    tab: tocUrl.tab,
                    book_id: tocUrl.book_id,
                    index: i,
                    title: catalog_data[i].title,
                }),
                "index": i,
                "isPay": false,
                "isVip": false,
                "isVolume": false,
                "tag": catalog_data[i].first_pass_time || ""
            });
        }
        return JSON.stringify(chapters);
    }

    async function paraForQyd(content, book_id, sources) {
        let server = await BaseUrl();
        const regex = /<p>(.*?)(?:<comment ident="([^"]*)" count="([^"]*)" \/>)?<\/p>/g;
        const matches = Array.from(content.matchAll(regex));

        const replacements = await Promise.all(
            matches.map(async (match) => {
                if (match[2] && match[3]) {
                    let lurl = match[2];
                    if (!lurl.includes(book_id)) {
                        lurl = lurl.replace("book_id=&", "book_id=" + book_id + "&");
                    }
                    var dpnumber = match[3] > 99 ? "99+" : match[3].toString();
                    const svgUrl = `<img src="dp:${dpnumber},{"js":"showCmt('${server + lurl}', '${sources}')"}"/>`
                    return {search: match[0], replace: `${match[1]}${svgUrl}`};

                }
                return {search: match[0], replace: match[1]};
            })
        );

        replacements.forEach(({search, replace}) => {
            content = content.replace(search, replace);
        });

        return content;
    }

    async function syncBookShelf(book, data) {
        if (!book) {
            return;
        }
        // flutterBridge.showToast(JSON.stringify(book));
        let book_order = book.order;
        if (book_order != 0) {
            book_order = 1;
        } else {
            book_order = 2;
        }


        try {

            let book_info = {
                book_name: book.name,
                author: book.author,
                //abstract:book.abstract,
                thumb_url: book.coverUrl,
                book_id: data.book_id,
                tab: data.tab,
                source: data.source
            };
            if (!book_info || typeof book_info != "object") {
                return;
            }
            const rurl = `/add_book_to_book_shelf`;
            book_info.read_status = book_order;
            book_info.last_chapter_item_id = data.item_id;
            book_info.last_chapter_title = data.title || "";
            //java.toast(JSON.stringify(book_info));
            let check_data = null;
            try {
                const check_book_url = `/check_book_in_book_shelf`;
                check_data = await request(check_book_url, "POST", book_info);
            } catch (e) {
                flutterBridge.log(`检查书籍请求失败: ${e}`);
            }

            try {
                if (check_data.data.id) {
                    book_info.id = check_data.data.id;
                    const uurl = `/update_book_shelf`;
                    let up = await request(uurl, "POST", book_info);
                    flutterBridge.showToast(JSON.stringify(up));
                } else {
                    let up = await request(rurl, "POST", book_info);
                    flutterBridge.showToast(JSON.stringify(up));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                try {
                    let up = await request(rurl, "POST", book_info);
                    flutterBridge.showToast(JSON.stringify(up));
                } catch (e) {
                    flutterBridge.showToast(`书架操作失败: ${e}`);
                }

            }
        } catch (error) {
            flutterBridge.log(`书籍同步流程异常: ${error}`);
            flutterBridge.showToast("同步阅读进度失败，但不影响阅读，可以前往登录关闭书架同步功能。");
        }
    }


    async function content(url, bookurl) {
        url = JSON.parse(url);
        var tone_id = await cache.get("tone_id") || "4";
        tone_id = tone_id.trim();
        if (url.tab === "听书" && (url.source !== "番茄" || url.source !== "七猫")) {
            flutterBridge.showToast(`当前播放音色：${tone_id}`);
        }
        var moreSettings = await getVariable("更多设置") || {};
        var show_img = moreSettings && moreSettings['显示图片'] || 'true';
        var review = moreSettings && moreSettings["段评开关"] || "true";
        var reading = moreSettings && moreSettings['同步书架'] || 'false';
        let book = await flutterBridge.getReadBook();
        // flutterBridge.log("111111111111111111")
        // flutterBridge.showToast(await flutterBridge.getdurChapterIndex());
        // flutterBridge.showToast((await flutterBridge.getdurChapterIndex()) == url.index);
        // flutterBridge.showToast(`当前章节：${url.index},当前阅读：${await flutterBridge.getdurChapterIndex(bookurl)}`);
        if ((await flutterBridge.getdurChapterIndex(bookurl)) == url.index && reading === "true") {
            try {
                await syncBookShelf(book, url);
            } catch (error) {
                flutterBridge.showToast(`同步阅读进度失败: ${error}`);
                // flutterBridge.showToast("同步阅读进度失败，但不影响阅读，可以前往登录关闭书架同步功能。");
            }
        }
        if (review === "false") {
            review = "0"
        } else {
            review = "1"
        }
        url["version"] = localVersion;
        url["tone_id"] = tone_id;
        let content_data = await request(`/content?review=${review}`, "POST", url);
        let result = content_data.content;
        if (content_data.msg) {
            flutterBridge.showToast(content_data.msg);
        }
        if (url.tab === "小说") {
            result = result.replace(/<img[^>]*>/g, (match) => {
                const srcMatch = match.match(/\s+src="([^"]+)"/);
                if (srcMatch) {
                    const encodedSrc = srcMatch[1].replace(/&/g, '&');
                    return `<img src="${encodedSrc}" />`;
                }
                return match;
            });
            if (show_img === "false") {
                result = removeAllImgTags(result);
            }
            if (review === "1") {
                result = await paraForQyd(result, url.book_id, url.source);
            }


        }
        if (url.tab === "短剧") {
            var play_url;
            if (url.source !== "毒舌影视" && url.source !== "NT动漫") {
                play_url = `${await BaseUrl()}/online_video?book_id=${url.book_id}&source=${url.source}&tab=${url.tab}`;
            } else {
                play_url = result;
            }
            if (result && content_data.msg === "") {
                result = `${await playButton(play_url)}`
            } else {
                if (content_data.msg) {
                    result = content_data.msg;
                } else {
                    result = `播放地址为空，请联系管理员处理：\n平台：${url.source}\n类型：${url.tab}\n书籍id:${url.book_id}\n章节id：${url.item_id}`;
                }

            }

        }
        return result;
    }

    async function find(url, page) {
        var books = [];
        url = url.replace("{{page}}", page);
        let method = "GET";
        let body = {};
        try {
            let option = url.split("##")[1];
            url = url.split("##")[0];
            option = JSON.parse(option);
            method = option.method || "GET";
            body = option.body || {};
        } catch (e) {
        }
        var books_data = await request(url, method, body)
        books_data = books_data.data;
        for (var i = 0; i < books_data.length; i++) {

            var book = books_data[i];
            let type = 0;
            if (book.tab === "听书") {
                type = 1;
            } else if (book.tab === "小说") {
                type = 0;
            } else if (book.tab === "漫画") {
                type = 2;
            }
            books.push({
                "bookUrl": `/detail?book_id=${book.book_id}&source=${book.source}&tab=${book.tab}`,
                "name": book.book_name,
                "author": book.author,
                "kind": [
                    book.status,
                    book.score,
                    book.tags,
                    typeof book.last_chapter_update_time === "number" && book.last_chapter_update_time > 946656000 && book.last_chapter_update_time < 4102444800
                        ? new Date(book.last_chapter_update_time * 1000).toLocaleString("zh-CN")
                        : book.last_chapter_update_time
                ].filter(v => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "").join(","),
                "coverUrl": book.thumb_url,
                "intro": book.abstract,
                "tocUrl": `/detail?book_id=${book.book_id}&source=${book.source}&tab=${book.tab}`,
                "wordCount": book.word_number,
                "type": type,
                "latestChapterTitle": `${book.source}:${book.latest_chapter_title || ""}`,
            })
        }

        return JSON.stringify(books);
    }

        function renderServerList() {
          const serverList = document.getElementById('serverList');

          HOSTS.forEach((host, index) => {
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'server-card' + (currentServer === host ? ' selected' : '');
            card.dataset.host = host;
            card.dataset.index = index;
            
            card.innerHTML = \`
              <div class="server-icon">
                <i class="fas fa-server"></i>
              </div>
              <div class="server-info">
                <div class="server-url">\${host}</div>
                <div class="server-details" id="details-\${index}">状态: 检测中</div>
              </div>
              <span class="server-status checking" id="status-\${index}">
                <i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>
                <span>检测中</span>
              </span>
              \${currentServer === host ? '<div class="selected-badge"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></div>' : ''}
            \`;
            
            card.addEventListener('click', () => {
              selectServer(host);
            });
            
            serverList.appendChild(card);
          });
        }

        function selectServer(host) {
          currentServer = host;
          
          document.querySelectorAll('.server-card').forEach(card => {
            card.classList.remove('selected');
            const badge = card.querySelector('.selected-badge');
            if (badge) badge.remove();
          });
          
          const selectedCard = document.querySelector(\`[data-host="\${host}"]\`);
          if (selectedCard) {
            selectedCard.classList.add('selected');
            const icon = selectedCard.querySelector('.server-icon');
            icon.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-primary-light))';
            icon.style.color = 'white';
            
            const statusEl = selectedCard.querySelector('.server-status');
            const newBadge = document.createElement('div');
            newBadge.className = 'selected-badge';
            newBadge.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i>';
            selectedCard.appendChild(newBadge);
          }
          
          document.getElementById('currentServer').textContent = host;
          document.getElementById('serverValue').textContent = host;
        }

        async function checkSingleServer(host, index) {
          const currentProtocol = window.location.protocol;
          const statusEl = document.getElementById(\`status-\${index}\`);
          const detailsEl = document.getElementById(\`details-\${index}\`);
          
          try {
            const serverProtocol = new URL(host).protocol;
            if (currentProtocol === 'https:' && serverProtocol === 'http:') {
              statusEl.className = 'server-status not-support';
              statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i><span>不支持</span>';
              detailsEl.textContent = '浏览器安全策略限制';
              return;
            }
            
            const startTime = performance.now();
            const controller = new AbortController();
            const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
            
            const response = await fetch(\`\${host}/health?t=\${Date.now()}\`, {
              signal: controller.signal,
              method: 'GET',
              mode: 'cors',
              cache: 'no-cache'
            });
            
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            const responseTime = Math.round(performance.now() - startTime);
            
            if (response.ok) {
              if (responseTime < 1000) {
                statusEl.className = 'server-status online';
                statusEl.innerHTML = \`<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i><span>\${responseTime}ms</span>\`;
              } else if (responseTime < 2000) {
                statusEl.className = 'server-status slow';
                statusEl.innerHTML = \`<i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i><span>\${responseTime}ms</span>\`;
              } else {
                statusEl.className = 'server-status slow';
                statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i><span>缓慢</span>';
              }
              detailsEl.textContent = '运行正常';
            } else {
              statusEl.className = 'server-status offline';
              statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times-circle"></i><span>异常</span>';
              detailsEl.textContent = 'HTTP状态码: ' + response.status;
            }
          } catch (error) {
            statusEl.className = 'server-status offline';
            statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times-circle"></i><span>离线</span>';
            detailsEl.textContent = '连接失败';
          }
        }

        async function checkServers() {
          HOSTS.forEach((_, index) => {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById(\`status-\${index}\`);
            const detailsEl = document.getElementById(\`details-\${index}\`);
            if (statusEl && detailsEl) {
              statusEl.className = 'server-status checking';
              statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i><span>检测中</span>';
              detailsEl.textContent = '状态: 检测中';
            }
          });
          
          const promises = HOSTS.map((host, index) => checkSingleServer(host, index));
          await Promise.all(promises);
          
          const now = new Date();
          document.getElementById('lastCheckTime').textContent = \`最后检测: \${now.toLocaleTimeString()}\`;
        }

        document.getElementById('refreshBtn').addEventListener('click', checkServers);

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
          renderServerList();
          document.getElementById('currentServer').textContent = currentServer;
          checkServers();
          
          const autoSwitchToggle = document.getElementById('autoSwitchToggle');
          const autoSwitchValue = document.getElementById('autoSwitchValue').textContent;
          autoSwitchToggle.checked = autoSwitchValue !== 'false';
          
          autoSwitchToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            document.getElementById('autoSwitchValue').textContent = e.target.checked ? 'true' : 'false';
          });
          
          const timeoutSwitchToggle = document.getElementById('timeoutSwitchToggle');
          const timeoutSwitchValue = document.getElementById('timeoutSwitchValue').textContent;
          timeoutSwitchToggle.checked = timeoutSwitchValue !== 'false';
          
          timeoutSwitchToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            document.getElementById('timeoutSwitchValue').textContent = e.target.checked ? 'true' : 'false';
          });
          
          const timeoutSelect = document.getElementById('timeoutSelect');
          const timeoutValue = document.getElementById('timeoutValue').textContent;
          timeoutSelect.value = timeoutValue;
          
          timeoutSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            document.getElementById('timeoutValue').textContent = e.target.value;
          });
          
          const notifySwitchToggle = document.getElementById('notifySwitchToggle');
          const notifySwitchValue = document.getElementById('notifySwitchValue').textContent;
          notifySwitchToggle.checked = notifySwitchValue !== 'false';
          
          notifySwitchToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            document.getElementById('notifySwitchValue').textContent = e.target.checked ? 'true' : 'false';
          });
        });
        <\/script>

    `;

    }

  transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.main-tab::before {
  content: '';

  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);

.main-tab:hover {

.tab-content {

@keyframes slideIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }

/* 来源选择子Tab */

.source-subtab.audio.active {

  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6 0%, #2563eb 100%);
  border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5);

  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.source-subtab.comic.active {
  color: white;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #9333ea 100%);
  border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);

.source-subtab.drama.active {

.source-subtab:hover:not(.active) {

.source-subtab.active i {

/* 来源选项 */
.source-options {
  display: grid;

}

.source-option {

.source-option:hover {

.source-option.selected {

/* 选中状态提示 */

}

}

/* 设置项样式 */
.setting-item {
  display: flex;

  padding: 20px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);

.switch input {

.slider {

  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;

  width: 24px;
  left: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;

input:checked + .slider {

}

.highlight::after {

.highlight-orange {

}

.highlight-blue {

}

.highlight-purple {

  font-weight: 700;
}

.highlight-red {
  color: #ef4444;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* 选择器样式 */
.select-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.select-wrapper select {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  padding: 10px 34px 10px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;

  background: var(--bg-card);

}

.select-wrapper select:hover {

}

.select-wrapper select:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45, 157, 120, 0.1);
}

.select-wrapper::after {
  content: '\\f078';
  font-family: 'Font Awesome 6 Free';

  position: absolute;
  right: 10px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);

  pointer-events: none;
  font-size: 13px;

.select-wrapper:hover::after {

}

/* 提示文案样式 */
.tip-alert {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.12) 0%, rgba(255, 152, 0, 0.08) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.25);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  margin: 20px;

}

.tip-alert::before {

  right: -20%;

  height: 100px;

}

.tip-alert i {

.tip-alert p {

.tip-alert .highlight-text {

/* 响应式 */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .container {
    padding: 16px 12px;

::-webkit-scrollbar {

}

}

  border-radius: 3px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--text-secondary);
}
</style>

        </label>

          <div class="setting-title">段评开关</div>
           <div class="setting-desc">仅 <span class="highlight-red">番茄</span>、<span class="highlight">七猫</span>、<span class="highlight-red">塔读</span>、<span class="highlight">QQ阅读</span> 支持</div>
        </div>

          <i class="fas fa-video"></i>

        })}
      <\/script>

        <span id="novelSource">${(data && data.小说) || '全部'}</span>

        <span id="showParaSwitchValue">${(data && data.段评开关) || 'true'}</span>
        <span id="showFullDescSwitchValue">${(data && data.完整简介) || 'true'}</span>
        <span id="syncBookshelfSwitchValue">${(data && data.同步书架) || 'false'}</span>
        <span id="networkModeValue">${(data && data.网络模式) || '服务器'}</span>
        <span id="forceSearchSwitchValue">${(data && data.强制搜索) || 'false'}</span>

<script>
const SOURCES = ${JSON.stringify(config)};
let settings = ${JSON.stringify(data)};
let currentType = '小说';

document.getElementById('tabSource').addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.getElementById('tabSource').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('tabBookSource').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('contentSource').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('contentBookSource').classList.remove('active');
});

document.getElementById('tabBookSource').addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.getElementById('tabBookSource').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('tabSource').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('contentBookSource').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('contentSource').classList.remove('active');
});

const subtabs = document.querySelectorAll('.source-subtab');
subtabs.forEach(tab => {
  tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
    subtabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
    tab.classList.add('active');
    currentType = tab.dataset.type;
    renderSourceOptions();
  });
});

function renderSourceOptions() {
  const optionsContainer = document.getElementById('sourceOptions');
  const key = \`搜索\${currentType}\`;
  const sources = SOURCES[key] || [];
  const savedValue = settings[currentType] || '';
  const selectedValues = savedValue === '全部' ? ['全部'] : (savedValue ? savedValue.split(',') : []);

  optionsContainer.innerHTML = '';

  const allOption = document.createElement('div');
  allOption.className = \`source-option all \${selectedValues.includes('全部') ? 'selected' : ''}\`;
  allOption.textContent = '全部';
  allOption.addEventListener('click', () => selectOption('全部'));
  optionsContainer.appendChild(allOption);

  sources.forEach(source => {
    const option = document.createElement('div');
    option.className = \`source-option \${selectedValues.includes(source) ? 'selected' : ''}\`;
    option.textContent = source;
    option.addEventListener('click', () => selectOption(source));
    optionsContainer.appendChild(option);
  });

  updateSelectedInfo();
}

function updateHiddenSettings() {
  const jsonEl = document.getElementById('settingsJson');
  if (jsonEl) {
    jsonEl.textContent = JSON.stringify(settings);
  }

  const typeMap = {
    '小说': 'novelSource',
    '听书': 'audioSource',
    '漫画': 'comicSource',
    '短剧': 'dramaSource',
    '搜索模式': 'searchModeValue',
    '显示图片': 'showImageSwitchValue',
    '段评开关': 'showParaSwitchValue',
    '完整简介': 'showFullDescSwitchValue',
    '同步书架': 'syncBookshelfSwitchValue',
    '网络模式': 'networkModeValue',
    '强制搜索': 'forceSearchSwitchValue',
    '目录显示来源': 'showSourceInTocValue'
  };

  Object.keys(typeMap).forEach(type => {
    const el = document.getElementById(typeMap[type]);
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = settings[type] != undefined ? settings[type] : (type.includes('开关') ? 'false' : '全部');
    }
  });
}

function setupBookSourceSettings() {
  document.getElementById('searchMode').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    settings['搜索模式'] = e.target.value;
    updateHiddenSettings();
  });

  document.getElementById('showImageSwitch').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    settings['显示图片'] = e.target.checked ? 'true' : 'false';
    updateHiddenSettings();
  });

  document.getElementById('showParaSwitch').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    settings['段评开关'] = e.target.checked ? 'true' : 'false';
    updateHiddenSettings();

    async function content(url) {
        try {
            await ensureCookies();
            var u = absUrl(url);
            var allContent = "";
            var page = 1;
            var maxPages = 20;

            while (page <= maxPages) {
                var pageUrl = u;
                if (page > 1) {
                    var ext = u.lastIndexOf(".html");
                    if (ext > 0) {
                        pageUrl = u.substring(0, ext) + "_" + page + ".html";
                    }
                }

                var html = await fetchPage(pageUrl);
                if (!html) break;
                if (page === 1) flutterBridge.text(3, html);

                var $c = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(html));
                var pageContent = "";

                $c.find("#cont-body.cont-body p").each(function() {
                    var text = $(this).text().trim();
                    if (text) pageContent += text + "\n";
                });

                if (!pageContent.trim()) {
                    removeHTMLSafely($c);
                    break;
                }

                allContent += pageContent;

                var hasNextPage = $c.find(".page .pagination li a").filter(function() {
                    return $(this).text().trim() == "" + (page + 1);
                }).length > 0;

                removeHTMLSafely($c);
                if (!hasNextPage) break;
                page++;
            }

            var keywords = ["最新网址", "手机阅读", "请收藏本站", "本章未完", "点击继续", "温馨提示", "txt下载", "电子书下载", "好书推荐", "下载txt", "本站域名"];
            var lines = allContent.split("\n");
            var filtered = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                var line = lines[i].trim();
                if (!line) continue;
                var skip = false;
                for (var k = 0; k < keywords.length; k++) {
                    if (line.indexOf(keywords[k]) >= 0) { skip = true; break; }
                }
                if (skip) continue;
                filtered.push(line);
            }
            var result = filtered.join("\n").trim();
            if (result.length < 50) return "";
            return result;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("content error:" + e.message);
            return "";

<script>
  var isCookieJar = true;
  class FlutterJSBridge {
    constructor() { this.init(); }
    init() {
      if (window.flutter_inappwebview) { this.isReady = true; this.CookieJar(); }
      else window.addEventListener('flutterInAppWebViewPlatformReady', () => { this.isReady = true; this.CookieJar(); });
    }
    async CookieJar() { try { return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('CookieJar', isCookieJar); } catch (e) { return false; } }
    async text(type, str) { try { return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('text', type, str); } catch (e) { return false; } }
    async utf8ToGbkUrlEncoded(str) { try { return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('utf8ToGbkUrlEncoded', str); } catch (e) { return encodeURIComponent(str); } }
  }
  class Http {
    async Get(url, headers, followRedirects) {
      try { return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', 'get', url, '', JSON.stringify(headers || {}), followRedirects, ''); } catch (e) { return null; }
    }
    async Post(url, headers, body, contenttype, followRedirects) {
      try { return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http', 'post', url, body, JSON.stringify(headers || {}), followRedirects, contenttype); } catch (e) { return null; }
    }
  }
  const flutterBridge = new FlutterJSBridge();
  const http = new Http();
  const baseurl = 'https://www.hen0.com';
  const headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/131.0 Safari/537.36',
    'Referer': baseurl + '/'
  };

  function abs(url, base) {
    if (!url) return '';
    try { return new URL(url, base || baseurl + '/').href; } catch (e) { return url || ''; }
  }
  function cleanText(value) { return String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }
  function responseHtml(result) { return result && typeof result.data === 'string' ? result.data : ''; }
  function parse(html) { return $($.parseHTML(html, document, true)); }
  function bookFromDetail(root, bookurl) {
    var meta = root.find('.book-meta .label');
    var cover = root.find('.book-cover-large').attr('src');
    var latest = root.find('.book-meta').find('a').last().text();
    return {
      bookUrl: bookurl, name: cleanText(root.find('.book-title').first().text()),
      author: cleanText(root.find('.book-author').first().text()).replace(/^作者[：:]\s*/, ''),
      kind: cleanText(meta.eq(0).text()).replace(/^分类[：:]\s*/, ''), coverUrl: abs(cover),
      intro: '@html:' + (root.find('.book-tags').first().html() || ''), tocUrl: bookurl,
      wordCount: cleanText(meta.eq(2).text()).replace(/^字数[：:]\s*/, ''), type: 0,
      latestChapterTitle: cleanText(latest)
    };
  }

  async function search(key, page) {
    if (page > 1) return '[]';
    var body = 'searchkey=' + (await flutterBridge.utf8ToGbkUrlEncoded(key || ''));
    var result = await http.Post(baseurl + '/search.html', headers, body, 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', true);
    var html = responseHtml(result);
    await flutterBridge.text(0, html);
    var root = parse(html), books = [];
    // Exact matches are redirected by the site directly to a detail page.
    if (root.find('.book-title').length) {
      var firstChapter = abs(root.find('.action-buttons a.btn-primary').first().attr('href'));
      var detailUrl = firstChapter.replace(/[^/]+\.html(?:[?#].*)?$/, '');
      if (detailUrl) books.push(bookFromDetail(root, detailUrl));
      return JSON.stringify(books);
    }
    root.find('table tbody tr').each(function(index) {
      var row = $(this), link = row.find('td').eq(0).find('a').first();
      var href = link.attr('href');
      if (!href) return;
      var cells = row.find('td');
      books.push({
        bookUrl: abs(href), name: cleanText(link.text()), author: cleanText(cells.eq(1).text()),
        kind: '', coverUrl: '', intro: '', tocUrl: abs(href), wordCount: '', type: 0,
        latestChapterTitle: cleanText(cells.eq(2).text())
      });
    });
    return JSON.stringify(books);
  }

  async function info(bookurl) {
    var result = await http.Get(bookurl, headers, true), html = responseHtml(result);
    await flutterBridge.text(1, html);
    return JSON.stringify(bookFromDetail(parse(html), bookurl));
  }

  function chapterNameMap(html) {
    var names = {};
    var re = /\.p_(\d+)::after\s*\{\s*content\s*:\s*(['"])([\s\S]*?)\2\s*\}/g, match;
    while ((match = re.exec(html || ''))) {
      names[match[1]] = match[3].replace(/\\(['"])/g, '$1').replace(/\\n/g, '\n').trim();
    }
    return names;
  }

  function appendChapters(html, pageUrl, chapters, seen) {
    var names = chapterNameMap(html), anchorRe = /<a\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi, match;
    // Parse raw anchors because the visible title is not text content.
    while ((match = anchorRe.exec(html || ''))) {
      var attrs = match[1], inner = match[2];
      var hrefMatch = attrs.match(/\bhref\s*=\s*(['"])(.*?)\1/i);
      var classMatch = attrs.match(/\bclass\s*=\s*(['"])(.*?)\1/i);
      var href = hrefMatch ? hrefMatch[2] : '', className = classMatch ? classMatch[2] : '';
      var idMatch = className.match(/(?:^|\s)p_(\d+)(?:\s|$)/);
      if (!idMatch || !href) continue;
      var idNumber = idMatch[1];
      var visibleText = cleanText(inner.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' '));
      var name = visibleText || cleanText(names[idNumber]);
      if (!name) continue;
      var id = abs(href, pageUrl);
      if (seen[id]) continue;
      seen[id] = true;
      chapters.push({ name: name, chapterId: id, index: chapters.length, isPay: false, isVip: false, isVolume: false, tag: '' });
    }
  }

  async function chapter(tocUrl) {
    // Requests must stay sequential: some Windows builds cannot settle concurrent
    // Http bridge calls. The site exposes every catalog page in <option value>.
    var result = await http.Get(tocUrl, headers, true), html = responseHtml(result);
    if (!html) return '[]';
    await flutterBridge.text(2, html);
    var chapters = [], seenChapters = {}, pageUrls = [abs(tocUrl)], optionRe = /<option\b[^>]*value\s*=\s*(['"])(.*?)\1/gi, optionMatch;
    while ((optionMatch = optionRe.exec(html))) {
      var optionUrl = abs(optionMatch[2], tocUrl);
      if (optionUrl.replace(/_1\/$/, '/') === pageUrls[0]) continue;
      if (optionUrl && pageUrls.indexOf(optionUrl) < 0) pageUrls.push(optionUrl);
    }
    appendChapters(html, tocUrl, chapters, seenChapters);
    for (var pageIndex = 1; pageIndex < pageUrls.length; pageIndex++) {
      var pageResult = await http.Get(pageUrls[pageIndex], headers, true);
      var pageHtml = responseHtml(pageResult);
      if (pageHtml) appendChapters(pageHtml, pageUrls[pageIndex], chapters, seenChapters);
    }
    return JSON.stringify(chapters);
  }

  function cssAfterText(root) {
    var style = root.find('#chapter-content style').text() || '';
    var pieces = [], re = /#chapter-content\s+\.([^:]+)::after\s*\{\s*content\s*:\s*(['"])([\s\S]*?)\2\s*\}/g, match;
    while ((match = re.exec(style))) pieces.push(match[3].replace(/\\(['"])/g, '$1').replace(/\\n/g, '\n'));
    if (!pieces.length) {
      root.find('#chapter-content').contents().each(function() {
        if (this.nodeType === 3) pieces.push(cleanText(this.nodeValue));
      });
    }
    return pieces.filter(function(x) { return x !== ''; }).join('\n').trim();
  }

  async function content(url) {
    var current = abs(url), first = true, parts = [], guard = 0, baseChapter = current.replace(/_\d+(?=\.html$)/, '');
    while (current && guard++ < 20) {
      var result = await http.Get(current, headers, true), html = responseHtml(result);
      if (!html) break;
      var root = parse(html);
      if (first) await flutterBridge.text(3, html);
      var text = cssAfterText(root);
      if (text) parts.push(text);
      var next = root.find('.chapter-nav a').filter(function() { return /下一页/.test($(this).text()); }).first().attr('href');
      if (!next) break;
      var nextUrl = abs(next, current);
      if (nextUrl === current || nextUrl.replace(/_\d+(?=\.html$)/, '') !== baseChapter) break;
      current = nextUrl; first = false;
    }
    return parts.join('\n').trim();
  }

  async function getfinds() { return '[]'; }
  async function find(url, page) { return '[]'; }
  async function pay(bookurl, url) {}
  async function getloginurl() { return ''; }
  async function login() {}
  async function imagedecrypt(url, image) {}
  async function shouldOverrideUrlLoading(url) { return true; }
</script>

    // 以下所有参数除当followRedirects外均为 String
    // 如果需要使用http2协议 请在url 前添加 http2:// ，例如 http2://baidu.com
    // 如果https一直被盾拦截 ，可以使用https2协议
    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        /*
         * 检查速率限制
         * 实现方法：
         * 1. 获取当前时间戳
         * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
         * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
         * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
         * 5. 递归检查速率限制
         * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
         */
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        /*
         * 通用返回字段
         * method post get 或者 head
         * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
         * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
         * statusCode 状态码
         * statusMessage
         * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容
         */
        // headers 传入 Object，内部自动 JSON.stringify，调用方无需手动转字符串
        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            if (tempContainer[0]) { tempContainer = tempContainer[0]; }
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签

        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        // 移除link标签
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');

            "kind": kind || "",

    // ===== 通用列表解析（搜索+发现共用的 书库列表结构） =====
    function parseBookList($c) {
        var books = [];
        $c.find(".book-all-list .bd ul li.column-2").each(function() {
            try {
                var $li = $(this);
                var $a = $li.find("a.name").first();
                if ($a.length === 0) { return; }
                var href = $a.attr("href");
                var name = $a.text().trim();
                if (!href || !name) { return; }
                var author = $li.find(".info a.author").first().text().trim();
                if (!author) {
                    var $info = $li.find(".info").first().clone();
                    $info.find(".words").remove();
                    author = $info.text().replace(/作者[\s:：]*/, "").trim();
                }
                var status = $li.find("span[style*='float:right']").text().trim()
                    || $li.find("span[style*='color: #999']").text().trim();
                var wordCount = $li.find(".words").text().trim().replace(/字数[\s:：]*/, "");
                var latest = $li.find(".update a").first().text().trim();
                books.push(makeBook(absUrl(href), name, author, "", status, wordCount, latest));
            } catch (e) {
                flutterBridge.log("parse li:" + e.message);
            }
        });
        return books;
    }

    // ===== 搜索函数 =====
    // 如果没有分页 请在 page 为 2 及以上返回 "[]"
    // env 为搜索类型，可以判断是不是在搜索界面搜索或者是换源，当env为searchone 时为单书源搜索，允许使用筛选功能
    // 当env为searchone 又启用了filter时 请不要通过getsearch 函数获取搜索类型
    // 表单 POST /s.php，body 需按 GBK 编码（utf8ToGbkUrlEncoded），支持 page 分页，30条/页
    async function search(key,page,env) {
        try {
            if (env === "searchone") {
                var searchType = await flutterBridge.getsearch();
                if (searchType !== -1 && searchType !== 0) {
                    return "[]";
                }
            }
            var encKey = await flutterBridge.utf8ToGbkUrlEncoded(key);
            var u = baseurl + "/s.php";
            var body = "objectType=2&type=articlename&s=" + encKey + "&page=" + page;
            var post = await http.Post(u, { ...header, "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" }, body, "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", true);
            if (!post || !post.data) { return "[]"; }
            flutterBridge.text(0, post.data);
            var $c = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(post.data));
            var books = parseBookList($c);
            removeHTMLSafely($c);
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("search error:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    function encodeDataUrl(html) {
        try {
            var b64 = "";
            try { b64 = flutterBridge.base64encode(html); } catch (e) {}
            if (typeof b64 !== "string") { b64 = ""; }
            if (!b64 && typeof btoa === "function") {
                try { b64 = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(html))); } catch (e2) {}
            }
            if (!b64) { return ""; }
            return "data:text/html;base64," + b64;
        } catch (e) { return ""; }
    }

    async function readFilter(prefix) {
        var f = {};
        try {
            var key = prefix;
            if (prefix.indexOf("banzhu_find_filter_") !== 0) { key = prefix + "filter"; }
            var raw = await cache.get(key); if (raw) { f = JSON.parse(raw); }
        } catch (e) {}
        return f || {};
    }

    // 将筛选覆盖到 shuku 路径：/shuku/{cid}-{sort}-{status}-{{page}}.html
    // 按 url 隔离筛选：每个发现入口独立缓存，切换普通分类不再被全局筛选覆盖
    function mergeShukuParams(url, f) {
        if (!f) { return url; }
        var hasCat = f.category !== undefined && f.category !== "";
        var hasSort = f.sort !== undefined && f.sort !== "";
        var hasStatus = f.status !== undefined && f.status !== "";
        if (!hasCat && !hasSort && !hasStatus) { return url; }
        var m = url.match(/\/shuku\/(\d+)-([a-z]+)-(\d+)-/);
        if (!m) { return url; }
        var cid = hasCat ? f.category : m[1];
        var sort = hasSort ? f.sort : m[2];
        var status = hasStatus ? f.status : m[3];
        return url.replace(/\/shuku\/\d+-[a-z]+-\d+-/, "/shuku/" + cid + "-" + sort + "-" + status + "-");
    }

    function filterKeyForUrl(url) {
        // 用发现入口 url 作后缀，实现按入口隔离；空 url 回退全局
        if (!url) { return "banzhu_find_filter"; }
        return "banzhu_find_filter_" + url;
    }

    async function findfilter(url) {
        try {
            var key = filterKeyForUrl(url);
            var html = buildBanzhuFindFilterHtml(key);
            return encodeDataUrl(html);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("findfilter error:" + e.message);
            return "";
        }
    }

            if (!get || !get.data) { return JSON.stringify({}); }

            var author = "";

            var wordCount = "";

            if ($infoLines.length > 0) {
                var infoText = $infoLines.html().replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "\n").split("\n");
                for (var i = 0; i < infoText.length; i++) {
                    var line = (infoText[i] || "").trim();
                    if (line.indexOf("作者") === 0) { author = line.replace(/作者[\s:：]+/, "").trim(); }
                    else if (line.indexOf("类型") === 0) { kind = line.replace(/类型[\s:：]+/, "").trim(); }
                    else if (line.indexOf("字数") === 0) { wordCount = line.replace(/字数[\s:：]+/, "").trim(); }
                }
            }
            var latestChapterTitle = $c.find(".mod.block.update.chapter-list").first().find(".bd ul.list li a").first().text().trim();
            removeHTMLSafely($c);

            return JSON.stringify({
                "bookUrl": bookurl,
                "name": name,
                "author": author,
                "kind": kind,
                "coverUrl": "",
                "intro": intro,
                "status": status,
                "wordCount": wordCount,
                "tocUrl": u,
                "type": 0,
                "latestChapterTitle": latestChapterTitle

        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("info error:" + e.message);
            return JSON.stringify({});
        }
    }

    // ===== 目录页函数 =====
    // tocUrl 为详情页（即目录第1页），每页20章，分页为 {bookurl}_{n}/
    async function chapter(tocUrl,bookurl) {
        try {
            var u = absUrl(tocUrl);
            var chapters = [];
            var seen = {};
            var base = u.replace(/\/$/, "");
            var idx = 0;

            function collect($doc) {
                var $block = $doc.find(".mod.block.update.chapter-list").last();
                $block.find(".bd ul.list li a").each(function() {
                    try {
                        var $a = $(this);
                        var href = $a.attr("href");
                        var name = $a.text().trim();
                        if (!href || !name) { return; }
                        var cid = absUrl(href);
                        if (seen[cid]) { return; }
                        seen[cid] = 1;
                        chapters.push({
                            "name": name,
                            "chapterId": cid,
                            "index": idx,
                            "isPay": false,
                            "isVip": false,
                            "isVolume": false,
                            "tag": ""
                        });
                        idx++;
                    } catch (e) {
                        flutterBridge.log("chapter li:" + e.message);
                    }
                });
            }

            var get = await http.Get(u, { ...header, "Referer": baseurl }, true);
            if (get && get.data) {
                flutterBridge.text(2, get.data);
                var $c = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
                collect($c);
                var totalPages = 1;
                var endHref = $c.find(".mod.page a.endPage").attr("href") || "";
                var em = endHref.match(/_(\d+)\/$/);
                if (em) { totalPages = parseInt(em[1], 10); }
                removeHTMLSafely($c);

                var maxPages = totalPages;
                // 小批量并发抓取剩余目录页，替代逐页串行 + 人工延时
                http.open = true;
                var p = 2;
                while (p <= maxPages) {
                    var batch = [];
                    for (var b = 0; b < 5 && p <= maxPages; b++) { batch.push(p); p++; }

            function extractText($doc) {
                var $nc = $doc.find(".page-content.font-large").first();
                if ($nc.length === 0) { return ""; }
                // 移除翻页导航、广告等非正文元素，避免 【1】【2】… 翻页数字混入正文

                html = html.replace(/<img[^>]*>/gi, "");

                html = html.replace(/ /g, " ");
                html = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "");

                var filtered = [];
                var keywords = ["最新网址", "手机阅读", "请收藏本站", "本章未完", "点击继续", "温馨提示", "txt下载", "电子书下载", "diyibanzhu", "@gmail.com"];
                for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                    var line = lines[i].trim();
                    if (!line) { continue; }
                    var skip = false;
                    for (var k = 0; k < keywords.length; k++) {

                    if (skip) { continue; }

            fullText = extractText($c);
            var subPages = [];

            // 将下一页首行直接接上（不换行），其余行照常换行
            function joinPage(prev, next) {
                if (!prev) { return next; }
                var prevLines = prev.split("\n");
                var lastLine = prevLines[prevLines.length - 1] || "";
                if (!/[。！？…；：""''）】\]]$/.test(lastLine.trim())) {
                    var nextLines = next.split("\n");
                    var head = nextLines.shift() || "";
                    prevLines[prevLines.length - 1] = lastLine + head;

            }

            if (!fullText || fullText.length < 10) { return ""; }
            if (title) { fullText = title + "\r\n\r\n" + fullText; }

    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        /*
         * 检查速率限制
         * 实现方法：
         * 1. 获取当前时间戳
         * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
         * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
         * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
         * 5. 递归检查速率限制
         * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
         */
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        /*
         * 通用返回字段
         * method post get 或者 head
         * body 请求返回后的字节的 base64
         * headers  map<String,List<String>> 可通过headers[""]来或者
         * statusCode 状态码
         * statusMessage
         * data 返回后的字节 格式化后的内容
         */
        // headers 传入 Object，内部自动 JSON.stringify，调用方无需手动转字符串
        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {

            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return tempDiv;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            var el = tempContainer;
            if (el && el[0]) el = el[0];
            el.innerHTML = '';
            if (el.parentNode) {
                el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

            try {

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {

            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return tempDiv;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            var el = tempContainer;
            if (el && el[0]) el = el[0];
            el.innerHTML = '';
            if (el.parentNode) {
                el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

                    html = html.replace(/\(第\d+\/\d+页\)/g, '');
                    html = html.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
                    var lines = [];
                    var titlePattern = /^第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百千]+[章回节集卷部篇].*$/;
                    var keywords = ["最新网址", "本章未完", "请点击下一页", "上一章", "下一章", "返回目录", "加入书签", "进入书架", "返回书页"];

                        var l = line.trim();

                        for (var k = 0; k < keywords.length; k++) {
                            if (l.indexOf(keywords[k]) >= 0) return;
                        }
                        if (l.length < 2) return;
                        lines.push(l);
                    });
                    if (lines.length > 0 && titlePattern.test(lines[0])) {
                        lines.shift();

                    if (lines.length > 0) {
                        if (fullText) fullText += "\r\n\r\n";
                        fullText += lines.join('\r\n');

                doc.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(function(a){

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

            try {
