            // 封面：a.hst img
            var coverEl=doc.querySelector("a.hst img");
            var coverUrl=coverEl?(coverEl.getAttribute("src")||""):"";
            if(coverUrl && !coverUrl.startsWith("http")) coverUrl=absUrl(coverUrl);
            // 元信息：#at 表 th->td
            function getMeta(label){
                var ths=doc.querySelectorAll("#at th");
                for(var i=0;i<ths.length;i++){
                    var t=(ths[i].textContent||"").trim();
                    if(t.indexOf(label)>=0){
                        var td=ths[i].nextElementSibling;
                        if(td){
                            var a=td.querySelector("a");
                            return a ? (a.textContent||"").trim() : (td.textContent||"").replace(/\u00a0/g,"").trim();
                        }
                    }
                }
                return "";
            }
            var kind=getMeta("小说类别");
            var author=getMeta("小说作者");
            var status=getMeta("小说状态");
            var wordCount=getMeta("全文长度");
            var intro="";
            var pls=doc.querySelectorAll("p.pl");
            for(var i=0;i<pls.length;i++){
                var p=pls[i];
                var txt=(p.textContent||"").trim();
                if(txt.indexOf("内容简介")>=0){
                    var node=p.nextElementSibling;
                    while(node){
                        if(node.id==="sidename") break;
                        var tag=node.tagName ? node.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
                        if(tag==="p"){
                            var t=(node.textContent||"").trim();
                            if(t && t.indexOf("关键字")<0 && t.indexOf("最近章节")<0){
                                // 过滤内含 script 广告的 table 后的空 p
                                if(t.length>10) intro+=t+"\n";
                                else if(t.indexOf("内向")>=0 || t.length>20) intro+=t+"\n";
                            }
                        }
                        node=node.nextElementSibling;
                        if(intro && node && node.id==="sidename") break;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
            intro=intro.trim();
            if(!intro){
                var allP=doc.querySelectorAll("p");
                for(var j=0;j<allP.length;j++){
                    var pp=allP[j];
                    var pt=(pp.textContent||"").trim();
                    if(pt.length>30 && pt.indexOf("内向")>=0){ intro=pt; break; }
                }
            }
            var tocEl=doc.querySelector("p.btnlinks a.read") || doc.querySelector("a.read");
            var tocUrl=tocEl?tocEl.getAttribute("href"):"";
            if(!tocUrl){
                var anchors=doc.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/html/"]');
                for(var k=0;k<anchors.length;k++){
                    var h=anchors[k].getAttribute("href")||"";
                    if(h.indexOf("/html/")>=0){
                        var m=h.match(/(https?:\/\/[^\/]+\/html\/\d+\/\d+\/)/);
                        if(m){ tocUrl=m[1]; break; }
                        if(h.endsWith("/")){ tocUrl=h; break; }
                    }
                }
            }
            if(tocUrl && !tocUrl.startsWith("http")){
                if(tocUrl.startsWith("/")) tocUrl=baseurl+tocUrl;
                else tocUrl=baseurl+"/"+tocUrl;
            }
            if(!tocUrl){
                var mm=u.match(/\/book\/(\d+)/);
                if(mm){
                    var bid2=mm[1];
                    var g2=Math.floor(parseInt(bid2,10)/1000);
                    tocUrl=baseurl+"/html/"+g2+"/"+bid2+"/";
                } else {
                    tocUrl=u;
                }
            }
            var lastChapterEl=null;
            var ps2=doc.querySelectorAll("p");
            for(var p2=0;p2<ps2.length;p2++){
                if((ps2[p2].textContent||"").indexOf("最近章节")>=0){
                    var a2=ps2[p2].querySelector("a");
                    if(a2) lastChapterEl=(a2.textContent||"").trim();
                    break;
                }
            }
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify({ "bookUrl": bookurl, "name": name, "author": author, "kind": kind, "coverUrl": coverUrl||"", "intro": intro, "tocUrl": tocUrl||u, "wordCount": wordCount, "status": status, "type": 0, "latestChapterTitle": lastChapterEl||"" });
        } catch (e) { return JSON.stringify({ "bookUrl": bookurl, "name": "", "author": "", "coverUrl": "", "intro": "", "kind": "", "status": "", "wordCount": "", "tocUrl": bookurl, "type": 0 }); }
    }

    async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
        try {
            var u = absUrl(tocUrl);
            if (/\/book\/\d+/.test(u) && u.indexOf("/html/") < 0) {
                var m = u.match(/\/book\/(\d+)/);
                if (m) {
                    var bid = m[1];
                    var g = Math.floor(parseInt(bid, 10) / 1000);
                    u = baseurl + "/html/" + g + "/" + bid + "/";
                }
            }
            if (!u.endsWith("/")) {
                if (u.indexOf(".html") > 0) {
                    var slash = u.lastIndexOf("/");
                    u = u.substring(0, slash + 1);
                } else {
                    u = u + "/";
                }
            }
            var get = await http.Get(u, header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) return "[]";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var chapters=[];
            doc.querySelectorAll("#at td.L a").forEach(function(a){
                var name=(a.textContent||"").trim();
                var cUrl=a.getAttribute("href");
                if(!name||!cUrl) return;
                if(name.length<1 || name.indexOf("点击阅读")>=0) return;
                if(!cUrl.startsWith("http")){
                    if(cUrl.startsWith("/")) cUrl = baseurl + cUrl;
                    else cUrl = u + cUrl;
                }
                cUrl=absUrl(cUrl);
                chapters.push({ name: name, chapterId: cUrl, index: chapters.length, isPay: false, isVip: false, isVolume: false, tag: "" });
            });
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify(chapters);
        } catch (e) { return "[]"; }

    async function content(url, bookurl) {
        try {
            var u = absUrl(url);
            var get = await http.Get(u, header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) return "";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var el=doc.querySelector("#contents") || doc.querySelector("#nr1");
            var textEl=el?el:doc.querySelector("#content");
            var html=textEl?textEl.innerHTML:"";
            if(!html){
                var c=doc.querySelector("#content");
                html=c?c.innerHTML:"";
            }
            if(textEl){
                var clone=textEl.cloneNode(true);
                var tips=clone.querySelectorAll("#content_tip, #center_tip, script");
                tips.forEach(function(n){ n.remove(); });
                html=clone.innerHTML;
            }
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            if(!html) return "";
            html=html.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n');
            html=html.replace(/ /g, " ");
            html=html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "");
            html=html.replace(/\(第\d+\/\d+页\)/g, "");
            html=html.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
            var lines=[];
            var titlePattern=/^第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百千]+[章回节集卷部篇].*$/;
            var keywords=["最新网址","手机阅读","请收藏本站","本章未完","点击继续","温馨提示","txt下载","电子书下载","最新章节","最新更新","上一章","下一章","返回目录","加入书签","进入书架","返回书页","请点击下一页","下一页","加入书架","推荐本书","没看完","将本书加入收藏","章节错误","点此举报"];
            html.split('\n').forEach(function(l){
                var t=l.trim();
                if(!t) return;
                if(t.length<2) return;
                for(var k=0;k<keywords.length;k++){
                    if(t.indexOf(keywords[k])>=0) return;
                }
                if(/^\//.test(t) && t.indexOf("最新章节")>=0) return;
                if(/^\d+\//.test(t) && t.indexOf("最新章节")>=0) return;
                lines.push(t);
            });
            if(lines.length>0 && titlePattern.test(lines[0])){
                lines.shift();
            }
            var result=lines.join('\n').trim();
            if(result.length<50) return "";
            return result;
        } catch (e) { return ""; }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {

            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return tempDiv;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除，兼容 jQuery 对象（内部通过 [0] 解引用）
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            if (tempContainer[0]) { tempContainer = tempContainer[0]; }
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {

            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return tempDiv;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除，兼容 jQuery 对象（内部通过 [0] 解引用）
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            if (tempContainer[0]) { tempContainer = tempContainer[0]; }
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

        constructor() {

            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

            doc.querySelectorAll("#sitebox dl").forEach(function(dl) {
                var nameEl = dl.querySelector("dd h3 a");
                var name = nameEl ? (nameEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
                var bookUrl = nameEl ? (nameEl.getAttribute("href") || "") : "";
                var coverEl = dl.querySelector("dt a img");
                var coverUrl = coverEl ? (coverEl.getAttribute("src") || "") : "";
                if (bookUrl && !bookUrl.startsWith("http")) bookUrl = baseurl + bookUrl;
                if (coverUrl && !coverUrl.startsWith("http") && coverUrl) coverUrl = baseurl + coverUrl;
                var spans = dl.querySelectorAll("dd.book_other span");
                var author = spans.length > 0 ? (spans[0].textContent || "").trim() : "";
                var kind = "";
                if (spans.length > 2) {
                    var kindA = spans[2].querySelector("a");
                    kind = kindA ? (kindA.textContent || "").trim() : (spans[2].textContent || "").trim();
                }
                var lastChapter = "";
                var otherAs = dl.querySelectorAll("dd.book_other a");
                if (otherAs.length > 0) lastChapter = (otherAs[otherAs.length-1].textContent || "").trim();
                // 兼容原 .book_other:eq(1) a
                var lastEl = dl.querySelectorAll("dd.book_other")[1];
                if (lastEl) {
                    var la = lastEl.querySelector("a");
                    if (la) lastChapter = (la.textContent || "").trim();
                }
                if (bookUrl && name) {
                    books.push({ bookUrl: bookUrl, name: name, author: author, kind: kind, coverUrl: coverUrl || "", intro: "", tocUrl: bookUrl, wordCount: "", type: 0, latestChapterTitle: lastChapter });

    // ===== 详情页函数 =====
    // ⚠️ bookUrl 必须原样返回 bookurl 入参，不可改动！
    async function info(bookurl) {
        try {
            var get = await http.Get(absUrl(bookurl), header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) return JSON.stringify({ bookUrl: bookurl, name: "", author: "", coverUrl: "", intro: "", kind: "", status: "", wordCount: "", tocUrl: bookurl, type: 0 });
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var nameEl = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:novel:book_name']");
            var name = nameEl ? (nameEl.getAttribute("content") || "").trim() : "";
            if (!name) {
                var h1 = doc.querySelector("h1.text-title a");
                if (!h1) h1 = doc.querySelector("h1");
                if (h1) name = (h1.textContent || "").trim();
            }
            var authorEl = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:novel:author']");
            var author = authorEl ? (authorEl.getAttribute("content") || "").trim() : "";
            if (!author) {
                var fa = doc.querySelector(".field span.fl a");
                if (fa) author = (fa.textContent || "").trim();
            }
            var coverEl = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:image']");
            var coverUrl = coverEl ? (coverEl.getAttribute("content") || "") : "";
            if (!coverUrl) {
                var ci = doc.querySelector(".cover img");
                if (ci) coverUrl = ci.getAttribute("src") || "";
            }
            if (coverUrl && !coverUrl.startsWith("http")) coverUrl = absUrl(coverUrl);
            var introEl = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:description']");
            var intro = introEl ? (introEl.getAttribute("content") || "").trim() : "";
            if (!intro) {
                var de = doc.querySelector(".desc");
                if (de) intro = (de.textContent || "").trim();
            }
            var kindEl = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:novel:category']");
            var kind = kindEl ? (kindEl.getAttribute("content") || "").trim() : "";
            var statusEl = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:novel:status']");
            var status = statusEl ? (statusEl.getAttribute("content") || "").trim() : "";
            var lastEl = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:novel:latest_chapter_name']");
            var lastChapter = lastEl ? (lastEl.getAttribute("content") || "").trim() : "";
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify({ bookUrl: bookurl, name: name, author: author, kind: kind, coverUrl: coverUrl || "", intro: intro, tocUrl: bookurl, wordCount: "", status: status, type: 0, latestChapterTitle: lastChapter });
        } catch (e) { return JSON.stringify({ bookUrl: bookurl, name: "", author: "", coverUrl: "", intro: "", kind: "", status: "", wordCount: "", tocUrl: bookurl, type: 0 }); }
    }

    // ===== 目录页函数 =====
    async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
        try {
            var get = await http.Get(absUrl(tocUrl), header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) return "[]";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var chapters = [];
            doc.querySelectorAll("#allChapter ul.chapter li a").forEach(function(a, index) {
                var chapterUrl = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
                var name = (a.textContent || "").trim();
                if (!chapterUrl || !name || name.length < 1) return;
                if (!chapterUrl.startsWith("http")) chapterUrl = baseurl + chapterUrl;
                chapters.push({ name: name, chapterId: chapterUrl, index: index, isPay: false, isVip: false, isVolume: false, tag: "" });
            });
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify(chapters);
        } catch (e) { return "[]"; }
    }

    // ===== 正文页函数 =====
    // 提交内容为目录类里的chapterId
    async function content(url, bookurl) {
        try {
            var get = await http.Get(absUrl(url), header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) return "";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var titleEl = doc.querySelector(".paper-article h1");
            var title = titleEl ? (titleEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
            var contenttxt = "";
            var bookText = doc.querySelector("#BookText");
            if (bookText) {
                var clone = bookText.cloneNode(true);
                var tip = clone.querySelector("#center_tip");
                if (tip) tip.remove();
                contenttxt = (clone.textContent || "").trim();
            }
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            var filterWords = ["最新网址", "手机阅读", "请收藏本站", "本章未完", "点击继续", "温馨提示", "txt下载", "电子书下载"];
            var lines = (contenttxt || "").split("\n");
            var filteredLines = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                var line = (lines[i] || "").trim();
                if (!line) continue;
                var skip = false;
                for (var j = 0; j < filterWords.length; j++) {
                    if (line.indexOf(filterWords[j]) >= 0) { skip = true; break; }
                }
                if (!skip) filteredLines.push(line);
            }
            // 标题净化：正文首行若为标题（与 h1 相同或符合章节标题正则）则剔除，避免与 app 标题重复
            if (filteredLines.length > 0 && title) {
                var first = filteredLines[0].trim();
                var titlePattern = /^第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百千]+[章回节集卷部篇].*$/;
                if (first === title || titlePattern.test(first)) {
                    filteredLines.shift();
                }
            }
            contenttxt = filteredLines.join("\r\n");
            if (!contenttxt || contenttxt.length < 50) return "";
            return contenttxt;
        } catch (e) { return ""; }
    }

    // ===== 发现函数 =====
    async function getfinds() {

        push("乡村小说", "/xiangcun/page_{{page}}.html", 0);
        push("其它小说", "/qita/page_{{page}}.html", 0);
        push("文桑视界", "/wensang/page_{{page}}.html", 0);
        return JSON.stringify(r);
    }

    // ===== 发现搜索函数 =====
    async function find(url, page) {
        try {
            var u = url.replace("{{page}}", page);
            if (!u.startsWith("http")) u = baseurl + u;
            if (page == 1) u = u.replace("page_1.html", "").replace("/page_1", "");
            var get = await http.Get(u, header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) return "[]";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var books = [];
            doc.querySelectorAll(".filter-ret li").forEach(function(li) {
                var nameA = li.querySelector("h3 a");
                if (!nameA) nameA = li.querySelector(".cover");
                var bookUrl = nameA ? (nameA.getAttribute("href") || "") : "";
                var name = nameA ? (nameA.textContent || "").trim() : "";
                if (!nameA || !name) {
                    var h3a = li.querySelector("h3 a");
                    if (h3a) { name = (h3a.textContent || "").trim(); bookUrl = h3a.getAttribute("href") || ""; }
                }
                var coverEl = li.querySelector(".cover img");
                var coverUrl = coverEl ? (coverEl.getAttribute("src") || "") : "";
                if (coverUrl && !coverUrl.startsWith("http")) coverUrl = absUrl(coverUrl);
                var author = "";
                var d1 = li.querySelector(".d1");
                if (d1) author = (d1.textContent || "").replace("作者：", "").trim();
                var introEl = li.querySelector(".d2");
                var intro = introEl ? (introEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
                var lastChapter = "";
                var moreA = li.querySelector(".d1 a.more");
                if (moreA) lastChapter = (moreA.textContent || "").trim();
                if (bookUrl && name) {
                    if (!bookUrl.startsWith("http")) bookUrl = baseurl + bookUrl;
                    books.push({ bookUrl: bookUrl, name: name, author: author, kind: "", coverUrl: coverUrl || "", intro: intro, tocUrl: bookUrl, wordCount: "", type: 0, latestChapterTitle: lastChapter });
                }
            });
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) { return "[]"; }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {

            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {

        }

    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制

            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

            var coverEl = doc.querySelector("#sidebar #fmimg img");
            var coverUrl = coverEl ? (coverEl.getAttribute("src") || "") : "";
            if (coverUrl && coverUrl.indexOf("http") < 0) coverUrl = baseurl + coverUrl;
            var introEl = doc.querySelector("#intro");
            var intro = "";
            if (introEl) {
                var clone = introEl.cloneNode(true);
                // 移除开头的手机阅读广告（手机阅读《xxx》...免费阅读）
                var raw = (clone.textContent || "").trim();
                raw = raw.replace(/^手机阅读.*?免费阅读\s*/, "");
                raw = raw.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
                raw = raw.replace(/最新网址.*$/, "").trim();
                raw = raw.replace(/请收藏本站.*$/, "").trim();
                intro = raw;
            }
            if (!intro) {
                var ogDesc = doc.querySelector('meta[property="og:description"]');
                if (ogDesc) intro = (ogDesc.getAttribute('content') || "").trim();
            }
            var kind = "";
            var ogCat = doc.querySelector("meta[property='og:novel:category']");
            if (ogCat) kind = (ogCat.getAttribute("content") || "").trim();
            var status = "";
            var ogStatus = doc.querySelector('meta[property="og:novel:status"]');
            if (ogStatus) status = (ogStatus.getAttribute("content") || "").trim();
            if (!status) {
                var stxt = doc.body ? (doc.body.textContent || "") : "";
                if (stxt.indexOf("已完结") !== -1 || stxt.indexOf("完本") !== -1) status = "已完结";
                else if (stxt.indexOf("连载") !== -1) status = "连载中";
            }
            var wordCount = "";
            var ogWC = doc.querySelector('meta[property="og:novel:wordCount"]');
            if (ogWC) wordCount = (ogWC.getAttribute("content") || "").trim();
            if (!wordCount) {
                var txtAll = doc.textContent || "";
                var mwc = txtAll.match(/(\d+万字)/);
                if (mwc) wordCount = mwc[1];
            }
            var latestChapter = "";
            var ogLatest = doc.querySelector('meta[property="og:novel:latest_chapter_name"]');
            if (ogLatest) latestChapter = (ogLatest.getAttribute("content") || "").trim();
            if (!latestChapter) {
                var infoPs2 = doc.querySelectorAll("#info p");
                for (var i=0;i<infoPs2.length;i++) {
                    var tt=(infoPs2[i].textContent||"");
                    if (tt.indexOf("最新章节") !== -1) {
                        var a=infoPs2[i].querySelector("a");
                        if (a) latestChapter = (a.textContent || "").trim();
                        else { var mm=tt.match(/最新章节[：:]\s*(.+)/); if(mm) latestChapter=mm[1].trim(); }
                    }
                }
            }
            var tocUrl = absUrl(bookurl);
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify({ bookUrl: bookurl, name: name, author: author, coverUrl: coverUrl, intro: intro, kind: kind, status: status, wordCount: wordCount, tocUrl: tocUrl, type: 0, latestChapterTitle: latestChapter });
        } catch (e) { return JSON.stringify({ bookUrl: bookurl, name: "", author: "", coverUrl: "", intro: "", kind: "", status: "", wordCount: "", tocUrl: bookurl, type: 0 }); }
    }

    // ===== 目录页函数 =====
    async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
        try {
            var post = await http.Get(absUrl(tocUrl), header, true);
            if (!post || !post.data) return "[]";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(post.data));
            var chapters = [];
            var index = 0;
            doc.querySelectorAll("#list dl dd a").forEach(function(a){
                var href = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
                var name = (a.textContent || "").trim();
                if (!href || name.length < 1) return;
                if (href.indexOf("http") < 0) href = baseurl + href;
                index++;
                chapters.push({ name: name, chapterId: href, index: index, isPay: false, isVip: false, isVolume: false, tag: "" });
            });
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify(chapters);
        } catch (e) { return "[]"; }
    }

    // ===== 正文页函数 =====

    async function content(url, bookurl) {
        try {
            var post = await http.Get(absUrl(url), header, true);
            if (!post || !post.data) return "";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(post.data));
            var centerTip = doc.querySelector("#center_tip");
            if (centerTip) centerTip.remove();
            var contentTip = doc.querySelector("#content_tip");
            if (contentTip) contentTip.remove();
            doc.querySelectorAll("script, style").forEach(function(n){ n.remove(); });
            var contentDiv = doc.querySelector("#content");
            if (contentDiv) {
                contentDiv.querySelectorAll("p").forEach(function(p){
                    var text = (p.textContent || "");
                    if (text.indexOf("给个好评") >= 0 || text.indexOf("wap.xbiqugu.la") >= 0 || text.indexOf("手机站全新改版") >= 0) p.remove();
                });
                contentDiv.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(function(a){
                    var href = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
                    if (href.indexOf("koubei.baidu.com") >= 0 || href.indexOf("wap.xbiqugu.la") >= 0) a.remove();
                });
            }
            var content = "";
            if (contentDiv) {
                var html = contentDiv.innerHTML || "";
                html = html.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n');
                html = html.replace(/ /gi, ' ');
                html = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
                html = html.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
                content = html.trim();
            } else {
                content = (doc.textContent || "").trim();
                content = content.replace(/\s+/g, "\n");
            }
            var adKeywords = ["最新网址", "手机阅读", "请收藏本站", "本章未完", "点击继续", "温馨提示", "txt下载", "电子书下载", "www.xbiqugu.la", "笔趣阁", "给个好评", "分数越高更新越快", "wap.xbiqugu.la", "无广告清新阅读"];
            var lines = content.split("\n");
            var filtered = [];
            for (var i=0;i<lines.length;i++) {
                var line=(lines[i]||"").trim();
                if (line.length<1) continue;
                var isAd=false;
                for (var j=0;j<adKeywords.length;j++) { if (line.indexOf(adKeywords[j])>=0) { isAd=true; break; } }
                if (!isAd) filtered.push(line);
            }
            content = filtered.join("\n\n");
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return content;
        } catch (e) { return ""; }
    }

    // ===== 发现函数 =====

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();

    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {

            return tempDiv;

            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除，兼容 jQuery 对象（内部通过 [0] 解引用）
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            if (tempContainer[0]) { tempContainer = tempContainer[0]; }
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

            var get = await http.Get(u, header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) return "[]";
            var doc = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(get.data));
            var books = [];
            // 排行榜/分类通用：优先 #jieqi_page_contents tr，其次 c_row
            var rows = doc.querySelectorAll("#jieqi_page_contents tr");
            if (rows.length > 1) {
                rows.forEach(function(tr){
                    var tds = tr.querySelectorAll("td");
                    if (tds.length < 6) return;
                    var nameA = tds[0].querySelector("a:nth-of-type(2)") || tds[0].querySelector("a");
                    if (!nameA) return;
                    var bookUrl = nameA.getAttribute("href") || "";
                    var name = (nameA.textContent || "").trim();
                    if (!bookUrl || !name) return;
                    if (!bookUrl.startsWith("http")) bookUrl = baseurl + bookUrl;
                    var lastChapter = "";
                    var lastA = tds[1].querySelector("a");
                    if (lastA) lastChapter = (lastA.textContent || "").trim();
                    var author = (tds[2].textContent || "").trim();
                    var kind = (tds[5].textContent || "").trim();
                    books.push({ bookUrl: bookUrl, name: name, author: author, kind: kind, coverUrl: "", intro: "", tocUrl: bookUrl, wordCount: "", type: 0, latestChapterTitle: lastChapter });
                });
            }
            if (books.length === 0) {
                doc.querySelectorAll("#jieqi_page_contents > div.c_row").forEach(function(row){
                    var a = row.querySelector(".c_subject a");
                    var bookUrl = a ? (a.getAttribute("href")||"") : "";
                    var name = a ? (a.textContent||"").trim() : "";
                    if (!bookUrl || !name) return;
                    if (!bookUrl.startsWith("http")) bookUrl = baseurl + bookUrl;
                    var spans = row.querySelectorAll(".c_tag .c_value");
                    var author = spans.length>0 ? (spans[0].textContent||"").trim() : "";
                    var kind = spans.length>1 ? (spans[1].textContent||"").trim() : "";
                    if (kind.indexOf("万")>=0) kind = spans.length>3 ? (spans[3].textContent||"").trim() : "";
                    var coverEl = row.querySelector(".fl img");
                    var coverUrl = coverEl ? (coverEl.getAttribute("src")||"") : "";
                    if (coverUrl && !coverUrl.startsWith("http")) coverUrl = baseurl + coverUrl;
                    var introEl = row.querySelector(".c_description");
                    var intro = introEl ? (introEl.textContent||"").trim() : "";
                    var lastA = row.querySelector(".c_tag .c_value a");
                    var lastChapter = lastA ? (lastA.textContent||"").trim() : "";
                    books.push({ bookUrl: bookUrl, name: name, author: author, kind: kind, coverUrl: coverUrl || "", intro: intro, tocUrl: bookUrl, wordCount: "", type: 0, latestChapterTitle: lastChapter });
                });
            }
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) { return "[]"; }

        constructor() {

            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        var ck = await cookie.get(host);

        }
        wafLoaded = true;
    }

    function extractBooksFromJSON(data) {
        var books = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
            var item = data[i];
            var wordCount = item.bkWords > 10000 ? (item.bkWords / 10000).toFixed(1) + "万字" : item.bkWords + "字";
            books.push({
                bookUrl: baseurl + "/book/" + item.id + ".html",
                name: item.bkName,
                author: item.authName,
                kind: item.cateName,
                coverUrl: item.bkCover,
                wordCount: wordCount,
                latestChapterTitle: item.lastChapterName,
                intro: item.bkDesc,
                tocUrl: baseurl + "/book/" + item.id + ".html",
                type: 0
            });
        }
        return books;
    }

    // ===== 搜索函数 =====
    async function search(key, page, env) {
        try {
            if (env === "searchone") {
                var searchType = await flutterBridge.getsearch();
                if (searchType !== -1 && searchType !== 0) return "[]";
            }
            await ensureCookies();
            var u = host + "/book/search.html?pageNo=" + page + "&kw=" + encodeURIComponent(key);
            var hdr = { "User-Agent": header["User-Agent"], "Referer": host };
            var post = await http.Get(u, hdr, true);
            if (post && post.data) {
                var jsonData = JSON.parse(post.data);
                var books = extractBooksFromJSON(jsonData.content);
                return JSON.stringify(books);
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return "[]";
    }

            var nameEl = doc.querySelector("h1.booktitle");
            var name = nameEl ? (nameEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
            var authorEl = doc.querySelector("a.red");
            var author = authorEl ? (authorEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
            if (!author) {
                var reds = doc.querySelectorAll("a.red");
                if (reds.length>0) author = (reds[0].textContent||"").trim();
            }
            var coverEl = doc.querySelector("img.thumbnail");
            var coverUrl = coverEl ? (coverEl.getAttribute("src") || "") : "";
            if (coverUrl && !coverUrl.startsWith("http")) coverUrl = host + coverUrl;
            var kindEl = doc.querySelector("a.blue");
            var kind = kindEl ? (kindEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
            var statusEl = doc.querySelector("span.red");
            var status = statusEl ? (statusEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
            status = status.indexOf("全本") >= 0 ? "完本" : "连载中";
            var wordCount = "";
            doc.querySelectorAll("span.blue").forEach(function(el){
                var t=(el.textContent||"").trim();
                if (t.indexOf("字") >= 0) wordCount=t;
            });
            var introEl = doc.querySelector("p.bookintro");
            var intro = introEl ? (introEl.textContent || "").trim() : "";
            var suffixIdx = intro.indexOf("《" + name + "》是作家");
            if (suffixIdx > 0) intro = intro.substring(0, suffixIdx);
            var idMatch = bookurl.match(/\/book\/([^\/]+)\.html/);

            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            for (var p = 1; p < pageUrls.length; p++) {

            var html = "";

                clone.querySelectorAll("#center_tip, script, style, link").forEach(function(n){ n.remove(); });
                html = clone.innerHTML || "";
            }
            removeHTMLSafely(doc);
            if (html) {
                html = html.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n");
                html = html.replace(/ /gi, " ");
                html = html.replace(/<p>/gi, "\n");
                html = html.replace(/<\/p>/gi, "");
                html = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "");
                var lines = html.split("\n");
                var filtered = [];
                var filterWords = ["最新网址", "手机阅读", "请收藏本站", "本章未完", "点击继续", "温馨提示", "txt下载", "电子书下载"];
                for (var i=0;i<lines.length;i++) {

                    var skip=false;
                    for (var f=0;f<filterWords.length;f++) if (line.indexOf(filterWords[f])>=0) { skip=true; break; }
                    if (!skip) filtered.push(line);
                }
                var result = filtered.join("\n\n");

    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }

                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {

            }

            var hexData = contentKey.substring(16);
            var wordArray = CryptoJS.enc.Hex.parse(hexData);
            var base64Str = CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(wordArray);
            var decrypted = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(base64Str, keyHex, {
                iv: ivHex,
                mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC,
                padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7
            });
            var decryptedStr = decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8);
            if (!decryptedStr) {
                var wvResult = await contentViaWebview(url);
                if (wvResult) return wvResult;
                flutterBridge.showToast("解密结果为空");
                return "";
            }
            var imageData = JSON.parse(decryptedStr);
            var imgs = [];
            if (Array.isArray(imageData)) {
                for (var i = 0; i < imageData.length; i++) {
                    var item = imageData[i];
                    var imgUrl = typeof item === "string" ? item : (item.url || item.src || "");
                    if (imgUrl && imgUrl.indexOf("http") === 0) {
                        imgs.push('<img src="' + imgUrl + '" />');
                    }
                }
            } else if (typeof imageData === "object") {
                for (var key in imageData) {
                    var imgUrl = imageData[key];
                    if (typeof imgUrl === "string" && imgUrl.indexOf("http") === 0) {
                        imgs.push('<img src="' + imgUrl + '" />');
                    }
                }
            }
            if (imgs.length > 0) {
                return imgs.join("");
            }
            flutterBridge.showToast("未解析到图片URL");
            return "";
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("内容解密失败:" + e.message);
            var wvResult = await contentViaWebview(url);

    async function find(url,page) {
        if (url.indexOf("{{page}}") >= 0) {
            var pageUrl = url.replace("{{page}}", page);
        } else {
            pageUrl = url;
        }
        if (!pageUrl.startsWith("http")) {
            pageUrl = baseurl + pageUrl;
        }
        var resp = await http.Get(pageUrl, header, true);
        if (!resp || !resp.data) return "[]";

        var html = resp.data;

        var listMatch = html.match(/list\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/);
        if (listMatch) {
            try {
                var listStr = listMatch[1].replace(/'/g, "'").replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/&/g, '&');
                var items = eval(listStr);
                var result = [];
                if (Array.isArray(items)) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                        var item = items[i];
                        result.push({
                            bookUrl: baseurl + "/comic/" + item.path_word,
                            name: item.name,
                            author: item.author && item.author.length > 0 ? item.author[0].name : "",
                            coverUrl: item.cover,
                            intro: "",
                            wordCount: "",
                            kind: "",
                            type: 2,
                            latestChapterTitle: ""
                        });
                    }
                    return JSON.stringify(result);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                flutterBridge.log("解析列表数据失败:" + e.message);
            }
        }

        var totalMatch = html.match(/total\s*=\s*"(\d+)"/);
        if (page > 1 && !totalMatch) return "[]";

        var tempContainer = parseHTMLSafely(removeHTMLTags(html));
        var items = [];
        var cols = tempContainer.querySelectorAll(".exemptComic_Item, .col-auto");
        for (var i=0;i<cols.length;i++){
            var item = cols[i];
            var a = item.querySelector("a[href*='/comic/']");
            if (!a) continue;
            var bookUrl = a.getAttribute("href");
            if (!bookUrl || bookUrl.indexOf("javascript") >= 0) continue;
            if (bookUrl.indexOf("http") !== 0) bookUrl = baseurl + bookUrl;
            var img = item.querySelector("img");
            var coverUrl = img ? (img.getAttribute("data-src") || img.getAttribute("data-original") || img.getAttribute("src") || "") : "";
            if (coverUrl.indexOf("loading") >= 0) coverUrl = "";
            var nameEl = item.querySelector(".twoLines");
            var name = nameEl ? nameEl.textContent.trim() : "";
            if (!name) {
                name = a.getAttribute("title") || a.textContent.trim();
            }
            if (!name || name.length < 1) continue;
            var author = "";
            var authorSpan = item.querySelector(".exemptComicItem-txt-span");
            if (authorSpan) {
                author = authorSpan.textContent.trim().replace("作者：", "").replace("作者:", "");
            }
            items.push({
                bookUrl: bookUrl,
                name: name,
                author: author,
                coverUrl: coverUrl,
                intro: "",
                wordCount: "",
                kind: "",
                type: 2,
                latestChapterTitle: ""
            });
        }

        removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer);

        if (items.length === 0) {
            if (page > 1) return "[]";
            return "[]";
        }

        return JSON.stringify(items);
    }

    async function imagedecrypt(url,image) {

            var ccz = await cache.get("2026copy_ccz") || "op0zzpvv.nmn.00p";
            var keyHex = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(ccz);
            var ivHex = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(ccz);
            var decrypted = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(image, keyHex, {
                iv: ivHex,
                mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC,
                padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7
            });
            var words = decrypted.words;
            var byteList = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < decrypted.sigBytes; i++) {
                byteList.push((words[i >>> 2] >>> (24 - (i % 4) * 8)) & 0xff);
            }
            return byteList;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("imagedecrypt失败:" + e.message);
            return null;
        }
    }

            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

                if (!h || !s) continue;
                var href = h[1];

                chapters.shift();

            var getNum = function(s, href){
                var m=s.match(/(\d+)/);

            };

                chapters.reverse();
                for (var i=0;i<chapters.length;i++) chapters[i].index = i;

    class Http {
        constructor() {
      
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

    
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {
            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的容器，互不影响（已移除 jQuery 依赖，原生JS）
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return tempDiv;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        // 移除link标签
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

        if (page == 1) {
            var resp = await http.Get(u, header, true);

                var nameEl = item.querySelector(".likeinfo a p.le-t");

                var authorEl = item.querySelector(".likeinfo p");
                var author = authorEl ? authorEl.textContent.trim().replace("作者：", "") : "";
                var imgEl = item.querySelector(".likeimg img");
                var coverUrl = imgEl ? (imgEl.getAttribute("data-src") || imgEl.getAttribute("src") || "") : "";
                var introEl = item.querySelector("p.le-j");
                var intro = introEl ? introEl.textContent.trim() : "";

            }
        }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

    function encodeDataUrl(html) {
        try {
            var b64 = "";
            try { b64 = flutterBridge.base64encode(html); } catch (e) {}
            if (typeof b64 !== "string") { b64 = ""; }
            if (!b64 && typeof btoa === "function") {
                try { b64 = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(html))); } catch (e2) {}
            }
            if (!b64) { return ""; }
            return "data:text/html;base64," + b64;
        } catch (e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    async function readFilter(prefix) {
        var f = {};
        try {
            var raw = await cache.get(prefix + "filter");
            if (raw) { f = JSON.parse(raw); }
        } catch (e) {}
        return f || {};
    }

    // 本地过滤（服务端忽略的部分）：字数 / 人数筛选
    function passLocalFilter(item, f) {
        if (!f) { return true; }
        var wnum = parseInt(item.word_number, 10) || 0;
        if (f.word === "1" && !(wnum < 1000000)) { return false; }
        if (f.word === "2" && !(wnum >= 1000000 && wnum < 2000000)) { return false; }
        if (f.word === "3" && !(wnum >= 2000000)) { return false; }
        if (f.scorer) {
            var min = parseInt(f.scorer, 10) || 0;
            if (min > 0 && (parseInt(item.scorer, 10) || 0) < min) { return false; }
        }
        return true;
    }

    function mergeFindParams(url, f) {
        if (!f) { return url; }
        var add = {};
        if (f.channel) { add.type = f.channel; }
        if (f.category) { add.categoryId = f.category; }
        if (f.status) { add.updateStatus = f.status; }
        if (f.update) { add.update = f.update; }
        var tagArr = f.tag;
        if (typeof tagArr === "string") { tagArr = tagArr ? [tagArr] : []; }
        if (Array.isArray(tagArr) && tagArr.length) { add.tagList = tagArr.join(","); }
        var sortVal = f.sort || "";
        if (f.bookage && (sortVal === "score" || sortVal === "scorer")) {
            sortVal = sortVal + "_" + f.bookage;
        }
        if (sortVal) { add.sort = sortVal; }
        var addKeys = Object.keys(add);
        if (!addKeys.length) { return url; }

        var qi = url.indexOf("?");
        if (qi < 0) {
            var q = [];
            for (var k0 = 0; k0 < addKeys.length; k0++) { q.push(addKeys[k0] + "=" + encodeURIComponent(add[addKeys[k0]])); }
            return url + "?" + q.join("&");
        }
        var base = url.substring(0, qi);
        var qs = url.substring(qi + 1);
        var parts = qs ? qs.split("&") : [];
        var replaced = {};
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            var p = parts[i];
            var eq = p.indexOf("=");
            var name = eq >= 0 ? p.substring(0, eq) : p;
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(add, name)) {
                if (!replaced[name]) {
                    out.push(name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(add[name]));
                    replaced[name] = true;
                }
            } else {
                out.push(p);
            }
        }
        for (var j = 0; j < addKeys.length; j++) {
            var n = addKeys[j];
            if (!replaced[n]) { out.push(n + "=" + encodeURIComponent(add[n])); }
        }
        return base + "?" + out.join("&");
    }


    // ===== 搜索函数 =====
    async function search(key, page, env) {
        try {
            if (env === "searchone") {
                // 只有选择分类 -1（全部）和 0（小说）时才搜索
                var searchType = await flutterBridge.getsearch();
                if (searchType !== -1 && searchType !== 0) {
                    return "[]";
                }
            }
            var u = baseurl + "/api/novel/search?keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) + "&page=" + page;
            var get = await http.Get(u, header, true);
            if (!get || !get.data) { return "[]"; }
            flutterBridge.text(0, get.data);

            var json = JSON.parse(get.data);
            if (json.code !== "00" || !json.data || !json.data.data) { return "[]"; }

            var books = [];
            json.data.data.forEach(function(item) {
                var bookUrl = baseurl + "/novel/" + item.id + ".html";
                var status = item.update_status === 0 ? "连载中" : (item.update_status === 1 ? "已完结" : (item.update_status === 2 ? "已太监" : ""));
                var wordCount = item.word_number ? Math.floor((parseInt(item.word_number, 10) || 0) / 10000) + "万字" : "";
                var kind = item.tags ? item.tags.split(",")[0] : "";
                books.push({
                    bookUrl: bookUrl,
                    name: item.novel_name,
                    author: item.author_name,
                    kind: kind,
                    coverUrl: item.novel_img || "",
                    wordCount: wordCount,
                    intro: item.synopsis || "",
                    tocUrl: bookUrl,
                    type: 0
                });
            });

            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("search error:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数

             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
