        /*
         * 检查速率限制
         * 实现方法：
         * 1. 获取当前时间戳
         * 2. 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
         * 3. 检查是否超过速率限制
         * 4. 如果超过限制，计算需要等待的时间并等待
         * 5. 递归检查速率限制
         * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
         */
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        /*
         * 通用返回字段

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {
            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的jQuery对象，互不影响
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return $(tempDiv);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return $('<div>');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除，兼容 jQuery 对象（内部通过 [0] 解引用）
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            if (tempContainer[0]) { tempContainer = tempContainer[0]; }
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        // 移除link标签
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 Mobile/15E148",
    "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
    "X-Payload-Version": "1",
    "Cookie": "dfp=f-c29c4:f-testfingerprintvalue1234567890"
};

// ============ 加密解密（基于 @noble/ciphers 单文件构建） ============
// NobleCiphers 提供：hexToBytes/bytesToHex/utf8ToBytes/bytesToUtf8/concatBytes、
//   xchacha20poly1305(key, nonce) -> {encrypt,decrypt}（输出/输入为 ciphertext||tag）、
//   gcm(key, nonce, aad?) -> {encrypt,decrypt}（输出/输入为 ciphertext||tag）
var NB = typeof NobleCiphers !== 'undefined' ? NobleCiphers : null;
function hexDecode(s) { return NB ? NB.hexToBytes(s) : null; }
function hexEncode(b) { return NB ? NB.bytesToHex(b) : null; }
function utf8Encode(s) { return NB ? NB.utf8ToBytes(s) : null; }
function utf8Decode(b) { return NB ? NB.bytesToUtf8(b) : null; }

// 响应载荷格式：[version][24B nonce][cipher]，version=2 时 cipher 整体 reverse
function decryptPayloadHex(hexPayload, key32) {
    if (!NB) return null;
    var enc = NB.hexToBytes(hexPayload);
    if (enc.length < 41) return null;
    var v = enc[0];
    var nonce = enc.subarray(1, 25);
    var cipher = enc.subarray(25);
    if (v === 2) cipher = cipher.slice().reverse();
    try { return NB.xchacha20poly1305(key32, nonce).decrypt(cipher); }
    catch (e) { return null; }
}
// 请求体封装：[version][12B iv][cipher+tag]，version=1
function encryptRequestPayload(key32, dataBytes) {
    if (!NB) return null;
    var iv = new Uint8Array(12);
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.getRandomValues) crypto.getRandomValues(iv);
    else for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) iv[i] = (Math.random() * 256) | 0;
    var cipher = NB.gcm(key32, iv).encrypt(dataBytes);
    var out = new Uint8Array(1 + 12 + cipher.length);
    out[0] = 1; out.set(iv, 1); out.set(cipher, 13);
    return out;
}


// ============ 通用请求工具 ============
var KEY = hexDecode(keyHex);

// 静态池 GET：返回解密后的 JSON 对象（或 null）
async function get1(path) {
    var get = await http.Get(baseurl + "/" + path, header, true);
    if (!get || get.statusCode !== 200 || !get.data) return null;
    try {
        var j = JSON.parse(get.data);
        if (!j.payload) return j;
        var pt = decryptPayloadHex(j.payload, KEY);
        return pt ? JSON.parse(utf8Decode(pt)) : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
}

// 动态 API POST：请求体 AES-GCM 加密(hex)，响应 XChaCha 解密
async function apiPost(path, bodyObj) {
    var payload = encryptRequestPayload(KEY, utf8Encode(JSON.stringify(bodyObj)));
    var body = hexEncode(payload);
    var post = await http.Post(apiurl + path, header, body, "text/plain", true);
    if (!post || post.statusCode !== 200 || !post.data) return null;
    try {
        var j = JSON.parse(post.data);
        if (!j.payload) return j;
        var pt = decryptPayloadHex(j.payload, KEY);
        return pt ? JSON.parse(utf8Decode(pt)) : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
}

// 由 album 记录组装书本对象
async function makeBook(it) {
    var id = String(it.id);
    var b64 = await flutterBridge.base64encode(id);
    var kind = (it.type || "") + (it.cat && it.cat !== it.type ? "/" + it.cat : "");
    return {
        "bookUrl": b64,
        "name": it.title || "",
        "author": (it.teller || it.author || ""),
        "kind": kind,
        "coverUrl": it.cover_url || "",
        "intro": it.description || "",
        "tocUrl": b64,
        "wordCount": "",
        "type": 1,
        "latestChapterTitle": ""
    };
}

// ===== 搜索函数 =====
async function search(key, page, env) {
    try {
        // 只有选择分类 -1（全部）和 1（听书）时才搜索
        if (env === "searchone") {
            var searchType = await flutterBridge.getsearch();
            if (searchType !== -1 && searchType !== 1) {
                return "[]";
            }
        }
        var d = await apiPost("/api/search", { keyword: key, page: page || 1 });
        if (!d || !d.results) return "[]";
        var books = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < d.results.length; i++) {
            books.push(await makeBook(d.results[i]));
        }
        return JSON.stringify(books);
    } catch (e) { return "[]"; }
}

// ===== 筛选函数 =====
async function filter() {
    return "";
}

// ===== 发现筛选函数 =====

    return "";
}

// ===== 详情页函数 =====
async function info(bookurl) {
    try {
        var id = await flutterBridge.base64decode(bookurl);
        var d = await get1("album_info/" + id);
        if (!d) return JSON.stringify({ "bookUrl": bookurl, "name": "", "author": "", "coverUrl": "", "intro": "", "kind": "", "tocUrl": "", "type": 1 });
        return JSON.stringify({
            "bookUrl": bookurl,
            "name": d.title || "",
            "author": (d.teller || d.author || ""),
            "coverUrl": d.cover_url || "",
            "intro": d.synopsis || d.description || "",
            "kind": (d.type || d.cat || ""),
            "status": (d.status === 0 ? "已完结" : "连载中"),
            "wordCount": "",
            "tocUrl": bookurl,
            "type": 1,
            "latestChapterTitle": ""
        });
    } catch (e) {
        return JSON.stringify({ "bookUrl": bookurl, "name": "", "author": "", "coverUrl": "", "intro": "", "kind": "", "tocUrl": "", "type": 1 });
    }
}

// ===== 目录页函数 =====
async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
    try {
        var albumId = await flutterBridge.base64decode(tocUrl);
        var d = await get1("album_chapters/" + albumId);
        if (!d || !d.chapters) return "[]";
        var list = [];
        var chs = d.chapters;
        for (var i = 0; i < chs.length; i++) {
            var c = chs[i];
            list.push({
                "name": c.title || ("第" + (c.index || (i + 1)) + "集"),
                "chapterId": await flutterBridge.base64encode(albumId + "❌" + c.index),
                "index": i,
                "isPay": false,
                "isVip": false,
                "isVolume": false,
                "tag": ""
            });
        }
        return JSON.stringify(list);
    } catch (e) { return "[]"; }
}

// ===== 正文页函数（听书源核心）：返回音频URL =====
async function content(url, bookurl) {
    try {
        var decoded = await flutterBridge.base64decode(url);
        var parts = decoded.split("❌");
        if (parts.length < 2) return "";
        var albumId = parts[0], idx = parts[1];
        var d = await apiPost("/api/play_token", { album_id: albumId, chapter_idx: parseInt(idx, 10) });
        if (d && d.play_url) return d.play_url;
        return "";
    } catch (e) { return ""; }
}

// ===== 发现函数 =====
async function getfinds() {
    var list = [];
    list.push({ title: "推荐", url: await flutterBridge.base64encode("home") + "❌{{page}}", type: 0 });
    list.push({ title: "最近更新", url: await flutterBridge.base64encode("recent") + "❌{{page}}", type: 0 });
    var d = await get1("filters");
    if (d && d.categories) {
        for (var c = 0; c < d.categories.length; c++) {
            var cat = d.categories[c];
            list.push({ title: cat.name, url: "", type: 0 });
            var types = cat.types || [];
            for (var t = 0; t < types.length; t++) {
                var ty = types[t];
                list.push({ title: ty.name, url: await flutterBridge.base64encode("cat❌" + ty.id) + "❌{{page}}", type: 0 });
            }
        }
    }
    return JSON.stringify(list);
}

async function find(url, page) {
    try {
        var parts = url.split("❌");
        if (parts.length < 2) return "[]";
        var tag = await flutterBridge.base64decode(parts[0]);
        var arr = null;
        if (tag === "home" || tag === "recent") {
            if (page > 1) return "[]";
            var h = await get1("homepage");
            if (!h) return "[]";
            arr = tag === "home" ? (h.recommends || []) : (h.recent_updates || []);
            var homeBooks = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) homeBooks.push(await makeBook(arr[i]));
            return JSON.stringify(homeBooks);
        }
        var pieces = tag.split("❌");
        if (pieces[0] === "cat") {
            var typeId = pieces[1];
            var d = await get1("types/" + typeId + "//comprehensive/p" + page);
            if (!d || !d.data) return "[]";
            var books = [];
            for (var j = 0; j < d.data.length; j++) books.push(await makeBook(d.data[j]));
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        }
        return "[]";
    } catch (e) { return "[]"; }
}

async function pay(bookurl, url) { }

}

            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

      
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

    class Http {
        constructor() {
      
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

  
        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    class Http {
        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");

    class Http {
        constructor() {
    
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {
            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的容器，互不影响（已移除 jQuery 依赖，原生JS）
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return tempDiv;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        // 移除link标签
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制

    function htBase64Decode(str) {
        var keyStr = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
        var output = "";
        var chr1, chr2, chr3, enc1, enc2, enc3, enc4;

            chr1 = (enc1 << 2) | (enc2 >> 4);

                i++;
            } else if ((c > 191) && (c < 224)) {
                c2 = str.charCodeAt(i + 1);
                string += String.fromCharCode(((c & 31) << 6) | (c2 & 63));

            } else {
                c2 = str.charCodeAt(i + 1);

    class Http {
        constructor() {
  
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

     
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

    //安全的创建一个 div 解析 html
    function parseHTMLSafely(htmlStr) {
        try {
            // 在函数作用域内创建独立的临时容器
            // 每个调用创建新的容器，互不影响（已移除 jQuery 依赖，原生JS）
            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlStr;
            return tempDiv;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML解析错误:"+e.message);
            return document.createElement('div');
        }
    }

    //parseHTMLSafely 创建的用完后必须删除
    function removeHTMLSafely(tempContainer) {
        try {
            tempContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (tempContainer.parentNode) {
                tempContainer.parentNode.removeChild(tempContainer);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("HTML移除失败:"+e.message);
        }
    }

    //移除 css js，创建parseHTMLSafely前如果用不上 cssjs 建议移除
    function removeHTMLTags(htmlString) {
        // 移除script标签
        let result = htmlString.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
        // 移除style标签
        result = result.replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '');
        // 移除link标签
        result = result.replace(/<link\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/link>)<[^<]*)*<\/link>/gi, '');
        return result;
    }

                    for (var bc = 0, bs = 0, buffer, i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {

                        bs = bc % 4 ? bs * 64 + buffer : buffer;

    class Http {
        constructor() {
            /*
             * 速率限制配置
             * requestTimestamps: 存储请求时间戳的数组
             * rateLimit: 速率限制，单位时间内最大请求数
             * rateLimitWindow: 速率限制窗口，单位毫秒
             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }


        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }


        async Get(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"get",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Head(url,headers,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"head",url,"",JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,"");
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }

        async Post(url,headers,body,contenttype,followRedirects) {
            try {
                await this.checkRateLimit();
                return await window.flutter_inappwebview.callHandler('http',"post",url,body,JSON.stringify(headers),followRedirects,contenttype);
            } catch (error) {
                return  null;
            }
        }
    }

        constructor() {

            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组

            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒
        }

       
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);
            // 检查是否超过速率限制
            if (this.requestTimestamps.length >= this.rateLimit) {
                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制
                return this.checkRateLimit();
            }
            // 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
            this.requestTimestamps.push(now);
        }

             */
            this.open = false; // 是否开启速率限制
            this.requestTimestamps = []; // 存储请求时间戳的数组
            this.rateLimit = 5; // 速率限制，1000毫秒内最多5次请求
            this.rateLimitWindow = 1000; // 速率限制窗口，1000毫秒

        /*
         * 检查速率限制

         * 5. 递归检查速率限制
         * 6. 将当前时间戳添加到数组中
         */
        async checkRateLimit() {
            if(!this.open) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            // 过滤掉超出时间窗口的时间戳
            this.requestTimestamps = this.requestTimestamps.filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < this.rateLimitWindow);

                // 计算需要等待的时间
                const oldestTimestamp = this.requestTimestamps[0];
                const waitTime = this.rateLimitWindow - (now - oldestTimestamp);
                // 等待到速率限制可用
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime));
                // 递归检查速率限制

                for (var j = 0; j < item.subs.length; j++) {
                    var s = item.subs[j];
                    finds.push({ title: s.name,
                                 url: await flutterBridge.base64encode(String(s.cid)) + "❌{{page}}",
                                 type: 0 });
                }
            } else {
                finds.push({ title: item.name,
                             url: await flutterBridge.base64encode(String(item.cid)) + "❌{{page}}",
                             type: 0 });
            }
        }
        return JSON.stringify(finds);
    }

    // ===== 发现请求 =====
    async function find(url, page) {
        try {
            var parts = url.split("❌");
            var cidBase = parts[0] || "";
            var cid = cidBase ? (await flutterBridge.base64decode(cidBase)) : "28";
            var pageNum = String(page);
            var path = "/ecmsapi/index.php?act=list&mod=movie";
            if (cid === "all") {
                path += "&classid=0&sort=newstime desc&page=" + pageNum + "&pagesize=50";
            } else {
                path += "&classid=" + cid + "&sort=onclick desc&page=" + pageNum + "&pagesize=50";
            }
            var data = await getJSON(path);
            if (!data || data.code !== 1 || !data.data || !data.data.list) {
                return "[]";
            }
            var books = [];
            var list = data.data.list;
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var item = list[i];
                if (!item.id) { continue; }
                books.push(await buildBook(item));
            }
            return JSON.stringify(books);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("发现错误:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    // ===== 详情 =====
    async function info(bookurl) {
        try {
            var workId = await flutterBridge.base64decode(bookurl);
            var data = await getJSON("/ecmsapi/index.php?mod=movie&act=detail&id=" + encodeURIComponent(workId));
            if (!data || data.code !== 1 || !data.data || !data.data.detail) {
                return JSON.stringify({ "bookUrl": bookurl });
            }
            var d = data.data.detail;
            var player = d.player || "";
            if (Array.isArray(player)) { player = player.join(","); }
            var author = d.playadmin || "";
            if (author && player && author !== player) { author = author + " " + player; }
            var filetype = d.filetype || "";
            var status = (filetype === "连载" || filetype === "连载中") ? "连载中" : (filetype ? "完本" : "");
            var book = {
                "bookUrl": bookurl,
                "name": d.title || "",
                "author": author,
                "kind": ((d.movietype || d.firstclassname || "") + " " + filetype).trim(),
                "coverUrl": d.titlepic || "",
                "intro": d.moviesay || "",
                "tocUrl": await flutterBridge.base64encode(String(d.id)),
                "wordCount": "",
                "status": status,
                "type": 1,
                "latestChapterTitle": ""
            };
            return JSON.stringify(book);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("详情错误:" + e.message);
            return JSON.stringify({ "bookUrl": bookurl });
        }
    }

    // ===== 目录 =====
    async function chapter(tocUrl, bookurl) {
        try {
            var workId = await flutterBridge.base64decode(tocUrl);
            var chapters = [];
            var page = 1;
            var maxPages = 20;   // 上限保护，20页 x 1000 = 20000 章
            while (page <= maxPages) {
                var path = "/ecmsapi/index.php?mod=movie&act=movielist&id=" + encodeURIComponent(workId) + "&page=" + page + "&pagesize=1000";
                var data = await getJSON(path);
                if (!data || data.code !== 1 || !data.data) { break; }
                var moielist = data.data.moielist || data.data.list || [];
                if (moielist.length === 0) { break; }
                for (var i = 0; i < moielist.length; i++) {
                    var item = moielist[i];
                    if (!item.id) { continue; }
                    chapters.push({
                        "name": item.title || ("第" + item.id + "集"),
                        "chapterId": await flutterBridge.base64encode(String(workId) + "❌" + String(item.id)),
                        "index": chapters.length,
                        "isPay": false,
                        "isVip": false,
                        "isVolume": false,
                        "tag": ""
                    });
                }
                var totalpage = data.data.totalpage || 0;
                if (page >= totalpage) { break; }
                page++;
            }
            return JSON.stringify(chapters);
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("目录错误:" + e.message);
            return "[]";
        }
    }

    // ===== 正文/音频 =====
    async function content(url, bookurl) {
        try {
            var decoded = await flutterBridge.base64decode(url);
            var parts = decoded.split("❌");
            var workId = parts[0];
            var seq = parts[1] || "1";
            var cachedLineKey = await cachedLine(workId);
            if (cachedLineKey && cachedLineKey !== "series") {
                for (var ci = 1; ci < audioLines.length; ci++) {
                    var cl = audioLines[ci];
                    if (cl.name === cachedLineKey) {
                        return cl.prefix + workId + "/" + seq + "." + cl.ext;
                    }
                }
            }
            var ts = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
            var token = ecmsToken(workId, seq);
            var path = "/ecmsapi/index.php?act=wapseries&mod=movie&id=" + encodeURIComponent(workId)
                + "&movieId=" + encodeURIComponent(seq) + "&t=" + ts + "&token=" + token;
            var data = await getJSON(path);
            var seriesUrl = (data && data.code === 1 && data.data && data.data.SeriesUrl) ? data.data.SeriesUrl : "";
            if (!seriesUrl) { return ""; }
            var line = await findLine(workId, seriesUrl);
            if (!line || line === "series") {
                return seriesUrl;
            }
            // 用线路前缀拼接
            for (var i = 1; i < audioLines.length; i++) {
                var l = audioLines[i];
                if (l.name === line) {
                    return l.prefix + workId + "/" + seq + "." + l.ext;
                }
            }
            return seriesUrl;
        } catch (e) {
            flutterBridge.log("音频错误:" + e.message);
            return "";
        }
    }
